tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ 'dir rje sna tshogs rang grol gyi bka' 'bum chos tshan gyi rnam grangs ji ltar bzhugs pa'i rim pa bkod par glegs bam kha) pa la/ rang gzhan la bslab bya gros 'debs kyi skor rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdeb pa lhag bsam rab dkar pad+ma'i phreng ba ldeb/ 146 bstod tshogs rin chen gser gyi mchod sdong ldeb/ 7 bdag gzhan don gang la'ang sbyor rung ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs 'byung gnas ldeb/ 7 gsang sngags rnying ma'i cha gsum gtor chog ldeb/ 17 sangs rgyas kyi dus chen rnams dang*/ gu ru'i tshes bcu sogs kyi ngos 'dzin rgyu mtshan phan yon bcas ldeb/ 16 sku rten rnying pa zhig gsos ar+gha'i cho ga ji ltar bya tshul ldeb/ 6 chos thams cad kyi snying po phyag rgya chen po'i don yang dag par rab tu gsal bar byed pa dri ma med pa'i sgron ma ldeb 52 bcas bzhugs//

1) ༄༅/ 'dir rang gzhan la bslab bya gros 'debs kyi skor rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa lhag bsam rab dkar pad+ma'i 'phreng ba'o// 2) ༄༅/ na mo gu ru/ mkhyen rab nam mkha'i khyon yangs par// thugs rje'i nyi gzhon 'od 'bar bas// bskal bzang yid kyi mun sel ba// drin can bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ de yang bdag ni dal 'byor gyi mi lus tsam zhig stes dbang gis thob mod kyang*/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab dang mi 'bral zhing*/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa 'ga' dang*// mjal nas de dag gi thugs rjes 'dzin par mdzad na'ang*/ rang nyid bskal pa dman zhing shes rab zhan pa'i dbang gis yon tan gyi cha shas 'ga' tsam yang thob par ma nus te/ ji skad du/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ lha yi rgyal pos char phabs kyang*// sa bon mi rung mi 'khrungs ltar// sangs rgyas rnams ni byon gyur kyang*// skal 3) ba med pas bzang mi myong*// zhes pa ltar dang*/ khyad par du zab khrid gdams pa'i snying po mang zhig zhu lo bgyid kyang*/ de dag rang nyid kyi rgyud thog tu ma khel bar sgo gsum rnam g.yeng snyom las kyi dbang du gyur cing zab chos nyams len gsha' ma zhig byed pa'i long med par tshe 'di'i khe grags dang 'du 'dzi sogs chos min gyi bya ba sha stag la mi tshe bskyel ba zhig bdag la 'bab gda' bas/ da ni de dag las brgyang bsrings te rgyal ba'i bsngags pas ri khrod dben par/ ri'i bu byas/ na bun la gos byas/ gyong lto gos gtam gsum la bskur nas tshe dang bsgrub pa mnyam pa zhig e yong dang*/ tha ma yang 'jig rten gyi chags sdang zhe sdang dang*/ dkor nag la bag med du spyod mi dgos tsam 4) zhig gi 'dun pa ni gtan du yod kyang rang dbang med par 'ching ba'i zhags pa dam pos bcings zhing khri mun gyi nang du chud pa 'di las thar nas/ rje mi las/ nga shi ba dgra yis ma tshor zhing*// na ba gnyen gyis ma tshor bar// ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na// sprang po'i bsam pa 'grub pa yin// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i chos tshul bzhin byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa zhig bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen zhes gsol ba btab cing*/

rang gi rang nyid la bskul 'debs kyi tshig 'ga' smras pa ni/ ༄༅/ rje 'gro ba'i sde dpon pad+ma 'byung*// mtshungs bral gyi bka' rgyud bla ma'i tshogs// chos med kyi bu ngas gsol 'debs kyis// rgyud byin gyis rlobs shig thugs rje can// bdag snyigs dus kyi btsun gzugs tshul chos mkhan// bsod nams kyi las 'phro chung ba'i mthus// rtsod ldan gyi bstan zhabs 'di 'drar skyes// chos med kyi bla ma'i tshul bzung zhing*// 'jig rten gyi bya ba kho nas mnar// 'di skyug nad can gyis 5)zas mthong bzhin// blor dran pa tsam gyis 'tshangs la phog /lar 'jig rten las kyi bya byed 'di// bdag sngar nas mi 'dod yod bzhin du// dus ding sang lhag par skyo shas 'phel// tshe mi rtag la kha'i na bun 'dra// dus do nub 'chi'am cha med par// tshe 'di nyid kyi bya byed bgyid bgyid nas// rang phyi ma'i don chen yal bar 'dor// lar skyes pa'i pha yul rgyab bskyur zhing*// mgon shākya'i bstan la rab byung kyang*// chos tshul bzhin byed pa'i long med cing*// gnas dben pa bsten pa'i dbang med par// gzhan mgu byed thabs la 'bad pa 'di// phugs rang gzhan gnyis ka phung pa'i rgyu// de yin par go yang rang dbang med// 'khor g.yog gi skyong bran zhe sdang gi rgyu// nor rdzas kyi rtsol bsgrub rnam smin gyi las// yon bdag gi ngo slang chags sdang gi gzhi// 6)/bya byed kun chos dang mi mthun zhing*// 'jig rten gyi bya bas g.yengs pa la// rgyal bstan gyi zhabs tog yin par rlom// 'di bskyur na ni theg dman gyi lta bar 'gro// byas na ni dge sbyor gyi bar chad che// bdag 'di 'dra'i 'ching bas ma bcings ba// las ci 'dra'i rnam smin 'dir gyur tam// skyabs mi bslu nges pa dkon mchog gsum// rje skyabs gnas dam pa pad+ma 'byung*// khyod thugs rjes nus pa'i dpung bskyed la// bdag 'khor ba'i 'dam las drang du gsol/

/de yang bdag 'khor ba'i bya ba dang 'du 'dzi'i las kyi mnar ba 'di nyid spyir ni rang la chos kyi bsod nams dman par gor ma chagasashing*/ khyad par du ni rang gi yid la chos sha stag de lta bu zhig 'dun pa yod kyang*/ da dung cung zhig blo thag ma chod par gzhan gyi ngag la nyan pas lan pa dang*/ le lo phyi bshol gyi dbang du thal bar 'dug snyam ste/ rang gis rang nyid la gros 'debs dran pa'i lcags skyu 'di smrasaso// ༄༅/ skyabs gnas bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud de/ 7)/da ni rang gis rang la gros cig 'debs// dus mtha'i sprang po tshul 'chos mkhan po khyed// 1$1000220bstan pa'i sgor zhugs lo mang lon mod kyang*// da dung chos dang rang rgyud ma 'dres par// rnam rtog brgyud mar spel 'di zhe re 'khrel// da nas chos dang rang rgyud bsre ba 'thad// na so gzhon kyang tshe la nges med cing*// 'byung 'dus sgyu lus nam 'dor cha med kyang*// da dung skyid 'dod tshe 'di'i zhen pas bcings// da ni long med chos la brtson pa 'thad// shi dus chos min cis kyang mi phan par// cha yod bzhin du da dung rnam g.yeng byed// chos med chos par brdzu 'di zhe re 'khrel// da ni phyi ma'i don mchog sgrub pa 'thad// 'khor g.yog longs spyod nor rdzas la sogs pa// 'du 'dzi chos kyi bdud du mi bsam par// da dung 'jig rten khe grags lo 'dod sgrub// da ni nges par dben pa 8)bsten pa 'thad// mtshan ldan bla ma 'ga' dang mjal na yang*// snying nas mos gus bkur bsti mi byed par// 'gran sems mnyam 'grogs byed pa zhe re 'khrel// da ni gus pas gdams ngag zhu ba 'thad// dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin mi srung zhing*// dge ba'i bshes kyi mtshan nyid mi ldan par// da dung btsun pa'i gral 'gor bsdod 'di blun// da ni gcig pur ri khrod 'grim pa 'thad// thos pas phyi yi sgro 'dogs ma chod cing*// sgom pas nang gi btsan sa ma zin par// da dung gzhan la chos bshad byed pa blun// da ni sgrub pa snying por dril ba 'thad// dbang khrid gdams pa 'ga' zhig thob na yang*// rang rgyud thog tu ma khel zhu lo tsam// chos dang rang sems so sor bsdod 'di blun// da ni zab don nyams su blangs pa 'thad// bskyed rim lha yi bsnyen sgrub ma rdzogs shing*// rdzogs rim lta ba'i gdengs dang

9)ma ldan par// shi gson kun gyi skyabs gnas byed pa 'khrul// da ni thog mar rang skyabs 'tshol ba 'thad// smin byed dbang gis rang rgyud ma smin zhing*// grol byed gdams pa'i rtsis kyis ma zin par// da dung gzhan gyi 'dren pa byed pa blun// da ni thog mar rang don bsgrub pa 'thad// nam zhig bar do'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i tshe// 'khor g.yog mang pos phan pa med mod kyang*// da dung chos med grogs mang brten 'di blun// 1$10002201$1000180da ni gcig pur bsam gtan bsgom pa 'thad// 'chi bdag bdud kyi zhags pas btab pa'i tshe// longs spyod nor gyi rdul tsam phan med na'ang*// da dung nor rdzas bsog 'jog byed 'di blun// da ni zang zing sred pa bskyungs na 'thad// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi 'dam kha'i sa mtshams su// da res 'dam kha log na shin tu sdug /'jig rten bya bzhag byas pa don med bor/ 10)/da ni gtan gyi 'dun ma bsgrub pa 'thad// 'khor ba'i chos la spros pa ma chod cing*// dkon mchog gsum la blo gtad ma byas na// da dung rtag tu 'khor bar 'khyams 'gyur bas// da ni dam pa'i chos la 'bungs pa 'thad// pha yul bdud kyi brtson rar ma shes shing*// nye 'brel bdud kyi pho nyar ma shes par// chags zhing zhen na ngan 'gror 'phen pa'i rgyu// da nas chags sdang rtsad nas bcad pa 'thad// mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs la ma gtugs na// ngan song 'khor ba'i skye sgo su yis chod// lus srog longs spyod bla ma'i phyogs btang nas// kha zhe med pa'i skyabs gnas bcol ba 'thad// rang gis chos btsal nyams su ma blangs na// chos kyis rang nyid 'tshol bar ga la 'gyur// lus srog blos gtang dka' ba lhur blangs nas// zab mo'i gdams ngag nyams su len pa 'thad// de ltar chos med dus mtha'i snyom las pas// gnas 11)skabs shig tu rang gi rang nyid la// bslab bya gros 'debs phyir du 'di smras pa'i// dge bas 'gro kun byang chub myur thob shog/༄༅/

swasti/ skyabs mchog gsum gyi ngo bo rdo rje 'dzin// mgon mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin po che// de spyi gtsug tu mi 'bral rgyan du bzhugs// rje thugs rje'i bdag des byin gyis rlobs// nga snyigs dus kyi chos gzugs snyom las pa// yid skyo ba sangs ba'i glu 'di blangs// lha dpa' bo mkha' 'gror mchod pa 'bul// grogs rdo rje'i spun tsho dgyes par mdzod// phyi mtha' bral gyi nam mkha' stong pa dang*// nang 'dzin med kyi rig pa stong gsal gnyis// de stong tshul 'dra yang gsal ba'i khyad// sems gsal stong zung 'jug cig ma go na// lha snang stong du go ba de bas dka'// lar snyigs dus kyi chos pa'i gzugs 'dzin pa// blo gnyis 'dzin gyi 'dud pa ma grol bar// 12)gzhan gsal stong sogs ngo sprod byed pa de// dpe dmus long gis lam mkhan byed pa 'dra// lar gnyis 'dzin 'di 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyu// nam gnyis 'dzin bral na sangs rgyas zhes// de log nas thob rgyu zhig med pa lags// 'di rig pa'i khye'u chung khyod ma go'am// zhes snyigs dus kyi bla ma'i tshul 'dzin des// tshig bslab bya rang gis rang la smras// rtogs grol gyi don mchog thob par shog /ces pa 'di 'ga' zhig ni chos skad sems dang nam mkha' gcig zer ba dang*/ rdzogs rim mi shes kyang bskyed rim las sla zer ba sogs la cung zad yid ma rangs nas smras pa ste/ de ltar 'di yan chad rang lo gzhon nu'i lo bco lnga pa'i dus 'khos ka med rung bla ma'i tshul bzung nas 'jig rten gyi bya ba la bstan don yin rgyur bsgom shing grwa 'khor yon bdag gi skyong bstang m-i yong bzhin du byed dgos pa'i skabs byung ba'i tshe smras pa'o// kye ma/ dal 'byor bco brgyad kyis brgyan pa'i mi lus dang rin chen// thob nas snyom las su bsdad na don med du 'gyur bas// mi tshe stong 13)zad du ma btang lha chos la 'bungs dang*// 'dir bde phyi ma skyid pa'i bdun ma rang yin no// tshe srog rtswa kha'i zil 'dra nges med kyi tshe la// long yod phyi bshol du bsdad na 'chi bdag gi slebs yong*// blo sna chos phyogs su dril la brtson 'grus su gyis dang*// shi dus 'gyod med kyi grabs gcig da lta nas dgos so// 1$1000220dka' las brtsol sgrub kyis bsags pa'i nor rdzas dang longs spyod// 'chi dus 'khyer dbang med par lag stongs su 'gro dgos// zhen med chog shes kyi bang mdzod nor rdzas kyi dam pa// phyi ma'i lam rgyags shig bsgrub na de 'dra zhig dgos so/

dgos 'dod kun 'byung gi nor bu mtshon ldan gyi bla ma/ mos gus gsul 'debs la 'bad na byin rlabs kyi char 'debs// glo rnying brang gsum gyi gtad sa 'di la rang bgyid dang*// 'di phyi'i bde legs kyi lam zhig de na rang gda'o// 'khor 'das 14)kun rtsa ba rang rig dang stong gsal// 'khrul snang a 'thas su ma btang dran shes kyis bzung dang*// 'dzin med rang grol du 'gro ba nam mkha' dang sprin ltar// ltad mo ngo mtshar can zhig de na rang gda'o// chos med snyoms las kyi sprang po sna tshogs dang rang grol// gtad med gang shar du smras pa'i shugs 'byung gi glu 'di// dben pa'i mtshams khang nas smras 'di dad ldan rang rnams kyi/ yid gyi re ba skong ba'i dga' ston du gyur cig ༄༅/ bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med du 'dres pas// gsol ba la 'debs bya 'debs byed dang bral zhing*// byin rlabs su rang sems rang ngo shes pas// bka' drin gyi mchog tu 'di rang che byung*// gang shar gyi rang ngo cer gyi bltas tsam na// shar mkhan gyi ngo bo logs su ma rnyed// blta bya dang blta byed dbyer med du song bas// ngo sprod kyi mchog tu 'di rang zab byung*// rtsol byas kyi dmigs pas rnam rtog spel zhing*// 15)spang blang gi sgom gyis bogs skyed mi 'dug /sgom med kyi ngang du yengs med skyong ba// gdams ngag gi gnad du 'di rang che byung*/ chos med kyi sprang po gtad med bdag 'dras// nges med kyi tshig 'di rang shar du smras pas// thar med kyi 'gro ba sdug bsngal las grol te// spros med kyi go 'phang thob par shog cig /ces pa rnams rang lo nyer gsum par mtshams mal nas smras pa'o// ༄༅/ e ma/ dal 'byor rin chen rnyed par dka' ba da lan lan gcig thob dus 'dir// don med tshe 'di'i bya ba bsgrub na gtan gyi 'dun ma mi 'byung bas// snying po med pa'i 'jig rten bya ba sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor 'dra ba 'di// spangs nas dam pa'i lha chos bsgrub pa sprang po kho na'i snying gtam yin// tshe 'di mi rtag rtsa kha'i zil dang la kha'i na bun ji bzhin du// nam 'ch-i cha med nges med tshe la rnam g.yeng byed du mi khom pas// sang byed gnang byed lo zla 'das nas

16)'chi bdag bdud kyis gtug ge 'ongs// da lta nyid nas chos la brtson pa sprang po kho'i snying gtam yin// gnyen dang nye ba nor rdzas longs spyod bdud kyi pho nya chos kyi dgra /cis kyang dgos med zhen log soms shig kha zhe med par ma skyes na// 'dod pa'i ra ba sgyu ma'i nor gyis gang ba'i dus zhig mi yong bas// ser sna spong zhing chog shes byed pa sprang po kho bo'i snying gtam yin// mtshan ldan bla ma dgos 'dod kun 'byung yid bzhin nor bu rin chen la// rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba btab na byin rlabs dngos grub char rgyun 'bebs// mos pa'i bu la thugs rjes gzigs pa blam kun gyi dam tshig ste// dad gus gsol 'debs rgyun du byed pa sprang po kho bo'i snying gtam yin// rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo rgyud man ngag du ma'i bcud gyur dam pa'i chos// zhi phyag lam rdzogs rgya chen chos kyi rnam grangs dpag tu med mod kyang*// kun gyi dgongs mthun ma bcos mtha' 17)bral rang rig gsal stong zab mo'i chos// sgom med yengs med rgyun du skyong ba sprang po kho bo'i snying gtam yin// ngo mtshar spro bskyed zab mo'i gdams ngag snying gtam bslab bya mdor bsdus 'di// rang la spangs rtogs yon tan med kyang phan pa'i sems kyis smras lags pas// skal ldan khyod kyi thugs la 'chongs shig blang dor ma nor nyams su longs// 'di yis dge bas mkha' mnyam 'gro kun sangs rgyas sa la myur 'khod shog ces pa 'di dge bshes bkra shis don grub kyi bskul ngor gdams pa'o// dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje gcig bsdus pa// srid gsum 'gran zla kun bral pad+ma 'byung*// khams gsum 'gro la thugs rje brtser dgongs nas// sku gsum go 'phang mchog la 'god du gsol// kye ma ding sang snyigs ma'i mthar thug pas// sangs rgyas bstan yang phyi dro'i nyi ma bzhin// nag phyogs bdud rigs dbyar gyi chu ltar rgyas// dus ngan

18)'di 'dra shar bas skyo shas 'phel// bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen tshul bzung kun// byams dang rnying rje dag snang mos gus dang*// thos bsam sgom dang chos spyod bcu sogs kyis// rang gzhan kha lo chos la mi bsgyur bar// mdo rgyud man ngag shes rgya gzhan las chung*// cung zad shes na khengs pa su las che// chags sdang kun slong phrag dog 'gran sems kyi// rang dang gzhan rgyud rab tu tshig byed cing*// yul ljongs thams cad kun tu myul byas nas// kha gsag g.yo sgyu zol zog du ma yis// blun dad can rnams mgo bo bskor byed cing*/ gtong phod can gyi nor rnams bzang bcom byed// ji tsam rnyed pa'i zang zing de dag kyang*// sbyin dang dkon mchog mchod sogs mi byed par// log pa'i 1$10002201$1000180phyogs rgyar dad zas chud gzon zhing*/ ngan song gnas su rang gzhan khyu ded pa'i// chos min bla gzugs mthong tshe skyo shas 'phel// ngo shes 'dris med phyogs med 19)rgyal khams su// mi med dben pa'i ri khrod 'grim byed cing*// dkar nag log 'tsho'i zas rnams spangs nas su// dka' thub dag la mel tshe bskyal na bsam// dge 'dun sde dang dgon gnas 'dzin rnams kyang*// bstan pa'i gzhir gyur 'dul khrims bag yod dang*// slob gnyer kha bton bzlas pa bsam gtan sogs// 'di phyi'i don gnyer bsgrub la mi brtson par// dam tshig sdom dang thos bsam rgyab tu bskyur// g.yo khram rang mthong 'gran sems dang du len// dman pa 'dzin dang btsun tshugs ring du 'dor// sha chang longs spyod gos rgyan gtso bor 'don// bstan dang phyi ma'i don la mi bsam par// lo 'dod gtam sogs byung na chog par sems// mig gi 'bras ltar bsrung rgyu dam tshig nyid// mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du bor byas nas// bag med spyod pas dus kun 'da' bzhin du// dge sbyong ming 'dzin 20)chos gos du mas brgyan// 'di phyi'i skyabs gnas rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gus pas ci gsungs rjes su mi bsgrub par// ci mdzad dag la log lta skyed byed cing*// gsung gcog thugs dkrug skur 'debs kho na byed// rang la nor rdzas gnang sbyin byung ba'i tshe// bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong byed cing*// rang mi 'dod pa'i tshig gcig gsungs tsam la'ang*// srang mdo'i khyi rganalas kyang log par blta// tshig tsam la'ang 'thab rtsod du ma byed// dkor zas ched du sdig pa gang yang phod// khe grags bsgrub phyir zol zog ci yang shes// tshul min btsun gzugs mthong bas skyo shas 'phel// bstan don yin rgyu'i chos min bya byed kyis// dal 'byor chud zos byed pa 'di spangs nas// dben pa'i gnas su spros med spyod zhugs te// smra bcad 'dag sbyar dag la gnas na bsam// sbyin bdag rnams dang skye bo phal kun kyang*// 21)dam pa rnams dang bslu byed zog po'i rigs// legs par brtags nas bkur bsti'i 'os gyur rnams// 'gyur med dad pas spyi bor mi 'khur bar// kha mkhas g.yo mkhas zol zog la goms pas// ngo bsrung kha lan gtso bor 'don rnams dang*// gnas 'gyu'i sems ngo zhib tu'ang ma shes par// 'khrul zhig rtogs ldan grub thob yin no zhes// mi chos bla ma'i brdzun gyis mngon shes dang*// khrel med tho co byed pa'i zog po la// dad pas sangs rgyas dngos ltar mthong byed cing*// zhabs gtogs longs spyod rgya mtsho med bskyil nas// gces dgu'i nor rdzas ri ltar spung te 'bul/

gang dran byed pa'i spyod la ya mtshan dang*// ci dran zer ba'i gtam la yid ches byed// log lam 'khrid pa de 'dra'i rjes 'brang nas// chos mthun dam pa rnams la brnyas byed cing*// zhabs tog mthun rkyen cung zad sbyar tshe yang*// tshogs gnyis rdzogs dang dge la mi 22)bsam par// zas lan gnang sbyin bzang du byung na bstod// ma byung bla mchod ring du spong byed pa'i// tshul min yon bdag mthong tshe skyo shas 'phel// rgyal bas bsngags pa'i ri khrod nyams dga' bar// gzhan ngo srung ba'i bya byed kun spang nas// srog 'tsho lhag skyobs tsam la gzhi byed cing*// dam chos bsgrub la gcig tu dril na bsam// sbyang yon kun gyi khyad par grags rnams kyang*// sde snod rgyud gzhung bstan bcos gang dang gang*// shes pa de dag ma nor mthar phyin cing*// rang gi rgyud las 'khel bar mi byed par// ji tsam shes bzhin nga rgyal lhag par che// rang nyid ma gtogs gzhan kun dud 'gror mthong*// kho bos yon tan 'di tsam shes so zhes// kus 'debs dar 'phyar dung 'bud byed la mkhas// thos pas 'gag don rgyud thog bkal nas ni// rang gzhan don mchog bsgrub la mi 'bad par// mkhas par grags dang rnyed bkur byung ba 23)na// don gyi snying po de ka yin par rlom// don ma 'byor na tshig gi 'phreng ba la// mkhas kyang mkhas pa'i mtshan nyid mi 'byung te// 'dab chags ne tsos yig drug la sogs pa// smra bar shes mod don du ci zhig rtogs// don med tshig la mkhas pa'i rlom sems can// phrag dog chen pos gzhan yid dkrugs byed pa// sngon byung legs skar gtam rgyud dang mtshungs pa'i// mkhas rlom dregs ldan mthong tshe skyo shas 'phel/ ༄༅/ mi tshe bar snang glog 'dra yud tsam 'dir// zad mtha' med pa'i tshig la sbyangs pa las// chos kun snying po gcig shes kun grol don// bla ma'i gdams ngag gcig thog dril na bsam// zab khrid zhus shing bsgom par rlom rnams kyang*// mtshan ldan nyams myong ldan pa'i bla ma la// sems kyis phu thag legs par chod byas nas// snying rus chen pos nyams su

gang la chags kyang snying po cang 'dug gam// 'chi dus phan pa'i lha chos mi byed na// nor rdzas phyug kyang yi dwags gter bsrung 'dra// rang nyid rang gis bslu ba'i snying med po// 'gyod kyang phyis pa'i dus gcig mi yong ngam/ 41)༈ chu 'brog dang sa zhing 'dzom pa yi// phyi rol gyi yul la phar bltas tshe// bde skyid du 'dzom yang sdod dbang med// bar do ru 'khyams pa'i dus gcig 'ong*// bkrag mdangs dpa' rtsal 'dzoms pa yi// sha khrag gi lus la tshur bltas tshe// 'chi bdag gi bdud kyi bcom nas kyang*// lus sems gnyis bral ba'i dus shig 'ong*// dka' las kyi rtsol sgrub byas pa yi// longs spyod dang nor la phar bltas tshe// sbrang ma yi sbrang rtsi ji bzhin du// rang dbang du med pa'i dus shig 'ong*/ yun ring du 'grogs pa'i grogs rnams dang*// mdza' bshes dang gnyen la phar bltas tshe// dgos dus su mi phan so sor gyes// gcig pu ru 'gro ba'i dus zhig 'ong*// 'dus byas kyi chos la snying po med// mi rtag cing 'gyur ba'i chos nyid de// lha chos gcig snying nas ma byas na// cis byas kyang sdug bsngal 42)kho na'i rgyu// tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs dang*// 'khor sgyur gyi rgyal po thams cad kyang*// 'chi bdag gi bdud kyis zin pa'i tshe// dbang med du 'gro ba ma thos sam// mi lus 'di lan gcig thob gyur cing*// rang dbang nyid rang gis thob dus 'dir// don med du stong log ma byed par// nam zhag gi 'dun ma sgrub re ran// skyes pa'i mtha' de 'chi las 'os med pas// tshe la blo gtad med do shes ldan rnams// pha yul bzang yang bskyur nas 'gro bar nges// yul la zhen pa ma che shes ldan rnams// mkhar khyim legs kyang dri za'i grong khyer 'dra// gtan du 'dug dbang med do shes ldan rnams// sgyu ma'i nor rdzas bsags kyang khyer dbang med// sbyin pa phyogs med thongs dang shes ldan rnams// gces par gsos kyang thal ba'i phung por 'gyur// lus la snying po med do shes ldan rnams// rim gro byas kyang 'chi bdag bdud kyis 'phrog

/tshe la 43)'thud thabs med do shes ldan rnams// sang shi gnangs shi sus kyang mi shes pas// bshom ra'i blo sna ma mang shes ldan rnams// sangs rgyas bstan pa nub kha'i nyi ma 'dra// snyom las sdod long med do shes ldan rnams// mtshan ldan bla ma yid bzhin nor bu la// rtse gcig gsol ba thob dang shes ldan rnams// dam tshig bdud rtsi 'chi gsos sman mchog 'dra// gus pas dang du longs dang shes ldan rnams// da lta mi 'bung 'bung dus nam zhig byed// tshe yi dus tshod zin nam shes ldan rnams// dud ngan khyim thabs skyid pa'i go skabs med// 'khor ba'i zhen pa spongs dang shes ldan rnams// ding sang mi rnams ri 'go'i nyi ma 'dra// su la'ang blo gtad mi thub shes ldan rnams// rang gi 'dun ma rang gis ma sgrub na// gzhan gyis phan par dka' 'o shes ldan rnams// phar la blo gtad chos na tshur la bslu// gzhan zer kha la ma nyan shes ldan rnams// chos phyogs mi 'bungs ci byas don med yin// dal 'byor stong zad ma byed shes ldan rnams// sang byed gnangs byed mi tshe zad 'gyur bas/ 44)/da lta brtson 'grus gyis dang shes ldan rnams// shi dus dgos pa chos las gzhan med pas// grabs bshom thogs med gyis dang shes ldan rnams// dgra 'dul gnyen skyong tshe 'di'i bya byed kun// byas kyang zin pa med do shes ldan rnams// rang gis byas pa'i las 'bras rang la smin// sdig spong dge ba sgrubs shig shes ldan rnams// ser gzugs byas kyang rgyu 'bras mi 'dzem rnams// bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren yin no shes ldan rnams// kha chos mkhas kyang rang rgyud ma thul na// chos pa'i phung 'dre yin no shes ldan rnams// rgyu 'bras shes rung khyad du gsod byed na// de las lod pa med do shes ldan rnams// ding sang skya ser thams cad chags sdang che// skyo shas gting nas skye'o shes ldan rnams// phan par smras pa'i tshig la nyan mkhan dkon// de bas yig drug grongs dang shes ldan rnams// bla ma ma gtogs re sa gang yang med// gsol ba snying nas thob dang shes ldan rnams// dam chos ma gtogs gang yang snying po med// blo na chos la dril dang shes ldan rnams// blo thag rang gis ma bcad 'grub

45)dus med// the tshom rbad kyi chod dang shes ldan rnams// ngan song sdug bsngal bzod pa'i go skabs med// lam sna da lta 'tshol cig shes sdan rnams// bla gzugs mang yang mtshan ldan shin tu dkon// skyabs gnas legs par 'tshol gcig shes ldan rnams// skyes bu dam pa su yin mi shes pas// gzhan la skur pa ma 'debs shes ldan rnams// 'gro kun pha mar ma gyur gcig kyang med// ngan long snying rjes skyongs shig shes ldan rnams// phyi ma'i lam rgyags da lta bsgrub dgos pas// nor rdzas mchod sbyin gyis dang shes ldan rnams// lab lab mang pos ngag sgrib bsog pa'i rgyu// gsol 'debs yig drug thon cig shes ldan rnams// gzhan skyon mthong yang rang skyon mi tshor bas// nga rgyal rang mthong spongs shig shes ldan rnams// rang snang dag na sangs rgyas thams cad dngos// dag snang phyogs med gyis shig shes ldan rnams// chos mthun bslab bya zab mo'i gdams ngag yin// ma brjed yid la zhog cig shes ldan rnams// e ma mdang gsum rmi lam 46)dang*// khyad par rdul tsam ma mchis te// thams cad 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin nyid// 'jig rten sgyu ma'i bslu brid la// a 'thas zhen chags byed pa kun// byis pa nam mkha'i rang bzhin la// zhan dang khyad par ma mchis pas// da lta'i mi rnams phal cher kun// do nub 'chi'am cha med kyang*// lo brgya'i bar du bsdod rtsis kyis// 'khor ba'i bshom ra mang po byed// dgos ngo shes pa'i lha chos de// khoms na byed cing mi khoms 'jog /dgos med 'jig rten bya byed rnams// rtag tu khoms rung ma khoms rung*// snying rus byas nas 'bad pa 'di// 'khrul tshabs de las che ba med// nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe// lus ni me tog sad khyer 'dra// 'jig rten bar do'i 'phrang ring la// rang dbang med par 'khyams dus su// sdig can 'gyod pa'i dus gcig 'ong*// de tshe 'gyod

47)kyang bya thabs med// las kyi rlung gis ded byas shing*// rngam zhing 'jigs pa'i las mkhan gyis// dmyal ba'i gnas su 'khrid pa'i tshe// bu dang nor gyis ci la phan// gshin rje'i tshogs pa'i khrims ra na// las kyi me long bstan pa'i tshe// dge sdig sa ler mthong tsa na// zol zog rdzun gyis ga la thub// rang byas las kyi rnam smin gyis// dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong dus su// yul dang 'khor 'bangs longs spyod kyis// de tshe phan pa ga la yod// da lta rang dbang yod dus 'dir// dge ba'i las la mi 'bad par// shul du kha chem 'jog pa kun// rang gis rang bslu ma yin nam// mi tshe skad cig yud tsam la// gtan gyi bdun ma mi bsgrub par// 'jig rten bya bas g.yeng byed pa// phung la de bas che ba med// bla ma sangs rgyas mjal dus 'dir// dad pa rtse gcig mi byed 48)par// skur 'debs log lta byed pa rnams// sdig la de bas che ba med// dal 'byor lan gcig thob dus 'dir// dkar po dge ba mi bsgrub par// sdig la mel tshe skyel ba kun// gros la de las nyes pa med// tshe la long med dus 'di la// nyin mo kha g.yeng mig yengs dang*// mtshan mo gnyid la bskyal byed pa// nor tshabs de las che ba med// rang mgo rang gis 'don dus 'dir// dkar po dge ba mi bsgrub par// sdig la mel tshe skyel ba kun// gros la de las nyes pa med// 'gyod med grabs su mi byed par// mi tshe stong zad byed pa kun// gyong la de bas che ba med// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// lan cig skyes pa'i mtha' ma de// 'chi ba ma gtogs 'gro sa med// de tshe phan pa chos las med// 'dus byas chos la snying po med// 'khor ba'i chos la zin pa med// ji tsam yod kyang chog shes med// 'dod pa'i blo la gang dus med// bsags kyang shi dus khyer thabs 49)med// ngan song sdug bsngal bzod glag med// bla ma ma gtogs re sa med// snyigs dus tshe la long glag med// de ring 'chi'am nges pa med// shi khar 'gyod kyang phan pa med// lam mchog chos la lhag pa med// lam sna da lta zin par mdzod// rnyed par dka' zhing 'jigs par sla ba'i lus// chu bur 'dra ba 'di nyid 'tsho ba'i phyir// zas skom gos kyis rgyun du bskyangs byas na'ang*// shi tshe ro zhes dur khrod 'dor bar byed// dka' ba du mas rab tu 'bad byed cing*// lus srog blo yis btang nas btsal ba'i nor// 'chi dus shul du lus lugs 'di mthong tshe// snying po spu tsam gang la'ang mi 'dug go// sha khrag 'brel ba'i gnyen dang bu sring sogs// sha tsha snying nas byas te bskyangs na yang*// mgu ba'i dus med mtha' ma dgra ru ldang*// blo gtad thub pa gang la'ang mi snang ngo// tshe 'di'i

50)bya ba blo yis btang byas nas// mi med ri khrod 'grim gcig ma nus na// gang la bltas kyang snying po ci yang med// blo sna gcig thog dril ba mi 'thad dam// sha tsha snying gtam bslab bya 'di rnams kyi// tshig don yid la bsam dang dad ldan rnams// phan pa'i gdams ngag yin no snying la 'chong*// dge bas 'gro kun thar lam 'dren par shog

ces rang gzhan gyi blo sna chos la bsgyur phyir smin grol bskyed rdzogs gling du smras pa'o// ༈ kong rong shing lo'i tshal gyi char gnas pa'i// kho bo sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i bsam yul du// go don 'di lta bu zhig byung ba'i tshul// ngo mtshar ya mtshan med kyang cung zad zhu// ca co brag cha lta bu'i ngag 'di yi// cha med brjun gyi gtam gyis mi mgo bskor// ja chang longs spyod 'du long gtso bor ston// nya mo mgo skor tsam zhig yin par go// ta thā ga ta'i bstan la rab byung zhing*// tha dad 51) grub mtha'i tshig la sbyangs byas kyang*// da dung chos dang rang rgyud ma 'dres rnams// na tshod rgas kyang bsam med yin par go// pu ti mang po'i slob gnyer byas byas kyang*// phu thag sgro 'dogs sems la ma chod na// ba tshā smig rgyu'i chu la zhen pa ltar// mu med tshig la 'byams na phung bar go// tsa thig rlung sems gnad rnams ma shes shing*// tsha grang bkres skom lam khyer mi nus par// dza lang tho co byed pa'i rtogs ldan rnams// wa sogs dud 'gro las kyang lod par go// zha lar sran ma chags 'dra'i mi lus 'di// zag med 'od phung bsgrub la mi brtson na// 'ar re 'ur re'i ngang du mi tshe zad*// yang yang longs spyod thob pa dka' bar go// rang rig gsal stong rang ngo ma shes na// lang tsho rgyas kyang nam 'chi nges pa med// shangs kyi zab bu lung sogs gnas chen du// sangs rgyas 52)bsgrub la brtson pa dgos par go// ha la'i dug 'dra'i 'khor ba spangs byas nas// a ti rdzogs chen bsgom la brtson pa na// 'di phyir skyid pa'i 'dun ma dam pa dang*// rang gzhan don gyi mthar thug yin par go// yi ge sum cu'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di// chos med snyom las legs sgrub ming can gyis// smin grol bskyed rdzogs gling du bris pa 'di'i// dge bas 'gro kun yid kyi mun sel shog/

༈ phyogs dus kyi rgyal ba gcig bsdus pa'i// khams gsum gyi skyabs mchog pad+ma 'byung*// mos gus dang ldan pas gsol 'debs na// rgyun ldan du thugs rjes bzung du gsol// dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob dus 'dir// don med du stong zad ma gtang bar// rang dbang nyid rang gi thob dus 'dir// sangs rgyas zhig bsgrub par mi 'thad dam// na gzhon gyi dus su g.yeng bas 'khyer/ 53)/rgan khog gi dbang po 'grib cing gud// byed 'dod kyi ngang la mi tshe 'das// dam chos la chig dril mi 'thad dam// mdo rgyud dang man ngag bstan bcos sogs// chos sgo la grangs las 'das mod kyang*// dgos dus su phan par dka' bas na// gdams ngag gi snying po mi 'tshol lam// shes shes kyi rnam grangs mang po dang*// gzhung lugs kyi bshad pa mkhas gyur kyang*// 'chi dus su bshad pas mi mkho bas// nyams len la brtson pas 'bad pa 'thad// snying gtam gyi bslab bya tshig gsum 'di// shes 'dod dang grags 'dod ma yin te// gzhan rgyud la phan dang rang nyid la// gsal 'debs su smras pa'i dge ba des// 'gro kun kyang 'di bzhin spyod par shog/ ༈ dpal thod phreng rtsal dang dbyer med pa'i// skyabs mchog tu gyur pa bla mar 'dud// bdag thos bsam sbyangs pa dman gyur kyang*// rje mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' drin 54)gyis// chos theg pa'i yangs rtse rdzogs chen don// 'di rtogs pas gu yang blo sems bde// khong sgom la nyams len byed mkhan 'ga'// don ka dag blo 'das chos sku la// slar yid dpyod 'dzin pas bcings ba yi// sems bcos ma zhig la sgom du re// de yang dag bsgom dus ngas ma mthong*// gzhi bde bshegs snying po ka dag de// sems blo bur dri mas bsgribs pa las// rje bla mas rang rig rang ngo sprod// don ka dag chos sku cer gyi mthong*// de ma yengs tsam du skyong ba las// sgom dmigs gtad byed rgyu ci zhig yod// sgom med la yengs med rol pa 'di// rdzogs chen gyi nyams len ma yin nam// yid dpyod dang bral ba'i lta ba la// yongs 'dzin dang bral ba'i sgom pas brgyan// dgag sgrub bral bar spyod pa yi// re dogs dang bral ba'i 'bras bu thob// thob shor du btags pa ming dang tshig

/ming tshig kyang blo yis 55)bcos ma ste// ma bcos pa'i rang sems rig stong 'di// rang babs su zhog cig rnal 'byor pa// a la la mtshan ldan bla ma'i drin// da dung thugs rjes bzung du gsol// rje bla ma sangs rgyas kun las lhag /yid rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba thob// las rgyu 'bras slu med yid la soms// don blang dor gyis shig rigs kyi bu// chos gsang sngags zab don bskyed rdzogs gnyis// tshul bzhin du spyod cig skal ldan pa// tshe mi rtag nam 'chi'i nges pa med// chos long med bsgrub shig bya bral ba// dus da lta rang dbang yod dus 'dir// lam byang chub bsgrub shig rnal 'byor pa// chos theg pa'i yang rtse rdzogs pa che// don blo 'das skyongs shig rnal 'byor pa// tshe 'dir snang 'dun ma yad yud 'di// phugs snying pos dben pa'i grogs po dag /dus ding sang rang mgo ma sgrim na// bdud bslu brid mang ngo shes ldan rnams// blo rtse gcig 56)bla mar ma gtad na// gzhan phan par dka'a'o skyes bu kun// tshig 'di dag yid la 'char ba na// don zab chos yin no dad ldan rnams// dge 'di dang dus gsum bsags pa'i mthus// ma khams gsum 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog /ces pa'i le mtshan gong 'og gsum po 'di rnams ni lho phyogs mon gyi yul phyogs su snga 'gyur 'od gsal snying po'i bstan pa gsal bar byed pa'i chos kyi rje rin po che pad+ma dkon mchog gi zhal snga nas bzhed pa ltar bkod pa'o/ gros 'debs snyan pa'i rol dbyangs bdud rtsi'i char zim zhes bya ba// srid zhi ma lus pa'i 'dren pa gcig pu par gyur pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ kye ma/ dal 'byor mi lus ni phun sum tshogs pa thob// rnam rig blo gros ni gza' skar las kyang bkra// dbang po sgo lnga ni shel sgong las kyang dwangs// dpal 'byor bsod nams kyi dpag bsam lo 'dab rgyas// mnga' thang longs spyod kyi 'bras bu yongs su smin// 'di

57)'dra'i gnas skabs ni yang yang 'dzoms par dka'// legs nyes spang blang ni da lta bsam dgos pas// legs par soms mdzod dang mi dbang rnam par rgyal/ kye ma/ sangs rgyas bstan pa ni mkha' ltar rgya re che// bstan 'dzin skyes bu ni nyi bzhin kun la khyab// theg pa'i 'jug sgo ni skar tshogs las kyang mang*// zab mo'i dam chos ni rnying ma'i bka' gter phyug /spros bral phyag chen ni dwags po bka' rgyud mkhas// dka' spyad snying rus ni dpal ldan 'brug pa che// snying rje byang sems ni bka' gdams slob rgyud bzang*// gzhung lugs bshad srol ni sa skya 'gran zla blal// nyan thos 'dul khrims ni dge ldan slob rgyud brtson// rkyen ngan lam khyer ni zhi byed chos kyis byed// rnam rtog dngos 'dzin ni gcod yul zab mos 'joms// dus 'khor sbyor drug ni jo nang chos lugs mkhas// 58)e ma de sogs kyi chos lugs mtha' yas kun// rgyal ba thabs mkhas kyis gang 'dul gsungs pa'i phyir// mthar thug 'bras bu ni sangs rgyas thob pa gcig /dag snang phyogs med gcig kun la ma 'byongs na// grub mtha'i kha 'dzin gyis sdig chen bsog pa'i rgyu// de ltar soms mdzod dang mi dbang rnam par rgyal/ kye ma/ lha chos sha stag cig byed pa ma byung na// 'jig rten chos lugs dang mthun pa'i ngang nyid nas// dge sdig blang dor gyi gnas la brtson byas pas// thar lam zin pa zhig da res ma 'bad na// lus 'di mi rtag pa me tog sad khyer 'dra// nor rdzas mi rtag pa sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi 'dra// grogs 'khor mi rtag pa tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra// kun kyang mi rtag ste mdangs kyi rmi lam 'dra// sang 'chi gnangs 'chi yang nges pa med pas na// dam chos ma gtogs pa cis kyang phan par dka'// grab bshom thogs med gcig da lta ma byas na// shi kha 'gyod pas ni phan pa cis kyang med// thugs la zhog mdzod dang mi dbang rnam par rgyal/

kye ma/ da lta dal 'byor dang mi lus thob dus 'dir// gtan gyi bdun ma zhig 'grub par ma byas tshe// 'khor ba gar skyes kun sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin// me stag tsam la yang bag zon byed lugs la// dmyal ba tsha grang gi sdug bsngal ga la bzod// nyin gcig bkres skom kyang bzod par mi nus na// yi dwags bkres skom rnams sems kyis bzod dam ci// 'khur po lji ba gcig 'khur ba'i sdug bsngal la// dud 'gro bkol spyod sdug bsngal e bzod soms// da lta tsher ma zhig zug pa'i zug rngu la// lha min 'thab rtsod kyi mtshon char ci phyir bzod// thag ring zhag 'ga' zhig 'gro ba'i sems khral la// 'chi 'pho ltung byed kyi sdug bsngal ga la bzod// e 60)ma 'khor ba 'di 'dra'i rang bzhin la// cis kyang da len nas lam sna ma zin na// zo chu'i 'khyud mo ltar mtha' med 'khor 'gyur bas// de ltar mkhyen mdzod dang mi dbang rnam par rgyal/ kye ma/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar byed pha rol phyin// dge ba bcu sogs dang chos spyod rnam pa bcu// 'di dag thar lam gyi shing rta chen po ste// 'bad pas bsgrub pa na mngon mtho'i dam pa 'grub// sbyin pa 'dod 'byung gi bang mdzod bzang po 'dra// tshul khrims cang shes kyi rta mchog rin chen 'dra// mtho ris thar lam gyi zhing du bsgrod par byed// bzod pa 'jigs med kyi go cha bzang po 'dra// gzhan rkyen gnaud pa las skyob pa'i dam pa'o// brtson 'grus g.yul bzlog gi dpa' bo mthu ldan 'dra// le lo rnam g.yeng gi dmag dpung bzlog par byed// bsam gtan yul mkhar gyi btsan rdzong bzang po 'dra// 61)nyon mongs dgra kun gyi 'tshe ba bral bar byed// shes rab rno dbal gyi ral gri ngar ldan 'dra// the tshom log rtog gi drwa ba gcod par byed// pha rol phyin drug gi lam bzang dam pa la// rtag tu brtson mdzod mi dbang rnam par rgyal// srog bcod spong ba ni 'chi med 'chi ba'i 'jigs las skyob sman mchog 'dra// ma sbyin len spong ni

longs spyod zad mi shes pa thob par 'gyur/ ma rmos lo thog 'dra// log g.yem spong ba kun gyi spyi bor 'khur ni rgyal sras thu bo 'dra// brjun tshig spong ba 'gyur ba med pas bzang*/ sa le sbram dang 'dra// phra ma spong ba ni thams cad kyi byams par 'gyur/ 'gro kun pha ma 'dra// tshig rtsub spong ba ni kun gyis yid du 'ong*/ rma bya gzhon nu 'dra// ngag 'khyal spong ba ni 'khor los bsgyur gzhan la ci smras nyan rgyal 'dra// brnab sems spong ba nirdzogs ldan sems can yid la gang bsam 'grub 'dra// gnod sems spong ba lha yi rtag tu bde skyid dang ldan/ 62)dbang po 'dra// log lta spong ba ni ngan par mi 'gro zhing rtag tu legs / rin chen gser zhun 'dra// dge ba'i las bcu 'di yid bzhin nor bu 'dra// rtag par 'bral med du rgyud la bsten par mdzod// gzhan yang chos spyod kyi rnam grangs bcu rnams ni// rgyal ba sras bcas kyi gshegs shul dam pa ste// yi ge 'bri ba dang mchod dang sbyin pa dang*// dam chos nyan pa dang klog dang 'dzin pa dang*// gzhan la 'chad pa dang kha ton don sems pa// ting 'dzin bsgom pa sde chos spyod rnam pa bcu// blo gros pad tshal gyi 'dab stong rgyas byed pa'i// ma rig mun sel gyi nyi ma'i snying po 'dra// legs par rtogs mdzod dang mi dbang rnam par rgyal// don gyi snying po ru hril gyi dril ba na// ya rab gong ma bkur sti che ba dang*// ngan longs 'bangs 'khor skyong bran mkhas pa dang*// rang gzhan thams cad kun dge ba'i lam la 'god// ya rabs 63)mi chen gyi spyod pa mthar thug yin// shes bya'i gnas kun la blo mig yangs pa dang*// bla ma dkon mchog la dad pa che ba dang*// rgyu 'bras blang dor la zhib tu 'bad pa ste// shes rab blo ldan gyi mtshan nyid mthar thug yin// legs nyes bya byed kun legs par gzhig pa dang*// mnga' thang stobs rtsal la rang tshod zin pa dang*// nor rdzas longs spyod kun dge phyogs spung ba ste// mi dbang rje dpon gyi 'dun ma'i mthar thug yin// chos kyi rang rgyud la phan par ma nus na// ser gzugs byas pa la dgos pa ci yang med// chos med btsun gzugs kyis rang gzhan bslu ba las// khyim pa byang sems nyid mchog tu khyad par 'phags// de ltar dgongs mdzod dang mi dbang rnam par rgyal//

nges pa'i don gyi snying po ma rtogs na// ci ltar byas kyang kun rdzob 'khrul ba'i ngang*/ kye ma/ sems kyi ngo bo stong pa nam mkha' 'dra// nam mkha' nyid la dngos po ngos 'dzin med// med ces chad lta cang med ma yin pas// rig stong nam mkha' las kyang khyad par 'phags/ kye ma/ sems kyi gsal cha nyi ma'i snying po 'dra// de yang ngos bzung mtshan bcas nyid ma yin// mthong dang reg dang reg bya can gyi nyi 'od las// khyad par 'phags shing gsal la 'dzin med nyid/ kye ma/ sems kyi 'gyu cha rlung dang 'dra ba yang*// khang khyim sogs kyis sgrib par nus pa yi// mtshan ma'i 'gro 'ong can de ma yin pas// de phyir 'dra la mi 'dra'i khyad par 'phags// kye ma yod med rtag chad 'gro dang 'ong ba sogs// kun btags du mas 69)sems kyi 'tshang mi rnyed// thag brgya'i mdud pa gcig gis 'khrol ba ltar// ma bcos klong yangs rtogs na gu re yangs/ kye ma/ ding sang chen por grags pa'i bshes gnyen 'ga'// lta sgom spyod la rtsod pa'i gzhi byed kyang*// rang gzhan phyogs cha khas len dgag sgrub kyi// lta sgom spyod pas grol ba thob bam ci/ kye ma/ mtho dang dma' bar gleng ba'i lta ba de// nam mkha'i thongs la sbar tshod byed pa 'dra// rig pa dri med gcer mthong ma shes na// lta ba mthong zhes dpag tshad ji ltar gzhal/ kye ma/ sgom pa shes dang mi shes brtan mi brtan// sna tshogs brjod kyang 'ja' tshon 'dzin 'dod 'dra// yang dag don la sgom rgyu'i dmigs gtad gang*// rig pa rang so zin na de ka rang*/ kye ma/ spyod pa'i bye brag blang dor bsam 'das kyang*// 70)yang dag don shes spyod pa rtsis gdab bral// nyams rtogs rang gdangs spyod par shar ba la// rung dang mi rung 'dzin pa'i brtod phur bu/ kye ma/ 'bras bu thob tu re bas byas byas kyang*// byas chos 'dus byas zad cing 'gyur ba'i rgyu// 'dus byas bsgrubs pas 'dus ma byas thob bam// de phyir re dogs yod na 'bras bu min/

kye ma/ spros med blo 'das byar med la sogs pa// lta ba'i phyogs su spyod pa 'brangs pa na// myong med kha ltas ru ṭar gol ba la// bden pa gnyis ldan don la spyod par 'tshal/ kye ma/ don gyi snying po hril gyi dril ba ni// phyogs su ma lhung lta ba'i yang rtse la// sgom med yengs med sgom gyi gnad 'gag nyid// dus tshod shes pa spyod pa'i rgyal po lags/ kye ma/ 'khrul med lam 'di rtag tu bsten pa na// 71)thob shor med pa'i 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur// re dogs med pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid la// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i dpal 'byor thob/ kye ma/ da ni thub pa'i bstan pa'ang mtha' la thug /bshes gnyen dam pa rnams kyang zhing gzhan bshegs// nags phyogs bdud rigs rnams ni mthu rtsal rgyas// gang la bsam kyang skyo shas 'phel ba'i rgyu/ kye ma/ snyigs dus kyi mi tshe yud tsam de nyid la// shes shes khe grags bsgrub tu mi khom pas// nyams len snying po'i don la dril nas kyang*// gtan gyi bdun ma bsgrub la shin tu ran/ kye ma/ sbyor dngos rjes kyi dge sbyor gzhung bsrang nas// snyom las le lo med par ma 'bad na// yin yin mang la blo gtad mi khel ba'i// chos des rang gzhan gang la'ang phan par dka'/ kye ma/ 72)mi rtag skyo shas las 'bras bsam byas nas// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya maṇ+ḍal dang// bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol 'debs dbang bzhi blangs// chos spyi'i sngon 'gro yin pas gnad bsnun ces/ kye ma/ bar du chos spyod gtor ma phyi nang dang*// yi dam bsnyen bsgrub bzlas brjod rdzogs rim la// yengs med brtson zhing de yang chos brgyad sogs// gnad du mi 'gro'i skyon dang ma 'dres gces/ kye ma/ dge sbyor gang byed kun gyi mjug tu yang*// spros med bsngo ba stong nyid don la blta// de ltar ma rtogs 'khrul ba'i 'gro rnams la// snying rjes kun slangs smon lam rgya cher gdab/

kye ma/ sbyor dngos rjes kyi nyams len khrid rim 'di// rig 'dzin grub thob rnams kyi gzhung lam nyid// snying gtam gdams ngag lhug par smras pa lags// rtse gcig nyams su longs dang don chen 'grub/ kye ma/ 'di ltar gdams pa'i 73)dge bas 'gro ba kun// don med 'khor ba'i bya ba ring dor nas// don gnyis lhun grub gdod ma'i gtan srid zin// khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stongs bar shog

/ces ṛg pa 'dzin pa tshul khrims bzang po la nyams len gyi bogs don du gdams pa'o// ༈ gdod nas ma bcos 'od gsal snying po'i don// rang rig chos kyi sku la rab btud nas// skal ldan khyod kyi ji ltar dris pa'i lan// cung zad bshad kyi thugs la dgongs par mdzod// bde bshegs snying po rang rig chos kyi sku// kun la yod kyang shes pa shin tu dkon// bla ma'i gdam pa mchog gi ma zin na// dbul po'i khyim kyi rin chen gter dang mtshungs// de la lta sgom spyod 'bras mang bshad kyang*// gnad don yin lugs cung zad bsdus pa ni// blta bya'i yul dang lta mkhan rig pa gnyis// dbyer med gcig pa de ka lta ba dngos// de don tshul bzhin rtogs pa'i don de nyid// ma bcos rang babs dran pas skyong ba la// sgom pa zhes bya ming du btags pa lags// gang 84)shar sems de mi sgom yengs par// rgyun ldan spyod lam kun tu 'khyer ba la// spyod pa'i ming du btags pa de ka lags// de don mngon du gyur pa'i mthar thug tshe// 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob ces de la zer// hril gyis dril na da lta'i tha mal sems// bzang ngan 'phro gnas 'gyu dran ci shar ba// de ka'i ngo bor rig pas ngos 'dzin na// sgom gyi mchog gyur de nyid gcig pus chog /e ma skyes mchog rnal 'byor pa// sems kyi 'gyu rtog sna tshogs la// rjes 'brang brtag dpyad byas na yang*// bung bas nam mkha'i mtha' 'tshol 'dra// rang sems ji ltar shar yang rung*// shar mkhan de ka stong pa nyid// stong pa nyid de gdod ma nas// lhun gyis grub pa'i chos nyid lags// rnam rtog ji tsam 'phro yang legs// 'phro mkhan ngo bo rtsad bcad na// thams cad chos sku'i rol rtsal las// ma dag blang dor bya rgyus dben// sems rig 85)'char snang sna tshogs kyang*// thams cad rig pa'i rtsal mdangs nyid// dgag bsgrub re dogs byed don chung*// rang ngo rig na de kas chog

/bde sdug tshogs drug chags sdang rnams// shar yang rig pas zin thog glod// ma shar na yang gang gar bskyur// yengs pa med pa gnad kyi mchog// mnar med dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal dang*// dpag med zhing khams bde skyid kun// rang sems snang tshul kho na las// rdul tsam med par rgyal bas gsungs// sangs rgyas go 'phang mthar thug la'ang*// re dogs byas na 'ching ba'i rgyu// gang byung bla ma'i thugs rje'i las// blo gtad gzhan du byed don chung*// e ma da dung rang sems la// yengs 'dzin med par glod pa dang*// 'gro kun pha ma'i rang bzhin la// stong nyid snyingarje'i zung 'jug dang*// dge sbyor yengs med skyong ba mkhyen// de ltar gdams pa la brten nas// 86)nyams rtogs gong du 'phel bar shog /ces pa 'di yang bstan 'dzin mthar phyin gyi lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi gnad 'gag gi tshig 'ga' zhig dris ba'i lan du sbyin pa'o// ༈ e ma dad ldan rnal 'byor pa// byang chub lam bzang bsgrub 'dod na// theg pa'i mthar thug snying po'i don// dam chos rdzogs chen sgom par zhu// snyigs dus longs med mi tshe thung*// yud tsam 'di la rtse gcig tu// zab don snying po mi len na// thos thos shes bya grangs mang kyang*// 1$10002201$1000180dgos dus phan par dka' mor mchis// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi sgo// mtha' dag gcig bsdus gsal stong don// rig pa byang chub sems sangs rgyas// ma rtogs tshig tshogs brgya yod kyang*// 'bras bu'i dam pa gzhan na med// bla ma yid bzhin nor bu rnyed// gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i char rgyun thob// dal 'byor snying po len dus 'dir// 'jig rten sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor spongs// da lta rang dbang yod 87)dus 'dir// gtan gyi bdun ma 'chugs pas na// rnyed dka'i dal 'byor rin chen 'di// stong zad 'gro ba a re phangs// de phyir tshe lhag gang thub 'dir// sgrub la gcig tu dril ba dang*// sgom med yengs 'dzin bral ba'i don// rang babs rang rig skyong bar zhu// de skad lhag bsam dge ba yis// khyed la snying gtam smras pa'i dges// mar 'gyur 'gro ba'i khams thams cad// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob gyur cig

thos bsam dang bslab shes yon tan 'dis/ 136)/rang rgyud skam rengs su gtang ba mang*// kun nyon mongs kyi gnyen por 'gyur thabs zhig /gting dam pa nas mdzod dang snying gtam lags// snyan grags dang gdul bya'i 'du long la// ming 'gro don du btags pa'i nor sdud dang*// dam med g.yo can tshogs pa'i grwa 'khor sogs// bla ma'i sku tshe bstung ba'i dug chen lags// 'chi ba snying dran gyi nges 'byung dang*// cis kyang dgos med kyi zhen log dang*// ci mdzad legs mthong gi mos gus sogs// zhe thag par bskyed mdzod snying gtam lags// sdom dam tshig la rang sems dpang gtsug dang*// chos nyams len la rang rgyud 'thul nus dang*// gzhan 'gro phan la rang 'dod 'khris med rnams// dgos nges kyang dkon par gzigs lags sam// chos thob kyang nyams su mi len dang*// gzhan la 'chad kyang rang ma smin// mtsho 'gram du skom grir shi 137)ba'am// sman pa rang nad kyis 'chi dang mtshungs/ rang don btsan sa zin pa'i tshe// gzhan don ma 'bad lhun gyis grub// dus ding sang gi gzhan don phal mo che// long bas long khrid du gda' lags mod// lam bskyed rim la brda don rtags gsum gyi// gnad tshul bzhin shes pa'i nyams len dgos/ a 'thas kyi bskyed bzlas ci 'bad kyang*// dngos grub 'byung ba'i re thag chod// chos phyag rdzogs dbu ma zhi byed sogs// rnam grangs kyi bre brag bsam 'das kyang*// ma bcos rang rig chos sku dngos// rjen par mthong mkhan dkon par zad// sems 'gyu ba bkag pa'i sdug btsir dang*// rnam rtog rjes 'brang gi 'khrul blo dang*// sgom byed do snyam pa'i blos byas sogs// kun byang chub kyi rgyu ru ga la 'gro// lta ba mtho 'dod ngar 'dzin yin// sgom 138)pa bzang 'dod bcos ma nyid// 'bras bu thob 'dod re dogs te// de thams cad 'dod blo'i bdud kyi zin// bdud rang sems kyi phugs su bcangs byas nas// phyi bsrung 'khor bgegs bskrad 'dre 'dul gyi// thabs rten 'brel 'bum phrag byas na yang*// gegs bar chad bzlog par ci la 'gyur// lar 'khor 'das dgra gnyen nad gdon dang*// skyid sdug sogs bag chags 'khrul snang tsam// 'di bden par mi bzung khyad mi gsad// sems rtsal mdangs su shes na gzhan ci dgos// phyi snang grags lha sngags phung khams kun// ye gdod nas dkyil 'khor chen por 'grub// de ma rtogs 'khrul ngo'i snang ba 'dir// zhen 'dzin grol na dbang bzhi thob// mgo rdol rdol du dbang bskur zhus byas shing*// rna ba tsha tshar chos nyan kyang*// rang snang log pa'i sol gdong de/

dngul shugs kyang dkar po 'gyur bar dka'// tshe bskal par thos bsam sgom sgrub la/ 139)/'bad rlom kyang rang rig gnas lugs gshis// 'di ji bzhin ma rtogs thabs gzhan gang*// ci 'bungs kyang byang chub thob par dka'// gnad bla ma'i gdams ngag byin rlabs bcud// des gser 'gyur rtsi thob bzhin du grol/ ༈ kyai/ mang du brjod kyang tshig la zad pa med// gnad don snying por bskyed rdzogs dbyer med du// ma yengs mi sgom tshogs drug lhug par zhog /sangs rgyas nye lam thabs gnad 'di ka zab// bla ma sangs rgyas thag chod gsol ba gdab// 'gro kun pha mar shes pa'i byams brtse bskyed// cir snang sems su rtogs pas lam khyer bya// rgyu 'bras khyad du mi gsad dge ba bsgrubs// 'di skyid zhen 'dzin mi bya thugs rjer bsam// sdug bsngal skyon du mi lta sgrib pa sbyong*// rnam rtog bkag pas mi khegs rang ngo ltos// nyams la brlom sems mi bya rang babs glod// nyams len res 'jog mi bya rgyun 140)'thud 'bungs// 'bras bu thob rings mi 'gos sgrub snyugs sring*// 'brel tshad dge la 'khod pa'i smon lam thob// nyams len snying por dril dang don mchog 'grub// bdag 'dra'i snying gtam yin no thugs la bstim// dngos su mjal yang bshad rgyu de bas med// byang chub bar du mi 'bral smon lam 'tshal// 'di ltar gdams pa'i dge des 'gro phan shog ces khams kaḥthog pa bla ma bkra shis blo gros pos bskul ngor gdams pa'o// ༈ kye ma/ lus dal 'byor gyi ljon pa legs byas kyang*// rkyen blo bur gyi dgra mgo mang la rgod// 'chi ba thogs babs su byung na 'gyod med kyi// gdengs chen grabs chud mdzod dang snying gtam lags// 'phral skyid 'dod kyi lto dgos rtsol sgrub kyi// phug dgos nges kyi lha chos phyi bshol lus// bar do'i 'phrang ring la 'gro tshe gtan rgyags su// bla ma'i gdams ngag sgoms dang snying gtam lags// tshe 'dir snang

141)la mdzes pa'i chos brgyad dang*// mi thams cad dga' ba'i zang zing gis/ rang blo bcol chung gi kha lo bsgyur nyan che// zhen log gting nas bskyed mdzod= /tshig kha bshad rgya che'i thos pa dang*// 'phral shes shes rnam grangs mang po kun// dge sbyor rlung tshubs la bkur ba'i nyer len yin// spros med chag dril gyis dang snying= /rje bla ma'i drung du sdod tsa na// yid 'gyur med mos gus mi byed par// ci mdzad log lta ru mthong ba'i grwa slob mang*// dad pa'i snying phur tshugs dang snying gtam= /grogs mang po'i dbus na rang 'dod kyi// blo nga rgyal mgo 'phang thon po yis// mcheng lcam dam sel gyi thal bas ma byugs par// dman sa rtag tu bzung mdzod snying gtam lags// khong yon bdag gi go sar 'grim dus su// rgyu nor rdzas 'dod pa'i zong rin du// zol zog rdzun khram gyis 142)mi mgo ma bslu bar// rang sems drang por srong ba snying= /gnas dben pa'i ri khrod 'grim na yang*// sems yengs med dran rig ma ldan na// phyi ba spang phugs su nyal 'dras dgos pa med// gar 'dug dge sbyor 'bungs mdzod snying= /chos rang sems kyi thog tu ma khel na// ming chos par btags kyang skye bo rang*// lus chas ji ltar du bsgyur kyang 'jig rten pa/ blo rgyud nang nas 'thul cig snying= /sems gang shar gyis rang ngo ma shes na// sgom blos byas kyi lhan pa ci btab kyang*// gnas lugs chos nyid kyi gting mtha' mi rtogs pas// gang shar lam du lhongs mdzod snying gtam= /don stong nyid gnyug mar thag chod kyang*// las rgyu 'bras khyad du ma gsad par// spros bcas spros med kyi nyams len zung 'jug gis// mkha' mnyam sems can don mdzod snying= /snying gtam bcu gcig gdams ngag 143)'di// lhun grub ye shes 'gyur med la// mi rgan sna tshogs rang grol gyis// gdams so thugs la legs par 'chongs// dge des 'gro phan mtha' yas shog

༈ rje rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs mchog /pha mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs pad la// yid dad brgya'i 'dus pas phyag bgyid na// mthu mkhyen brtse'i gzigs pa g.yel med stsol// rig grol gyi yon tan phun tshogs pa'i// yongs 'dzin gyi bshes gnyen rdo rje 'dzin// mtshan grags pa 'gyur med 'chang ba gang*// gnad zab mo'i snying gtam bskur zhig gsung*// khyed thos bsam sgom la mnga' dbang phyug /bdag rmongs pa'i tshig la mi ltos kyang*// bka' phebs sgo bzlog par mi rigs phyir// gtam cal col 'ga' zhig gsol bgyid na/ ༈ kye ma thub bstan gyi nyi ma nub rir gzhol// rtsod ldan gyi yang mtha'i dus 'di 'drar/ 144)/dal 'byor dang rnam g.yengs rjes pa na// 'chi dus lag stong 'gro bar nges// shi nas kyang khams gsum rigs drug gi /brtson dong du chud yun de sngas chog /da dung du 'khor ba'i sgo gsham la// 'bung nus pa'i mi rnams ci zhig bsam// las 'bras la bslu ba med pa dang*// 'khor 'das kyi skyon yon bde sdug sogs// gsung rab nas lan brgyar bshad mthong bzhin// spang blang de go log bsgrub mkhan mang*// chos pa rnams chos la brten pa'i sdig /nan tan du bsgrub pa'i snying khams dang*// chags sdang gi las kyi snying rus tsam// chos phyogs su 'bad na ci ma rung*// de bas na da nas dam chos kyang*// spros med la chig dril ma nus na// spros bcas kyi rnam dpyod ci che yang*// rang rgyud kyi lko skam thul bar dka'// kha bshad kyi 'brug sgra ldir che yang*// nyams len gyi sbrang char mi 'bebs na// las nyon 145)gyi tha ba sra mo nas// byang chub kyi myu gu 'khrungs par dka'/ mdo rgyud dang theg pa'i rim pa dang*// grub mtha' sogs chos sgo grangs med kun// rang sems kyi 'dul thabs 'ba' zhig tu// sangs rgyas kyi thabs mkhas phrin las nyid// bka' brgyud pa'i gsal stong zung 'jug dang*// sa lugs kyi 'khor 'das dbyer med dang*// rnying ma ba'i ka dag lhun grub sogs// mtshan mang gi dbye bsdu ci mdzad kyang*// yin lugs kyi ngo sprod mdzub tshugs te// rang sems kyi thog tu ma phebs na// tshig tshogs kyi sgrung gtam 'bum gleng kyang*// gang zag dang chos gnyis tha dad lus// de phyir du chos kyi snying po'i gnad// bla ma dang slob ma gdams ngag gsum// rten 'brel du 'dzom pa'i 'og rol na// nyams len la 'bad pa gnad du zab// mtshon byed kyi bla ma'i sku drin las/

146)/mtshon bya yi bla ma'i rang zhal dngos// sgrib med du mthong tshe snang srid kun// don dam gyi bla mar lhun gyis grub// phung khams dang skye mched 'byung ba lnga// snod bcud kun gdod nas dkyil 'khor lha// yin lugs la yin par shes pa'i tshe// rgyu lam 'bras dbang gi 'khor lo thob// dbang don nyid sems la ma shar na// bum pa brgya mgo bor btang byas shing*// dbang gzhung la 'bum ther klag na yang*// smin byed kyi nus pa ga la 'jog gsang sngags snying po rim gnyis don// gnyis po yang don la ngo bo gcig /gcig tshul ni snang stong dbyer med phyir// zung 'jug tu rtogs pas nyams len 'tshal// 'gags med kyi cha nas rnam pa gsal// skye med kyi rang bzhin rnam dag dran// zung 'jug gi klong du nga rgyal brtan// bskyed rim gyi gnas gsum sems la 'tshangs// yin tshul gnad don ma rtogs par// kun brtags kyi lha 147)gzugs bsgom bsgom yang*// sol nag la dngul du bsgom pa ltar// mchog thun gyi dngos grub ga la 'byung*// sgra grags kun sngags kyi rang bzhin nyid// 'byin 'jug gnas 'bru gsum rdo rje'i bzlas// rgyun ldan gyi bsnyen sgrub rang byung la// rtsol med du 'grub pa'i ya mtshan lags// rnam rtog gi rba rlabs zad med kyang*// chos nyid kyi rgya mtsho las ma g.yos// bsgom med la bsgom blo'i lhan pa ni// mi dgos kyang nan gyi 'debs mkhan mang*// gnas pa zhes bzang por 'dzin byed cing*// 'gyu ba zhes ngan par bzung bzung bas// gzung 'dzin gyi sgrogs kyis sgom chen bcings// gnyis 'dzin gyi lam du 'o re rgyal// tshogs drug mig rgyu'i chu rlung la// bden zhen gyi ri dwags 'brang 'brang yang*// log sred kyi skom tshad slar la 'phel// rang snang gi rol par 148)shes pa gnas// dran 'dzin gyi 'jur bdud dam po yis// nan btsir du bsdams kyang ngal ba'i rgyu// bzo med kyi shes pa cang shes rta// rang 'gros kyi btang na chugs sa med// bde gsal dang mi rtog nyams snang gi

/'ja' tshon la zhen pa'i byis pa 'khrul// 'khor 'das kun sems su 'dus pa la// nyams snang la bden 'dzin ci phyir byed// bden med la bden par 'dzin pa'i blos// nga med la ngar 'dzin sa bon bskrun// khengs sems kyi yal 'dabs 'phel gyur pa'i// dug sdong gis rang gzhan phung bar byed// mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs mtha' dag nas// dngos 'dzin las bzlog phyir stong nyid gsungs// stong nyid la zhen pa'i skran 'dril na// de nyid la bshig thabs ji ltar byed// yod mtha' zhen pa'i rtag mtha' dang*// med mtha' ni chad pa'i phyogs su lhung*// dbus ma yang zhen par mi byed pa'i// mtha' 149)dbus kyi sgrog bral lta bar gsungs// gsung rab bltas pa'i dpyad sgom dang*// nyams thog tu phab pa'i 'jog sgom sogs// bsgom tshul dang bzhed tshul mang mod kyi// byin rlabs kyi lam nyid zab par gsungs// lta ba dang sgom pa spyod pa 'bras// ming snyan gyi sgrig rim mang mod kyang*// sems nyid kyi rang tshul rang rig gis// gcer mthong zhig byung na chog par gda'// blta bya dang lta byed ma grub par// bsgom bya dang sgom byed ga la 'byung*// spyad bya dang spyod byed dngos pos dben// de phyir du thob bya thob byed med// med bzhin du sna tshogs snang ba'i 'phrul// 'khor 'das kyi bkod pa bsam yas 'di// ji rnyed kun rmi lam ji lta bar// sku gsum gyi rnam rol chos nyid dbyings// dbyings don de mngon du gyur pa'i tshe// gnyid sad pa'i rmi lam ji bzhin 150)du// zhen 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa rang sar sangs// lhun grub kyi ye shes rtsal chen rgyas// sangs rgyas zhes gzhan nas thob min par// rang rig nyid chos sku'i gtan srid zin// rtsol med kyi 'gro don shugs 'byung tshe// sku gnyis kyi go 'phang mi zer ram/ ༈ e ma/ de ltar cal col byung rgyal smras pa'i tshig

/'di la mkhas khyod khrel bar mi mdzadacing*// 'gal dang ma rtogs skyon la ma dgongs par// dgongs dbyings spro ba bskyed pa'i rol mor mdzod// ma nor gdams pa'i legs bshad ston nus pa'i// nyams rtogs dri tsam bdag la ma mchis kyang*// gzhan phan dkar po'i bsam pas 'di smras pa'i// dge bas 'gro kun chos nyid don rtogs shog /

ces pa ni bla ma grags pa 'gyur med la phul ba'o/ ༈ kye ho/ sems kyi gnas lugs gdod nas mkha' ltar 151)khyab// 'khor ba myang 'das bdag gzhan dngos pos dben// dngos po med las sna tshogs dngos snang ba/ chu zla'i gzugs brnyan 'dra 'di mtshar ba'i gnas// snang yang bden med sgyu ma'i ltad mo la// mi shes byis pa rnams kyi a 'thas brtsod// khron pa'i nang gi seng ge'i gzugs kyi dpe// ji bzhin 'khrul la 'khrul bsnan las nyon bsags// chos kun mthar thug don dam bden pa'i gnad// gnad kyi snying po rang sems ma bcos gshis// yin lugs ji bzhin rtogs pa'i don nyid la// gom na thag brgya'i mdud pa gcig 'khrol yang*// de ltar mi brtson tha snyad tshig mthar 'khor// grub mtha'i phyogs rer a thang chad chad 'then// 'then kyang du ma ro gcig ma thob par// chos khams che che'i skad kyis mgo bo 'khor// rgyal ba'i bka' la bzang dang ngan ma 152)grub// grub mtha' mtha' dag rang rang ngos nas zab// kun kyang 'bras bu sangs rgyas bsgrub par gcig /nga zhen chags sdang byed rnams snying rje'i gnas// mi tshe dgongs kha'i nyi ma yud tsam 'dir/ gtan gyi 'dun ma bsgrub la shin tu ran// rang yang mi brtson tshe 'di'i don bsgrub pa'i// chos gzugs kho na mang ba gzigs lags sam// glegs bam 'bum phrag slob gnyer byas na yang*// sems gsang ji bzhin shes pa shin tu dkon// lo brgyar mtshams sgrub byas pa'i yus can yang*// rang rgyud mar lkog snum gyi 'thul min 'dra// chos kyi snying por rang rgyud ma 'thul na// ci byas lam du 'gro ba srid min tshe// rang sems gzhu mo nang du bkug nas kyang*// chos dang sems su 'dres mdzod snying= /sems la sems kyis brtson du ma bzungs bar// gnas sam 'gyu'am gang ltar 153)'char kyang rung*// 'char mkhan kho yi rang ngo rig mdzod dang*// sgrog thag nang nas grol ba'i dus zhig 'ong*// chos sku'i rang zhal rang la 'char bzhin du// mi shes bcos ma'i sgom gyis bslad mkhan mang*// nyams rtogs re bas bsgrub dang dogs pas bcings// de 'dras nam yang byang chub thob mi 'gyur// yar mtha' drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen nas// mar mtha' 'jag mig srin bu yan chad la// bde gshegs snying po bzang ngan ma mchis tshe// re dogs zhe 'dod bral ba'i nyams len 'tshal// gzhi yis snying po gsal stong zung 'jug dang*// lam gyi snying por tshogs gnyis zung 'jug 'bad// 'bras bu'i snying por sku gnyis zung 'jug 'grub// snying po'i nyams len rtag tu brtson 'tshal lo//

ces dge slong kun dga' dbang rgyal la gdams pa'o// 154) ༈ mkhyen pa'i nam mkhar brtse ba'i 'od stong rgyas// mdzad pa'i phrin las gdul bya'i blo mun sel// smin grol pad tshal rgyas mdzad bla ma mchog /brgyud par bcas zhabs snying nas lan brgyar 'dud// dam pa du mas rjes bzung skal ba can// lung rtogs yon tan gyis phyug dge ba'i bshes// mtsho skyes lhun grub gang gi bzhed pa don// skong phyir zab don tshig 'ga' snyan du gsol// 'khor ba myang 'das ma lus kun gyi gzhi// sems nyid 'dus ma byas pa'i gnas lugs nyid// ye nas ma 'khrul rang ngo rig nas grol// de la chos sku'i grol gzhi'i ka dag zer// de ltar ma rig rang snang 'char sgo la// gzhan du bzung ba'i gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i rkyen// gcig las gcig 'phel lug rgyud 'khor bar 'khyams// khams gsum 'gro ba'i 'khrul gzhi zhes su 155)grags// de ltar 'khor ba thog med da bar du// ji tsam 'khrul yang rig pa'i ngo bo la// 'pho 'gyur bri gang spu tsam ma mchis tshe// bde gshegs snying po yongs grub ces pa lags// rgyal bas chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong kun// mtha' dag sems nyid 'dul thabs kho na ru// bstan yang gang zag so so'i skal ba'i mthus// ma rtogs lo rtogs phyogs rtogs sna tshogs 'gyur// lam rim theg pa'i dbye ba bsam yas kyang*// skabs 'dir theg mchog snying po'i nye lam nyid// phyag rdzogs dbyer med lta sgom spyod gsum gyi// 'gag don snying por dril nas brjod bgyi na// tha mal shes pa ma bcos rang babs kyi// gshis la bzang ngan dge sdig bdag gzhan sogs// kun rdzob mtshan ma'i lhad kyi ma bslad par// ngo bo ngos bzung med pa'i stong pa nyid// rang bzhin gsal 156)gdangs 'gags med cir yang 'char// de nyid tha dad ma yin zung 'jug che// rtag chad yod med yin min la sogs kyi// sgro bkur gang yang ma byas ma bcos pa'i// gnas lugs yin tshul ji bzhin rig pa la// lta ba'i don chen rtogs par zhes su brjod// de ltar rtogs par bya ba'i thabs mchog ni// tha snyad tshig mtha' gcod pa'i thos bsam dang*// 'gyu dran blo bzo mang pos mi 'byung gi

/tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag pa'i rgyu rkyen dang*// bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa nyid la rag /don la lta ba zer yang rang sems yin// rang sems bzo med rang ngo ma rig na// lta ba mthon por brlom yang yid dpyod yin// yid dpyod tshig gi lta bas 'tshang mi rgya// de phyir rang rig rang ngo shes par bya// sgom pa'i thabs dang khrid tshul mtha' yas kyang// gang zag dbang 157) rim so sor dgongs pa ste// kun gyi snying po zhi lhag zung 'jug tu// yang dag dran rig yengs med nyid la 'dus// zhi gnas lhag mthong rnam dbye mang mod kyang*// phra rags 'gyu rtog zhi ba zhi gnas la// gnas mkhan rang ngo rig pa lhag mthong nyid// mnyam gzhag rjes thob bzhed tshul mang po yang*// gdul bya tha dad dkri thabs bye brag tsam/ mthar thug don la mnyam rjes zung 'jug ste// sems nyid gnas sam 'gyu'am gang 'char kyang*// shar mkhan 'gyu mkhan gnas mkhan kho rang nyid// gcig pu de ka'i rang ngo rig pa na// thams cad mnyam gzhag 'ba' zhig kho na yin// rig pa rjen pa'i rang ngo ma rig na// gnas kyang dman pa'i zhi gnas tsam nyid dang*// 'gyu na tha mal 'khrul pa a 'thas te// gang yang mnyam rjes ma yin 158) 'khrul pa rang*// de phyir dran rig yod med gcig pur 'dus// rdzogs pa chen po ngo bo lam byed dang*// phyag rgya chen po rnam pa lam byed ces// spyi la grags mod de yi khyad par ni// rdzogs chen rig thog glod pa gtsor byed cing*// phyag chen dran pa kho nar rtsis su byed// de gnyis kyang ni don la khyad med de// phyag chen nyid nas a 'thas 'jur dran sogs// bcos ma'i yid byed mtha' dag rgyang bsrings ste// rtogs chos yang dag rang rig dran pa la// sgom gyi dngos gzhir mdzad phyir de nyid ni// rdzogs chen lugs kyi rig pa'ang de ka lags// des na 'gro 'chag za nyal 'dug la sogs// spyod lam kun dang tshogs drug gang la yang*// ma zhen mi dgag rjes 'brongs mi bya bar// dran tsam rig tsam cer mthong bzo med skyongs// rnam rtog skyes la skyon du mi

159)blta zhing*// mi rtog pa la dga' bar mi sems par// gang dran gang snang gang shar de ka'i ngor// dran rig rjen pas bskyangs ba gcig pus chog /nyon mongs dug lnga ched du mi spong zhing*// bde gsal mi rtog ched du mi sgrubs par// gang shar thams cad sgom du khyer ba'i gnang*// dran rig cer re 'di ka gcig pu lags// 'di don tshul bzhin rtogs la lta ba zer// de nyid rgyun du skyong ba sgom pa yin// la 'phebs// blta bya lta byed 'char dang mi 'char sogs// chos can mtha' dag chos nyid klong du zad// thos pa gsum dang gdengs bzhi la sogs kyi// yon tan mthar phyin zag med 'os lus 'grub// gang 'dul thugs rje mkha' mnyam 'gro la 'gyed// thod rgal 'di ni skal ldan 'ga' tsam las// kun gyis yid ches dka' zhing nyams len dkon// zhal rgyun lag khrid gnad bsnun gal cher gda'// de ltar phyag rdzogs nyams len brtson rnams kyi// shor sa bzhi dang gol sa gsum la sogs// rnam dbye mtha' yas bka' rgyud gong ma yis// gsungs pa mang phyir bdag 'dras brjod mi dgos// 'on kyang gegs dang gol sa'i che shos 162) /spyod lam dran rig ma zin spyod pa min// re dogs gnyis 'dzin yod na 'bras bu min// bla ma sangs rgyas ma mthong dad gus min// snying rje byang sems med na theg chen min// g.yo sgyu ngos lkog yod thogs med yod kyang mo ma 'dra// rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston yang mig 'khrul mtshungs// 'gro don zer yang rnyed grags bsgrub thobs rang*// lha bu'i bdud kyi chos pa bslus pa mang// zag bcas yon tan phran bu skyes pa la// ngar 'dzin khengs sems rang mthong cher skyes te// gegs la gegs su ma shes 'phrul phyir 'brong*// chos pa'i phung sa thams cad 'di na gda'// shor sa gol sa che shos 'di 'dras byed// rkyen dang bar chod thams cad 'di las 'byung// de phyir ngar 'dzin 'dul thabs gal re che/ ༈ gang zhig gegs skyon 164) med par nyams blangs na// rnal 'byor bzhi dang sa bcu lam lnga sogs// yon tan ma lus dbyar gyi rtsi thog bzhin// dus la babs pas 'bad med lhun gyis grub// thun mong theg pa'i lam lnga sa bcu sogs// byang phyogs so bdun yon tan mtha' dag kun// sngags kyi theg chen myur zab sa lam 'dir// grangs med gsum sogs mi 'gyangs gcig char bgrod// rtse gcig gsum la mnyam gzhag rang dbang thob// spros bral gsum gyis mnyam rjes dbyer med 'grub// ro gcig gsum la snang sems gnyis snang bgrod// sgom med gsum gyis shes sgrib mtha' dag bral// tshogs gyi lam gsum sngon 'gro'i skabs nas grol// sbyor lam gsum ni rtse gcig gsum gyis bgrod/

spros bral dus tshe mthong lam ye shes brnyes// sgom lam sa bcu ro gcig gsum gyis thob// sgom med mi slob mthar son nang gi sa/ 165) /bcu gcig bcu gnyis bcu drug skad cig bgrod// sku gsum go 'phang mchog brnyes gzhan don mdzad/ ༈ 'ga' zhig phar phyin theg pa'i sa lam gyi// yon tan brgya phrag mang po gsungs pa rnams// sngags gyi nye lam 'dir bzhugs rnal 'byor la// mngon par mi snang zhes su bskur 'debs kyang*// phyi rol phal pa'i ngo la mi snang yang*/ khyung phrug sgong ngar gshog drug rgyas pa dang*// seng ge mngal na rtsal gsum rdzogs pa ltar// rnal 'byor lus rgya grol dang yon tan snang*// de skad zab mo'i rgyud sde rnams las gsungs// rnal 'byor bzhi dang sa lam sbyar bshad sogs// zhib rgyas ma lus sgrub rgyud gong ma rnams// ji bzhin mngon du gyur nas gsungs pa las// lhag pa bdag 'dras brjod rgyu ga la mchi// tshul bzhin nyams su len pa'i skal ldan la// yong yong thob thob bshad pa mi dgos par/ 166) yon tan mngon gyur rang la 'byung bas na// de phyir nyams len kho nas chog par 'gro/ ༈ de lta'i lam rtags mtha' ru ma phyin par// tshe yi 'du byed zad par nye ba na// 'chi rkyen ma nges 'chi dus mi things bas// rtag tu 'chi kha'i nyams len grabs chud bya/ ring ba'i 'chi ltas rim gros slus tshul sogs// 'di ru ma brjod nye ba'i 'chi ltas ni// rlung lnga mal 'chug 'khor ba'i rtsa mdud 'jig /sa khams chur thim lus kyi 'tshe mi thub// shes pa bying zhing smig rgyu'i 'od gsal 'char// chu khams mer thim kha sna'i chu chad skam// shes pa rab 'tshubs 'od gsal du ba 'char// me khams rlung thim phyi rol snang ba 'gags// 'od gsal srin bu me khyer lta bu 'char// rlung khams rnam shes la thim dbugs brtsegs sdud// 'od gsal sgron me 'bar ba ltar mthong zhing*/

zug rngu che dang 'khrul 167)snang sna tshogs 'char// dkar cha thur 'bab dkar lam snang ba'i tshe// zhe sdang las gyur rtog pa so gsum 'gag /dmar cha gyen ldog dmar lam snang ba 'char// 'dod chags las dang*// dge sdig gang la 'dris pa de tshul dang*// mthun pa'i 'char sgo brjod kyi mi langs mod// thams cad kun la rang sems 'char sgo nyid// yin par shes na rnam shes grol 'gyur yang*// chos nyid bar tshigs bdun gyi phyed tsam tshun chod du// tshe 'di'i bag chags shas che zin sla zhing*// de 'das phan chad 169)skye ba phyi ma yi// snang ba dbang btsan de nas bsgyur bar dka'// de phyir dge ba myur min dmag 'khrug mi la yul grong snang// byol song brag phug yi dwags grog stong dang*// dmyal ba lcags khang la sogs mthong 'gyur zhing*// khyad par pha ma chags spyod mthong ba la// chags sdang rtog pa skyes nas mngal 'jug pas// de la mngal sgo dgag pa'i gdams pa yang*// rang nyid nyams len gang la goms pa yi// rab kyis rdzogs rim phyag rdzogs stong nyid dang*// 'bring gis bskyed rim tha mas zhen 170)thabs la 'bad// mngal sgo khegs par ma nus skye gnas 'dams// mi lus chos ldan skye ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs// yang na dag pa'i zhing du 'dun pas 'pho// de ltar bar do'i gdams pa thams cad kyi// gtso bor skye gnas bar do'i skabs 'dir rem// de bas da lta rang dbang yod dus 'dir// shi nas dge la re yang phyis te thal// des na zab lam chos drug gdams pa dang*// bar do'i 'phrang sgrol sgra bzhi lam khyer dang*// thos grol la sogs gdams pa gang mos rnams// long khyab yod ring rgyud la 'dris par bya// mdor na 'di phyi bar do thams cad du// dgos nges shes par rang sems gnyug ma'i gshis// bzo med lhug pa'i skyong tshul 'di nyid ni// gdams pa kun gyi nang nas mchog rab lags// de nyid ngang nas sgo gsum skad cig kyang*// snyom las mi bya spros bcas spros med la/ 171)/rgyun du brtson pas 'chi khar 'gyod med 'tshal// dge sbyor gang byed 'gro la phan phyir du// sems bskyed rtsis zin bsngo smon rgya yis gdab// rang gis rang nyid chos la dgod par mdzod// de ltar khyed kyi ji skad bskul ba bzhin// gdams pa'i zab gnad 'gag don mdor bsdus tsam// yi ge bris nas phul ba 'di bzhin du// thugs la sbyor mdzod rgyud la 'dres nges mdzod// rgyas bshad spro bar bdag gi nus min kyang*// nyams su len tshul 'di kas ma chog med// dngos su phrad kyang bstan rgyu 'di las ci// des na 'di nyid thugs la bcags par zhu// skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du// mi 'bral zab don chos kyi dga' ston la// lhan cig spyod pas mkha' khyab sems can kun// sku gsum go 'phang mchog la 'khod par smon/

zhes byang phyogs stod 172) kyi yul nas bla ma dge slong mtsho skyes sgrub pa'i bzhed pa skong phyir phul bdage'o// ༈ e ma gson dang skal ldan dzñā na ba// dad mos gdung bas bla ma dran pa 'di// kun rdzob rtsol byas bla ma'i rnal 'byor yin// bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems 'dres ba ni// don de rtsol med bla ma'i rnal 'byor yin// rig pa ma bcos lhug par 'jog pa 'di// kun khyab chos sku'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor yin/ tshogs drug snang ba gang shar zhen med 'di/ gsal gdangs longs sku bla ma'i rnal 'byor yin// rnam rtog 'gyu dran rang ngo shes pa 'di// sna tshogs sprul sku bla ma'i rnal 'byor yin// sangs rgyas thams cad bla ma'i ngo bor gcig /de ltar shes na byin rlabs ngang gis 'jug /lha tshogs ma lus bla ma'i rnam 'gyur tshul// yin par shes na dngos grub zad med 'byung*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong bla ma'i sprul pa yin// de bzhin go na phrin las rang bzhin 'grub/ 173)/snang srid kun kyang bla ma'i dkyil 'khor yin// dag snang 'byongs na thugs rje kun la yod// phyi rol 'byung ba thams cad bla ma'i sprul// gang la gang mkho'i 'gro don mdzad pa yin// nang bcud skye 'gro thams cad bla ma'i sprul// chos sku bde gshegs snying pos ma khyab med// bde skyid longs spyod thams cad bla ma'i drin/ gang bsam yid bzhin dngos grub rtsa ba yin// na tsha rkyen ngan kun kyang bla ma'i 'phrul// sdug bsngal myong bas sdig sgib zad par byed// kun khyab kun byed kun 'byung kun tu bzang*// de phyir bla ma'i lam khyer gnad du zab// yang cig gson dang dad ldan dzñā na ba// bla ma rang sems dbyer med ma rtogs na// kun rdzob gzugs sku'i bla mar 'du 'bral yod// rang rig bla ma chos skur shes pa gnad// bzang ngan mtha' dag bla mar ma rtogs na// dag snang phyogs med 'char ba'i

174)thabs gzhan med// dag snang ma 'byongs snang srid dgra ru ldang*// de bas gang 'dul sprul par shes pa gnad// dgra 'dre rkyen ngan bla mar ma shes na// bar chad gcig la zur yang gcig dang 'phrad// bdag 'dzin blo yis ma thongs 'di kas lan// gang byung bla ma'i thugs rjer shes pa gnad// 'chi kha'i dus nas bla ma ma dran na// shes shes byas byas mang yang rmi lam 'dra// rnam shes gcig pu bar dor 'khyams pa'i tshe// re sa skyabs yul gzhan na gang yang med// de phyir bla ma'i lam khyer zab gnad 'di// tshig dang yi ger ma bzhag sems la 'chong*// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos las 'di nyid zab// zab dang mi zab nyams su len la ran// nyams len mi byed zab kyang phan par dka'// de phyir blo snying brang gsum 'di la gtod/ gdams pa 'di yis dad ldan smin par shog 175) ces bla ma'i lam khyer gyi gdams pa snying por dril ba'i zhal gdams snying gtam 'di nyid rnal 'byor dzñā na kirti la gdams pa // e ma ho/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing gi sgron ma kun// gcig tu bsdus pa'i mthu stobs nus thugs rje// zla med ma hā gu ru thod 'phreng rtsal// gang de'i sgyu 'phrul zlos gar snyigs dus mgon// khrag 'thung he ru nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi// zhabs pad sri zhus gcig tu mchod mkhas pa// sdom brtson rnal 'byor ye shes phun tshogs pas// thugs kyi lhag bsam lang tsho dkar po dang// lhan cig dkar la 'gran pa'i lha gos mchog /dri 'dzin sim bde ster ba'i sdong bur bcas// 'chi med shis brjod dbyangs kyi rgyud mang sgra// rab gsal yi ger rnam par sprul pa'i phreng*// mi gshig phyag rgyas legs btabs ma nyams par// tha 'khob mun pa'i rong du bder 176)'byor bas// yid dbang spro bas 'dab brgya dgod par gyur// de dang mtshungs par nye gnas zung gnas la'ang*// phyag tham rten ldan bstsal ba'i don cha'ang nges/

༈ kye ho/ srid pa'i bde ba rmi lam las// ches cher bslu ba'i rmis chen 'dir// a 'thas rdo rje'i srog 'dzin bzhin// ngal ba 'bral med sgrub rems pa'i// rtsod ldan 'gro 'di ci zhig bsam// dgra gnyen 'jig rten bya byed kyi// las la 'bad pa'i snying stobs tsam// dam pa'i chos phyogs kha bstan na// ci ma rung te go log 'khrul// des na dge ba'i bshes mchog khyed// ngo mtshar gnas mchog de lta bur*// tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa yi// go cha de bzhin a la la// 'khor 'das kyi byed po sems nyid kyi// gshis ngo la 'gyur 177)ba med bzhin du// snang ngo ru sna tshogs 'char ba 'dis// gang zag rnams cir yang byed du bcug /'ga' zhig gi rnam rtog spong bsgyur bgegs// chu nyid kyi chu rag byed pa 'dra// 'ga' zhig ni bcos ma'i dmigs pas gzir// chab rom la shel du zhen de mtshar// la la dag rtog pa'i rjes 'brang byed// skyi ser gyi rta la zhon pa 'dra// phal cher ni sems la sems kyis bsgom// rang nyid la rang du ci phyir bsgom// lar bzang bzang zhig 'dod pa'i sgom blo dang*// ngan ngan zhig spong blo'i lhan pa 'di// mi dgos kyang nan gyis 'debs byed pas// sgom chen rnams sgom gyi 'o rgyal ldan// bcos min gyi rig pa cang shes rta// rang 'gros la btang na 'chug mi srid// zab zab dang yin yin khams che che'i// grub mtha' dang 178) chos lugs zhen phyogs kyi// thang 'then de shi la thug byed kyang*// sems nyid kyi rang 'gros shes pa dkon// ha ha/ gcig shes kun grol gnad kyi mtshang rig na// ci ltar byas kyang chos kyi dbyings nyid de// snod bcud ye nas lha yi dkyil 'khor du// yin tshul shes na bskyed rim logs na med// 'gro kun bla ma'i rnam 'phrul 'ba' zhig pa// yin par rtogs na dag snang sbyang dgos ci// skyid sdug thams cad byin rlabs kho na ru// go na bar chad rkyen ngan ga nas byung*// tshogs drug gang shar 'dzin med zhen med du// bskyur na 'gal mthun dgag bsgrub dgos med grol// tha mal shes rig zang thal rjen pa la// bsgom rgyu sgom byed gnyis su dbye don med// yengs kyi dogs dang ma yengs skyong snyam pa'i// chu la ri mo 'bri nas ci zhig bya// rang lugs rang babs rang sar lhod

179)kyi glod// bsgom rgyu med la rang ngo shes rgyu yod// rang ngo shes rgyu shes mkhan gnyis min par// gcig thog blo thag chod pa gnad du zab// gcig dang du ma'ang ming tsam tshig tsam ste// ming tshig brjod pa mang pos mgo bo 'khor// rnam rtog chos skur bzhed dang mi bzhed dang*// dran pa sgom du rung dang mi rung dang*// nyams rtogs shan 'byed mnyam rjes dbye bsdu dang*// shor gol gegs sel par 'gyur/ ༈ de skad cal col smyon pa'i gtam 'dra 'di// mang thos mkhyen ldan khyed thugs mgu min kyang*// dkyil 'khor dam tshig gcig pa'i nang 180)mchod du// 'bul gyi dbyings 'khrel med par rol du 'chi'i gdongs med pas// snying nas long med tshul 'di go lags sam// 'chi bar gyur pa tsam gyis mi chog pa// khams gsum rigs drug gar skyer bde ba ni// cung zad tsam yang go skabs ma mchis na// de bas skyob pa'i blo gtad gang la byed// rgyu 'bras las kyis bslu bar mi srid tshe// nyin zhag re la'ang sgo gsum mi dge ba// zhor la ci tsam 'gro 'dug legs bsom dang*/ 181)/skyi g.ya' snying nas za bar mi gda'a'am// bslab gsum sdom pa bslang kyang tshul 'chos 'dres// thos bsam slob gnyer byed na'ang za thabs tsam// mtshams bsgrub dge sbyor byed rloms chos brgyad spel// gang na'ang rang rgyud thul ba'i chos pa dka'// bskyed rim bsgom yang kun btags dri mas sbags// bzlas brjod 'bungs kyang bsrung zlog gsad don gnyer// rdzogs rim bsgom 'dod rnam rtog rdzing chur bskyil// byang chub lam du gang gis bsgod par byed// thob thob shes shes bgrang yang rgyud ma khel// gzhan skyon mthong mig rno yang rang ma rig

/grabs yul yid smon ngang la mi tshe 'das// deng sang chos pa'i rnam thar de 'drar lags/ ༈ kye ma/ snying thag par chos cig byed pa na// tshe 'di blo yi thongs pa dang*// lto gos skyid 'dod spong ba dang// zhen pa nang nas 182) zlog par 'tshal// sangs rgyas dngos kyi bla ma dkon// rnyed kyang dam tshig sel med dkon// ci gsungs chos bzhin bsgrub nus dkon// nyams len ci gcig byed pa dkon// dkon drag pas deng sang mi rnyed par// chos kha la yod kyang gting la med// phral skyid po'i chos cig ma gtogs pa// phugs byang chub bsgrub nus su la'ang med// phral rnam dpyod ldan pa'i chos tsam la// mi skya ser med pa yid smon yang*// sems tshe 'di'i don la zhen zhen nas// nam 'chi khar 'gyod kyang phyis na thal// gcig shes kun grol ma byung na// mdo rgyud man ngag mtha' dag la// ma shi'i bar du bslab sbyangs kyang*// kun shes gcig rdugs las 'gro sa med// chos ma shes kyi dogs pa byed mkhan mang// ma nus kyi dogs mkhan shin tu nyung*// nyams len la 'bungs nus gcig kyang 183)med// don de phyir snying gtam tshig 'di gson/ ༈ e ma/ 'di nas bzung ste rnam pa thams cad du// skyid sdug legs nyes na tsha 'chi rkyen sogs// gang la'ang blo rtse dkon mchog kho nar gtad// skyabs su 'gro ba'i nyams len rtsa ba yin// sems can mtha' dag drin can pha ma la// dgra gnyen chags sdang phyogs 'dzin nye ring sems// su la byas kyang pha ma gsad dang mtshungs// kun dang mthun pa sems bskyed rtsa ba yin// bag chags ngan pa thogs med dus nas goms// g.yo sgyu zol zog sus kyang ma bslab shes// btsan dug lkog tu bzos kyang 'chi ba bzhin// ngos lkog spong ba dam sdom rtsa ba yin// bla ma mched grogs snod bcud lha sngags dang*// phung khams rgyal ba'i zhing bsgom log lta spang*// 'khyer so rnam gsum rgyud la 'gris byed pa// dbang bzhi'i nyams len kun
