184)gyi rtsa ba yin// sangs rgyas kun kyang bla ma'i ngo bor gcig /mdzad tshul cir bstan gang 'dul phrin las nyid// skyon du mthong ba rang nyid 'phrul tshabs che// dag snang skyong ba byin rlabs rtsa ba yin// 'gro ba'i phung khams skye mched gzod ma nas// lha yi ngo bor grub kyang der ma rig /de nyid rig pas gsal gdab a 'thas spongs/ brda don shes pa bskyed rim rtsa ba yin// gdod nas dag pa'i ye stong mtha' bral gyi// gsal mdangs 'gags med rol rtsal cir yang 'char// shar yang don la 'char bya 'char byed med// zung 'jug rtogs pa rdzogs rim rtsa ba yin// yod med rtag chad dbus mtha' la sogs pa// gnyis chos thams cad ma spangs ye grol gyi// sems nyid gnas lugs ji bzhin shes pa ni// chos rnams kun gyi lta ba'i mthar thug yin/ dmigs pas bcos nas bsgom 185)rgyu rdul tsam med// tha mal 'khrul 'byams skad cig mi 'chor bar// ma yengs mi sgom ngang la dus 'da' bar// phyag rdzogs kun gyi sgom pa'i rtsa ba yin// chos kun rmi lam sgyu ma 'drar shes nas// dgag bsgrub mtshan 'dzin sgrog gis ma bcings shing*// kun rdzob rgyu 'bras khyad du mi gsod par// zhen med rtsol bral spyod pa'i rtsa ba yin// nyon mongs dug lnga rtsa ba yan lag bcas// lam du ma lhongs kha chos stong skad kyis// gsang sngags bstan pa'i zhabs nas mi drang bar// chos dang sems 'dres lam khyer rtsa ba yin// gang du sdod kyang chos min mi byed cing*// nam gyi dus na'ang dge sbyor mi bshol dang*// skad cig tsam yang le lor mi 'chor bar// nyams len mtshams sgrub kun gyi rtsa ba yin// ci byed bla med byang chub bsgrub don las// tshe 186)'di'i ched du spu tsam mi sems par// dge ba ma lus 'gro ba'i don du bsngo// theg chen gzhan don kun gyi rtsa ba yin// nyams len chos kyi rtsa ba'i snying po kun// mdo ru bsdus nas gdams pa'i dge ba gang*// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun kyang 'di lta'i don// ma nor rtogs nas 'bras mchog 'grub gyur cig

ces chos dbang ye shes kyi bskul ngor rgod phug bya skyibs nas gdams so// ༈ kye ho/ mdo rgyud man ngag rgya chen chos kyis// sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs kyang*// kun gyi rtsa ba rang sems 'di nyid// 'dul thabs gcig pu ma gtogs gzhan med// smin byed dbang gi rnam grangs mang po'i// brda thabs rten 'brel sna tshogs du mas// bskur yang rang rig ye shes ngo bo// 'di nyid dbang don dngos gzhi yin no// grol byed gdams pa'i khrid rim kun gyi// phyag bzhes man ngag zab zab mang 187)yang*// sems nyid rjen pa bzo bcos med 'di// rang la rang ngo sprod thabs kho nar// thams cad mthun yang 'phrod mkhan dkon no// gshis kyi ngo bo spros bral chos sku// de yi rang mdangs 'od gsal longs sku// 'gag med cir yang 'char grol sprul sku// de gsum don la dbyer med ro gcig /da lta'i tha mal shes pa 'di yin// gnas pa'i sems la bzang du ma zhen// 'gyu ba'i rnam rtog ngan du ma 'dzin// gnyis ka'i rang ngor cer gyi ltos dang*// lta ba lta mkhan gnyis su med do// med kyang 'char tshul cir yang ma nges// nam mkha'i sprin dang chu yi rba rlabs// shar dang thim kun rang las ma g.yos// de bzhin rnam rtog byung tshul thams cad// rang las byung zhing rang gi rang grol// de yang ming gi btags tshul tsam yin// don la sems nyid dngos po med phyir/ shar dang grol ba'i 188)dngos po ci 'byung*// med bzhin snang ba'i sgyu 'phrul 'di la// a 'thas zhen 'dzin dgag sgrub ma byed// gu yangs khrol le lhod der zhog dang*// rig stong chos sku'i rang zhal 'jol dang*// tsab tsub blo sna span spun mang pos// rang sems rang gis 'khrul du ma 'jug /wa le khyug ge ci gar thongs dang*// rnam rtog las lhag bsgom rgyu mi dgos// kho rang bla ma'i mchog tu 'char ro// nges shes zab mo nang nas skye'o// skyes kyang skye mkhan kho rang yin gyi// gang shar rang ngo rig las lhag pa'i// sgom 'dod sgom blo'i lhan pa ma rgyags// bsgom mo snyam pa'i shes pa de las// gzhan pa'i sgom mkhan sgom rgyu gar 'dug

/yengs so 'phros so 'khrul lo snyam mkhan// de nyid las gzhan yengs mkhan su 'dug /de phyir sems nyid gcig gi rol par// gang yang 189)shar med shar yang stong nyid// ji tsam 'char kyang dgag sgrub rjes 'brang*// ci yang mi bya rang sar glod la// mi spro mi bsdu skyur la zhog cig /yang dag don gcig 'di las 'byung ngo*// lo brgya'i bar du nan gyis bsgom pa'i// sgom chen sgom gyis bcings pa mang ngo*// mi bsgom bsgyur ba'i nyams len 'di yis// gtan 'dun byang chub thob par 'gyur ro// de skad gdams ngag rjen par phyungs 'di// tshig la ma 'byams rgyud thog 'khel mdzod/

ces pa 'di yang nye gnas pa bstan 'dzin dar rgyas la snying gtam gdams pa'i snying khur smras pa // ༈ bsam gyis mi khyab thugs rje'i zlos gar gyis// mtha' yas 'gro la phan bde sbyin mdzad pa// mtshungs bral ma hā gu ṇa mnyam rdor ba// rtsa ba'i bla ma dbyer med la btud nas// gso rig 'dzin mdzad bsod nams rab rtan mtshan// gang gi snying 190)gtam bslab bya dgos gsungs ba'i// bzhed don tshig 'ga' snyan du gsol bgyi na// kha chos ma mdzad rgyud la sbyor bar zhu/ kye ma/ snyigs dus rtsod ldan mtha' ma'i yang mtha' 'dir// skye rgu thams cad log lam blo kha phyogs// legs pa'i lam la mdun mkhan rab tu dkon// rang skyon rang gis tshor mkhan ma mchis lags// sman par mtshan gsol sa steng khyab na yang*// snying nas phan sems ldan pa nyin skar tsam/ blo zhag drug gi dam tshig bsrung mkhan med// khe grags zas nor bsgrub mkhan mang ba lags// yon tan ldan pa'i slob dpon bstan yun thung*// snyan brgyud phyag bzhes gdams pa'i gting ma lon// kha rje za thang la re'i sman pa mang*// 'gro la phan bde ster nges dkon pa lags// dpal ldan rgyud bzhi yid bzhin nor bu dang*// khyad par zab mo man ngag rgyud chen nyid/ 191) dor nas shog dril thang thung blo gtod pa// brgyud pa'i byin rlabs chu klung mi 'byung lags// sman pa gzhan la dag snang mi byed cing*// rang gi yon tan nor gyi zong du byed// snyoms chung nad pa snying rjes mi skyong ba// gso rig shes pa'i phan yon ma mchis lags// mdo rgyud kun nas gzhan phan smon 'jug lam// 'bad par gsungs na dngos su phan nges ni// gso dpyad las lhag gang yang ma mchis na// rang 'dod spangs nas gzhan phan bsgrub 'tshal lags// khyed nyid thugs dam yi dam lha skal ni// sangs rgyas gling dang zhig gling chos skor la// dad mos ldan pa shin tu legs mod kyang*// gu ṇa'i bla sgrub skabs su babs 'os lags// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma mchog zhig la// sdug bsngal mun sel thugs rje'i nyi 'od kyi// dbang lung khrid zhus nyams su len nus na// chos

192)bka' gzhan la re ltos mi dgos lags// phyag rdzogs nyams bzhes sngar nas mdzad mchis na// de las spros pa bdag gi ci zhig gsol// bla ma re la khrid tshul mi 'dra mang*// gang la goms bde gdams ngag zab pa lags// zhu zhu thob thob kha grangs bsags na yang*// rang rig rjen pa rang ngo ma shes na// lta sgom chos skad bzang yang dgos dus bslu// rang rgyud lko skam 'thul bar dka' ba lags// byin rlabs tshul bzhin snying la ma zhugs na/ gdams pa zab kyang rgyud la skye mi nus/ byin rlabs 'jug la dad pa'i stobs shugs dgos// dad pa tshul ldan deng sang dkon pa lags// 'khor 'das kun gyi byed po sems nyid 'di// rtag chad yod med skye 'gag 'gro 'ongs med// med bzhin snang ba'i cho 'phrul zad med 'char// 'char mkhan 'char rgyu so sor ma grub lags/ 193) /gdod nas dag pa'i stong dbyings chen po yi// rtsal mdangs rnam par rtog pa'i 'phro 'du 'di// bkag pas mi khegs rjes su 'brang na 'khrul// gang shar rang ngo rig pa gal che lags// 'ju+ur sgrim gnas cha sgrub pa'i sdug tsir gyis// srog rlung rin gyis nyo ba'i sgom chen mang*// rnam rtog rang gar shor na 'jig rten pa// de bas rang rig rang babs skyong ba lags// tha mal 'khrul phyir mi 'breng phyag rgya che// bzo med rig thog glod pa rdzogs chen don// rkyen snang dgag sgrub mi dgos gcod yul dang*// mtshan 'dzin phyogs ltung med pas dbu ma lags// rgyal ba thabs mkhas gdul bya sna tshogs la// gang 'dul chos kun mi zab 'ga' med kyang*// tshig dang yi ger lus nas rgyud ma 'khel// chos dang gang zag so sor song ba lags// rang rgyud chos kyis 194)ma dul nor la sred// gzhan la dag snang mi 'byongs khengs sems can// chags bral chos gtam stong lta kha khyer mkhan// de 'dra gsang sngags chos kyi zhabs 'dren lags// de phyir thos bsam yang snying nyams len gtso// nyams len snying por bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug zab// shi rung gson rung bla mar blo phugs gtad// blo sna mang pos phan pa ma mchis lags// lta sgom snying por phyag rdzogs dbyer med skyong*// spyod lam snying por sgo gsum chos mthun bsgrub// gzhan don snying por gso rig phyogs med bskyangs// snying gtam bslab bya lags so thugs la bstim/

zhes dwags po drung 'tsho ba bsod nams rab brtan la gdams pa // rje bka' brgyud kyi gtsug rgyan sgam po pa'i// gdung dri med las 'khrungs pa'i chos kyi rjes// bdag mtha' khobs kyi bya bral rgan po la// chos zab don gyi snying gtam smros shig 195)gsungs// khyed sngon sbyangs dang rigs kyis grub pa'i mthus// thugs mkhyen rab kyi nyi gzhon gsal bas na// bdag me khyer gyi 'od la ci zhig ltos// bka' mi chog pas phebs sgo'i lan 'di phul// spyir theg pa'i rim pa bsam yas dang// chos grub mtha'i bzhed gzhung dpag med kun// don dgos rgyu'i snying po gal che ba// sems rang rgyud 'di 'dul thabs 'ba' zhig lags// chos nga bzang 'gran pa'i bang rtsal de// blo chags sdang gi thang la rgyug rgyugs kyang*// sems ngar 'dzin zhi ba'i mgyogs dar ni// mi ngar 'dzin su ches len par byed// phral 'jig rten gyi 'dun ma mkhas 'gran dang*// rgyu nor rdzas kyi bsdu thabs gang mkhas la// ming chos pa dang yongs 'dzin du 'bod dus 'dir// sgom nyams len de nam langs kyi skar ma 'dra// zas sha 196)chang gi dga' ston spyod phyir du// ma sems can gyi srog dbugs 'gam rems pas// gos ngur smrig gi lhab lhub cher g.yo ba// chos las 'bras la dbang yod ha cang ches// phyogs sde ris rtsod pa'i snying stobs dang*// 'bangs mnga' zhabs skyong ba'i blo rgya dang*// dkor dad zas sgrub pa'i sgo bshoms sogs// ming bstan pa ru btags 'di su yis dran// zas btung ba tsam zhig 'tshol thabs su// la las chos bshad dang dbang bskur btsongs// la la rnga brdung dang dril 'khrel 'bad// la la shog slog dang bam slog rems// la las glu gar dang mtshams dri brtse// la la lta stangs dang sgom rdzu byed// la las mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul ston// phal cher thabs ka dang nga srung brtson// phral yon bdag gi mgo bskor 'bad 'bad nas// phug rang mgo rang gi bskor bar 'chi// lam bar do'i 'phrang

197)ring 'grim dus der// rgyu nor rdzas rnams gang du 'gro'am ci// phyi 'byung ba snod kyi g.yo 'khrugs dang*// nang skye 'gro bcud kyi rnam 'gyur sogs// yid khong snying 'dar ba'i tshul 'di 'drar// blo rtag 'dzin can rnams ci bsam na// lags de phyir mi tshe yud tsam 'di// gtan 'dun ma'i rtsa bar ma dril na// rkyen 'chi ba thog babs 'byung nges pas// gnad snying po'i nyams bzhes brtson par 'tshal// dal 'byor 'di thob pa'i dga' tshod la// stong zad du btang na phung tshabs ches// 'chi ba la rgan gzhon ma nges tshe// nam byung du thogs med grabs chud dgos// khams gsum du gar skye sdug bsngal gyi// brtson dong du go bas 'bros thabs 'bad// rgyu 'bras kun bslu med nges shes kyis// rang sems la dpang gtsug spang blang 'tshal// dkon mchog blo la gtad snying gtad kyi/ 198) /skyabs 'gro ni chos kyi gzhi rten lags// sems can kun pha mar blo nges pas// smon 'jug gi srab kha thar lam bsgyur// sdig sgrib kyis ngan 'gro'i gting rdo byed// 'gyod bshags dang yig brgyas dag par sbyangs// snod bcud dang sgo gsum gtan 'dun bcas// maṇ+ḍal phul bas tshogs sogs 'bad// byin rlabs kyi 'byung gnas bla ma la// gdung shugs kyis gsol ba rgyun du gdab// phung khams kun gzod nas lhar shes pa'i// bskyed rim gyis tha mal zhen rtog dgag /long gtam gyis ngag sgrib mi gsog par// rdor bzlas dang snyen pa kha ton rems// 'khrul pa la 'khrul rgyun 'thud pa 'dis// thogs med 'khor bar 'khyams lags pas// 'khrul mkhan nyid rang ngo shes mdzod dang*// 'khrul snang gi rdzun phugs dib par 'gyur// rnam rtog gi rba klong snyol ba'i phyir// zhi gnas kyi rmang gzhi brtan 199)pa dgos// gnas cha la ha cang zhen pa na// theg dman gyi 'gog par gol nyen mchis// lhag mthong gi rang zhal ma rig na// zhi gnas kyi nyams myong ci bzang yang*// phral rkyen gyi rlung 'tshubs ldang tsa na// sgom chen pa sgom dang bral ba mang*// blos byas kyi sgom pa bzang lags kyang*// phyag chen gyi don la nye bar dka'// sgom rgyu zhig yod na phyag chen min// yin lugs kyi lta ba ngo phrod na// rang babs su glod pa sgom pa'i gnad// glod rgyud dang glod mkhan gnyis min kyang*// bcos sgom du mi bya rang babs bzhag

/ma yengs pa gnad du che mod kyi// yengs dogs kyi rtogs pas g.yeng ba mang*// dran pa la sgom du byed na yang*// yengs mkhan dang dran mkhan tha dad 'dzin// tha dad du bzung la gnyis 'dzin zer// gnyis 'dzin ni sgom 200)gyi gegs su che// gangs chen 'dir phyag chen chu mgo ni// rje zla 'od gzhon nur ma thug med// deng sang gi phyag chen sgom mkhan phal// blos byas kyi gnas sa sbyong mkhan mang*// rje des gsungs gab pa mngon phyungs sogs// gnad zhal gdams rnams dang cung ma mthun// chu mgo dang ma mthun chu 'jug de// 'dam rnyog gi lhad las 'os ci zhig /bcos min gyi ngo bo skyong ba las// 'jur 'dzin gyi gnas pa sgrub don med// gnas 'gyu la spang blang byed byed nas// byed pa po 'khrul pa'i ngang du 'byams// gang shar gyi rang ngo phyag chen du// lam khyer gyi nyams len ma shes na// gnas dus nyid sgom du bzung bzung nas// bar mtshams kun 'khrul pa'i yo lang nyid// rnam rtog dang chos sku gcig mi gcig /rtsod gzhi de shi la thug byed kyang*// rnam rtog nyid chos skur ma shar ba/ 201) /gcig tha dad 'dzin pa ngal bar zad// gnas 'gyu kun sgom du khyer shes na// sgom min gyi 'khrul rtog lus rgyu med// gser gling na sa rdo mi rnyed bzhin// chos nyid las gzhan pa gang yang med// gnas cha la sgom du byed na yang*// gnas nyams de sgom gyi ngo bo min// gnas mi gnas rang ngo shes pa dgos// de shes tshe 'gyus kyang sgom gyi ngang// gnas 'gyu la dga' 'dam ma dgos tshe// tshogs drug kyang sgom du ma gyur med// yin tshul la nyams myong ma skyes na// de yin no snyam kyang go skam tsam// go ba dang tshig la zhen pa dang*// rgyas 'debs kyi lhan pa mi gdab par// tha mal gyi shes rig rjen pa 'di// rang babs su skyong dang de kas chog /thun mtshams kyi bzhag len mi byed cing*// go yul dang kha ltas ma bslus par// mos gus dang gsol

202)'debs nan tan bya// dngos grub de tshe gcig sangs rgyas zhu// mi tshe ni rmi lam tsam 'di la// skyid sdug gi mdun ma ci dga' btang*// gtan 'dun de yal bar ma dor na// 'jig rten gyi 'dun ma 'chugs kyang bzod// mkha' khyab kyi 'gro don mi sgrub na// rang phyogs kyi 'gro don phyogs char zad// rlabs chen gyi gzhan don sgrub pa la// mkhyen rtogs kyi nus pa mthar phyin dgos/ dge sbyor kun rang 'dod kyis ma slad par// sems skyed dang bsngo smon bzang pos spel// skad cig kyang tha mal mi sdod par// rtsol bcas dang rtsol med nyams len 'tshal// de skad du gsol ba'i tshig phreng 'di// kha chos su ma mdzad rgyud la sbyor// bdag mi rgan dngos su phrad na yang*// don 'di las lhag pa zhu rgyu med// thugs mkhyen dbyings zab mor bstim par gsol// tshul 'di smras dge 203)ba gang mchis mthus// ma mkha' mnyam 'gro ba byang chub shog ces shar dwags lha sgam po nas zhabs drung gdung rgyud rin chen sku bgres pa'i drung gi bzhed pa skong phyir phul ba maṅga laṃ// ༈ don rgyud byin rlabs 'byung gnas rtsa rgyud bla ma'i zhabs// gus pas lan brgyar btud nas skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs// bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs brtson mdzad bstan rdor skyes mchog gang*// bzhed don skong ba'i tshig gsum snyan du gsol ba dgongs// phun tshogs dal 'byor thob 'di rmi lam snang ba tsam// nam mkha'i thog las 'jigs pa'i 'chi bdag myur du 'ong*// tshe 'di'i snang bas bslus shing shi dus lag stong 'gro// long med dge sbyor 'bad rab grabs bshom ma mchis mdzod// thos pa rgya mtshos ngoms kyang dgos don nyams len nyid// mi tshe chos la 'bungs rloms sems rgyud thul ma 204)thul// rkyen ngan phra mo tsam gyis chos pa'i tsha rdo 'bor// rang skyon nan gyis brtul ba gal gyi che shos lags// rgyu 'bras kha nas bshad pa'i ston chen sgom che mang*// rang sems dpang du 'dzug mkhan rin chen gser las dkon// 'dod pa'i longs spyod mthong na las 'bras 'ja' ltar yal// rang zog rang la 'tshong ba'i chos pa mang la gzigs// lto 'brangs nyi mas dros nas 'bol bde bshoms pa'i tshe// chos dang mthun mthun 'dra ba'i sems kyi khye'u chung 'di// sdug bsngal en tsam byung dus chos dang bla ma brjed// byis pa'i rnam thar ston na 'chi khar cir 'gyur bsom// 'dul sdom kun gyi rtsa ba dge sbyong chos bzhi dang*// byang chub sems gyi snying po bdag las gzhan ces blo// gsang sngags lam gyi mthar thug khyer so rnam pa gsum// kha tshig tsam las ma lus rgyud la 'dres nges zhu/

205) /rnal 'byor ma thob bzhin du sha chang bud med dang*// nyon mongs lam du 'khyer ba'i tho bcos bslus pa mang*// skyo tsha'i zhim mngar tsam las 'dzin pa che lugs la// dug lnga lam khyer nus pa re shig 'gor ba lags// grub mtha' chos rgyud brtsod pa'i bstan pa'i gzhogs 'then dang*// chos la bzang ngan 'dzin pa'i cal sgrog rjes 'brengs dang// rang phyogs rgyal na dga' ba'i chags sdang kha 'dzin sogs// kun gyi nan ltar 'bad med spang bya'i gtso bo lags// zang zing rnying la gdung ba lan tshwa'i 'thung 'dra// mi chos pher yong mkhas bzhin sdig sgrib khres po ljib// gdul bya phrin las gang che bub pa'i snga ltas yin// blo kha nang du bzlog na gtan 'dun 'grub par mchi// bla ma'i bka' dang ma mthun dam tshig rtsa ba rul// dam med chos la mkhas kyang ru dra'i 206) go 'phang 'grub// rtag tu bla ma mnyes byas chos sgo de kas chod// dad dam dag snang can la byin rlabs lhug par 'bab// gzhis byes lam gsum med pa'i nyin mtshan nam du yang// sgo gsum chos min spong zhing snyom las mi bya bar// chos spyod bcu po gang rung lag tu blang bya zhing*// ci byed mkha' mnyam 'gro la sems bskyed bsngo smon spel// grogs 'khor slob ma sbyin bdag 'brel thogs thams cad la// ci nus lhag bsam zol med sdig spong dge la sbyor// rang 'dod phug bcug min pas bstan pa'i zhabs tog dang*// dge sbyor zung du 'brel la brtson pas mtha' 'khyol zhu// mi rgan dbang po gud pa'i cal col gtam tshig 'di// gang khyed thugs la 'phrod dang don la 'bab pa dka'// gal te phan sems dkar ba'i nus pa'i cha mchis na// de mthus skyes 207) mchog khyed sogs kun la phan par shog

ces bla ma sku skyes pa mi pham bstan pa'i rdo rje la phul ba'o// ༈ skal ldan dad can nor bzang pas// bka' phyag chu bo mnyam 'dres kyi// gdams pa'i snying po mdor dril ba'i// snying gtam smros zhes gang gsungs bzhin// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos sgo ni// brgyad khri bzhi stong la sogs kyang// nyams su blang bya'i snying po ni// lta spyod gnyis su ma lus med// lta ba'i mthar thug phyag rgya che// spyod pa'i mchog rab blo sbyongs chos// zung du 'brel ba'i zab bzhes 'di// sgam po pa yi khyad chos lags/ ༈ /lta ba'i ming du btags mang yang*// lta rgyu'i dngos por grub pa med// blta bya'i yul dang lta byed sems// gnyis su med pa'i ngos bzung bral// gnyis med gcig dang du ma'ang min// med bzhin 208)cir yang snang bzhin 'char// shar yang bden par ma grub pa'i// rang sems 'di la lta ba zer// bltas pas mthong du ma mchis kyang*// nyams su myong rgyu'i nges shes 'byung*// nyams myong zhen pas ma bcings par// rig pa rjen pa rang babs skyong*// rang ngo rang gi shes pa de// lta ba phyag rgya chen po yin// lta ba'i don las ma yengs pa// sgom pa kun gyi snying po ste// lta sgom dbyer med gnyug ma'i ngang*// ma bcos ma yengs bskyang bar 'tshal// snang sems dbyer med lhan cig skyes// lta ba'i don la 'drisapar mdzod// spyod pa blo sbyong gdams pa la// don bdun thun brgyad don bzhi sogs// sa bcad dbye tshul mang na yang*// snying por rang rgyud gdul thabs nyid// ngar 'dzin 'gong po ma thul na// thos bsam sgom pa bzang rloms kyang*// dug dang 'dres pa'i 209)kha zas bzhin/ rang gzhan gang la'ang phan pa med// thub pas chos rnams gang bstan yang*// gdul bya'i sems rgyud 'dul phyir yin// bdag 'dzin slar la 'phel ba yi// shes shes mang po'i chos kyis ci// tshig zur mtho dman tsam la yang*// mi bzod khong khro'i me 'bar zhing*// las 'bras khyad du gsod byed pa'i// bdag 'dzin 'di yis 'phral yun phung*// kun las rang nyid lhag par du// bzang 'dod rgyal 'dod grags 'dod dang*// bde skyid 'dod pa'i blo ngan 'dis// 'khor ba ngan song gzhi mar byas// da nas rnam pa thams cad du// skyid kyang chog la sdug kyang chog

/gang byung bla ma dkon mchog drin// thugs rjer shes pas mos gus bskyed// mkha' khyab rigs drug sems can kun// pha mar ma gyur su yang med// khro 'khrugs gnod 'tshe ci phyir byed// thar lam 'khod pa bsem sbyor 'bad/ 210)/so thar dge sbyong chos bzhi dang*// theg chen smon 'jug byang sems dang*// gsang sngags dag snang zhing sbyong sogs// gnad don ma lus 'di ru gzhol// dam chos byas pa'i don po de// rang skyon thul ba 'ba' zhig dgos// skyon zad yon tan rdzogs pa la// sangs rgyas zhes su brjod pa lags// phyag rgya che dang blo sbyong gi /dmigs rim tsam zhig shes sla yang*// don 'di rgyud la ma 'byor na// thob thob tshig gi lam du zad// kha la khyer rgyu'i chos ma yin// lag tu blangs zhing sems la sbyor// snying gtam go bder smras pa 'dis*// khyed thugs chos kyis smin gyur cig / ces pa 'di skal ldan ma ṇi bha dra la gdams pa shu bham// ༈ swa sti si d+dhi// rgyal ba gang zhig 'gro ba'i don// chags thogs med pa'i phrin las kyis// mngon mtho nges legs ster mdzad pa'i// skyabs gnas bla ma dkon mchog la// bdag sogs 211)mkha' mnyam sems can kun// snying nas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// dmigs bral thugs rje chen po yis// rtag par rjes su bzung du gsol// bod yul shar phyogs kong rong mthil// zad mthar thug pa rgyal ba'i gnas// snying po dpal ri gangs can 'di'i// phyogs bzhir gu ru'i sgrub phug yod// shar na zhi ba chos kyi phug/ lhe ru bde gshegs tshe yi phug nub tu mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i phug byang na phyag rdor 'og min phug phrin las bzhi 'grub gnas chen yin// de las bde gshegs tshe phug 'di// gu rus bya rgod sprul nas bzhugs// rgod tshang phug ces phal la grags// skyes chen mang po'i bzhugs gnas mdzad// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ngang gis 'du// skyo shas nges 'byung shugs la 'char// ting 'dzin nyams rtogs

212)rang bzhin 'phel// phyag mchod bskor bas sdig sgrib 'dag /'brel tshad don ldan gnas mchog 'dir// bdag 'dra ban chung bla ma'i gzugs// sna tshogs rang grol ming 'chang bas// mi lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bar// mi dang ma 'phrad dben mtshams bgyis// skyabs gnas rje la gsol ba btab// mkha' mnyam 'gro la snying rje bsgom// sgo gsum dam pa'i chos la bril// skye rim snod bcud dag snang sbyang*// rdzogs rim rlung rig ye shes bsres// zung 'jug rang sems bzo med glod// cir snang chos sku'i dkyil 'khor la// dgag sgrub mtshan 'dzin ma bcings par// khyab gdal ye shes rol par spyad// spros bcas spros med dge sbyor kun// mkha' khyab 'brel tshad ltos bcas sogs// bla med byang chub thob phyir bsngos// mi rgan bsam pa mtha' ru phyin/ 213) ༈ phyin chad 'dir bzhugs chos mdzad kun// dben pa'i sgrub gnas 'di lta bur// 'jig rten bya bas ma slad par// tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam mdzad zhu// gnas 'di mjal dang phyag skor byed// mchod 'bul tshogs 'khor bshoms la sogs// mthong thos dran reg thams cad kyang*// nad 'don sdig sgrib bar chad zhi// tshe dpal bsod nams 'byor pa 'phel*// ci bsam chos mthun nyid du 'grub// tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob gyur cig /rgyal khams bde zhing skye 'gro skyid// bstan pa dar dang bstan 'dzin mthun// ji ltar smon lam kun 'grub par// skyabs gnas rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs/ maṅga laṃ/ ces pa 'di dpal gyi gnas mchog rgod tshang phug nas bcad rgya grol te thang 'brog 'od gsal rtse mo'i sgrub gnas su 'gro gdong la yi ger bkod pa'o// ༈ grub rigs bzang po'i rgyud las legs 'khrungs pa'i// sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa don grub pas// sems 214)la phan pa'i slab bya dgos gsungs ba'i// bzhed don skong phyir snyan du 'di ltar phul// mi lus tsam zhig thob pa mang na yang*// dal 'byor don ldan 'grub mkhan shin tu dkon// chos med rnam rig bkra yang blun por zad// thar lam da res zin pa gal che lags// skyes nas mi 'chi ba ni su yang med// 'chi ba thog bab rgan gzhon ma nges tshe// shi nang phog nas 'gyod kyang bya thabs zad// snga grabs 'gyod med chud pa gal che lags// rgyu 'bras dge sdig bde sdug bslu ba med// ngos lkog g.yo sgyu mkhas kyang rang phung nyid// bde bdod sdug bsngal mi 'dod kun mthun bzhin// blang dor go log ma song dgos pa lags// tsher ma tsam zhig zug kyang mi bzod na// ngan song dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal ci zhig bzod// 'khor ba gar skyes bde ba spu tsam med// myang 'das byang chub ci 'grub rem dgos lags/

215)/ngan song 'khor ba'i 'jigs chen skyabs nus ni// bla ma dkon mchog las gzhan ma mchis tshe// dad gus drag pos skyabs 'gro gsol 'debs la// 'bad na dkon mchog thugs rje mi bslu lags// mkha' khyab sems can thams cad tshe rabs kyi// pha ma drin can ma byas su yang med// drin lan ma 'khor gnod sems ci la byed// snying rje byang sems ci sgrub dgos lags// bde gshegs ma lus tshogs gnyis rdzogs byed las byung*// tshogs bsags sgrib pa ma sbyang don mi 'grub// rtag par lus dang longs spyod sgo gsum kun// dkar phyogs dge la sbyor ba brtson dgos lags// sangs rgyas thams cad ngo bo dbyer med gcig /so so'i dad mos gar yod byin rlabs myur// byin rlabs zhes bya dad mos rang gzugs yin// dag snang gang cher byin rlabs 'jug pa lags// rang la sku drin che ba'i bla ma de// o rgyan dngos yin the tshom bya mi rung*// skyid sdug 216)na tsha 'chi rkyen gang byung yang*// blo gtad snying nas byed nus dgos pa lags// gsang sngags zab mo'i chos sgor zhugs phyin chad// sgo gsum tha mal 'khrul rjes 'brang mi rung*// lus lha tshig sngags sems nyid chos dbyings su// ye nas yin pa'i nges shes dgos pa lags// 'gro 'dug za nyal spyod pa gang byed kyang*// lha dang bla ma yid la dran pa dang*// dge ba thams cad sems can don du bsngo// rang sems rang tshod zin pa gal che lags// mdor na nyin mtshan dus kun thams cad du// rang sems dpang btsug dkon mchog mi khrel bar// lus ngag yid gsum chos dang ci mthun la// mi tshe'i lhag ma gang byung 'khyol bar mdzod/ ces pa ni sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa don 'grub tshe ring la gdams pa'o// na mo gu ru/ gang gis mtshan tsam dran pas kyang*// byin rlabs nus pa bsam yas kyis// gdul bya'i re ba skongs mdzad pa'i// pad+ma 'byung gnas zhabs la 'dud// dad ldan

217)mkhas grub rgya mtsho yis// zhal gdams dgos zhes bskul ba las// bya bral sna tshogs rang grol gyi// snying gtam tshig gsum 'di skad lo// mi lus lan cig thob pa 'di// don med stong zad byed mkhan mang*// yang yang dal 'byor mi thob pas// dge la 'bad pa snying gtam yin// mi tshe'i nyi ma rmi lam tsam// gcig shi gnyis shi'i ro los de// rang la myur du bab nges pas// 'byod med grabs chud snying gtam yin// dge sdig rgyu 'bras mi bslu bas// skyid du re nas sdig byas te// lto gos nor rdzas bsgrubs na yang*// phan med gnod do snying gtam yin// pha ma bu tsha gnyen 'khor la// sha tsha'i sems kyis 'jig rten 'di'i// bya bas rang don rlags pa mang*// gtan 'dun sgrub pa snying gtam yin// 'jig rten pher pher yong yong gi// bya byed mang na phung ba'i rgyu/ 218)/kun mthun snyom chung spyod pa dang*// dman sa bzung ba snying gtam yin// rang sems drang po'i gzhung bsrang na// su ma mgu yang 'gyod pa med// g.yo khram zol rdzun mi bya bar// blo zu byed pa snying gtam yin// bla ma dkon mchog ma gtogs pa// gtan gyi skabs gnas thub pa med// skyid sdug byung bla ma la// gsol ba gdab pa snying gtam yin// blo rgyud las su ma rung na// btsun gzugs byas kyang chos pa min// dkor gyi 'khur bcas thar lam med// rang rgyud thul ba snying gtam yin// nyams len gang yang mi nus par// shes shes mang pos phan pa med// nus pa yig drug gcig pus kyang*// sangs rgyas 'grub po snying gtam yin// dag snang phyogs med ma byas na// chags sdang kun slong sgrib pa che// chos dang gang zag thams cad la// skur pa mi 'debs snying gtam yin// sangs rgyas thams cad bla mar 'dus// bla ma'i mchog gyur pad+ma 'byung*// gsol 219)ba rtse gcig btab nus na// chos go chod do snying gtam yin// mdor na 'di phyi bar do gsum// bla ma dran zhing dge la 'bad// gtan gyi 'dun ma de yis 'grub// thugs la zhog mdzod snying gtam yin// snying gtam bcu gnyis tshigs bcad 'di// ma brjed snying gi dkyil du bstim// 'di yi dge bas 'gro kun kyang*// dam pa'i chos la 'khod par shog

ces mkhas grub rgya mtsho la gdams pa'o// ༈ gang la brten na srid pa'i sdug bsngal kun// yang dag zhi mdzad dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs// 'di bzung tshe rabs kun tu btud byas nas// snying gtam tshig gsum bshad kyi yid la bzung*// dal 'byor legs thob sangs rgyas bstan dang mjal// dbang po kun tshang rang dbang yod dus 'dir// 'jig rten g.yeng ba byed par mi khom pas// sgo gsum dge la 'bod cig gtan 'dun yin// nam 'chi cha med rgan gzhon la ma ltos/ 220) /shi rkyen ci 'dras byed pa ma nges tshe// mi tshe ring po'i rgyags grabs bya don med// 'chi dus 'gyod med dgos so blo na stungs// tshe 'dir nor rdzas gnyen 'khor 'jig rten gyi// pher yo ji tsam yod bzhin rnam g.yeng che// chos dang 'gal ba'i rgyu rkyen de las 'byung*// blo sna nang du khug dang bsam pa 'grub// dam chos snying por rang rgyud thul dgos pas// gzhan gyi skyon la ma blta rang skyong brtag /sdom pa dam tshig kun gyi rtsa ba ni// rang sems rang gis 'dul ba gal du che// bslab shes yon tan ji ltar che bzhin du// ngar 'dzin khengs sems 'phel zhing dkor la ham// snyigs dus chos pa'i bub sa 'di yin pas// snyom chung spros med byas na chos dang mthun// lus srog 'tsho tsam ji ltar byas kyang 'ongs// bag med chang dang dge 'dun dkor zas la// ci thob byed pa'i btsun gzugs rgyal 'gong dngos// nyes 221)dmigs 'khur bcas thar lam re thag chad// rgyu 'bras go zhing shes kyang khyad gsad nas// g.yo sgyu zog khram kho nas dus 'das yang*// chos gos sham thabs bzang pos brgyan byed pa// rang gis rang nyid bslu zhing phung tshabs che// nyin zhag re la skyabs 'gro tshar gcig kyang*// mi nus bzhin du lto gos 'tshol thabs la// nyin mtshan bar med rgyug cing rems pa yi// chos gzugs 'di dag 'gro sa ngan song yin// bla ma dkon mchog rnams la blo khel na// 'di phyi'i don chen de yis 'grub na yang*// log min dran rgya che bas dam tshig rul// dad med byin rlabs 'jug pa ci la srid// chos la bzang ngan yod pa ma yin kyang*// gang zag rang snang dag dang ma dag khyad// des na rang sems dag snang phyogs med sbyongs// blo gtad gcig thog dril na de kas chog

/gzhis byes lam dang 'gro 'dug 222)nam du yang*// sgo gsum dge sbyor zhor la ma 'bad na// dal khom shoms la bsgugs ring mi tshe zad// 'chi bdag dal khom brtsi ba mi srid do// skyid sdug gang byung bla ma'i byin rlabs su// shes na bar chad 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen zad// na tsha sdug bsngal gang yang sgrib sbyong du// go bar bya zhing smon lam bzang po gdab// zhe sdang la sogs nyon mongs dug lnga'i sems// nam skyes nyon mongs rang gar mi btang bar// rgyu 'bras dam sdom yid la dran pa yis// chos pa'i zhabs 'dren mi 'gyur gnyen po bsten// rang nyid rgyal 'dod mtho 'dod grags 'dod kyi// 'phral yun 'dun ma 'chugs cing chos dang 'gal// de phyir bzang ngan 'bring gsum gong du 'khur// dman sa snying nas bzung na don chen 'grub// chos 'di lo zla gcig gnyis ma yin par// mi tshe gang byung de srid 'khyol dgos pas// na so song bzhin chos dred 223)byed mkhan mang*// rgas kha shi khar zhan du ma song dgos// mdor na 'di phyi bar do thams cad du// bla ma dran zhing nyams len brtson pa dang*// dam sdom rgyu 'bras ngo lkog med pa ru// rang sems dpang 'dzug dkon mchog mi khrel bya// sgo gsum snyom las mi bzhag dge la 'bad// dag snang mos gus snying rje gong 'phel bslab// do nub shi sang dam chos la gtogs pa// bsam mno gzhan du ma byed snying gtam yin// snying gtam sems bzhag na gdam ngag yin// don de lag thog 'khel na dam chos yin// chos dang sems su 'dres na chos pa yin// de bzhin thugs la bzhog cig ma brjed cig /mi rgan lhag bsam bzang ba'i drang gtam 'di// gzhan la skur zhus ma yin phan phyir yin// 'di las byung ba'i dge tshogs ji snyed mthus// 'gro kun dam pa'i chos la 'khod gyur cig

ces don gnyis 224) mchog grub la gdams pa'o// ༈ dal 'byor mi lus thob pa da res tsam// don med stong zad ma byed don ldan mdzod// 'chi ba nam yong nges pa ci yang med// shi khar 'gyod pa med pa'i grabs chud mdzod// dge sdig rgyu 'bras bslu bar mi srid pas// dkar nag go log ma bsgrub spang blang mdzod// kha yengs mig yengs ngang la mi tshe 'gro// nam khom dge sbyor gang la gang 'gro 'bungs// rang gi sems rgyud thul bar ma nus na// kha bshad mkhas kyang chos pa'i zhabs 'dren mang*// dag snang med na zhor la sdig sgrib gsog /dag snang phyogs med sbyang ba gnad du che// lto gos ma 'dzom dogs pa kun gyis byed// dam chos ma 'grub dogs pa byed mkhan dkon// bla ma'i byin rlabs dad pa kho nar rag /log lta mkhan la byin rlabs 'jug yul med// dad pa zer yang ci mdzad legs mthong dgos/ 225)/'gyur ldog can gyi dad pas go mi chod// dam tshig zer yang ngos lkog med gal che// nyes ltung lkog bsags rang gi rang bslu yin// 'jig rten 'dun 'gros shes pa mang na yang*// chos kyi 'dun gros bslab mkhan nyan mkhan dkon// de phyir tshe 'di'i dka' las ma bsam par// phyi ma'i lam sna bsgrub thabs bsam par mdzod// 'gro 'dug nyin mtshan dus rnams thams cad du// rtsa ba'i bla ma o rgyan cha byad can// spyi bo'i steng gi 'ja' 'od klong bzhugs bsam// le bdun la sogs gsol 'debs gang nus bya// badz+ra gu ru'i bzlas pa rgyun du bgrangs// ci za ci 'thung bla ma mchod par bsam// na tsha skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang*// bsam sa re sa bla ma gcig bus mchog /shi khar rig pa bla ma'i thugs kar gtad// lam bzang 'pho ba zer yang 'di nyid lags// nyams len gcig 226)dril blo thag ma bcad na// thob thob shes shes mang yang phan par dka'// de bas mos gus rtse gcig 'di la 'bad// mi gcig chos gcig gcig thog 'di la dril// nges shes 'grongs pa gnad kyi mthar thug yin// shi rung gson rung nyams len 'di nas chog

/kha la ma khyer sems la 'dre bar mdzod/ /ces yon tan dbang phyug la gdams so// ༈ gang zhig dad pas gsol btab na// bslu ba med pa'i byin rlabs mchog /nges stsol sgrub rgyud bla ma'i zhabs// 'bral med gus pas bstud byas nas/ ༈ rigs rus mchog las legs bltams shing*// dam chos skal ba bzang mo can// dge ba'i thugs lhan chos zung la// ring mo'i sa nas mchid 'di gsol// dad pa'i snyim pas legs 'thor ba'i// shis pa brjod tshig yig phreng gis// ge sar ze'u 'bru rnam gsal ni/ 227) /lha gos 'dab brgya g.yo ba 'byor/ ༈ 'khor ba dug gi 'dam rdzab la// dug tu shes pas rab spangs te// thar gling byang chub skam sa ru// ring par bgrod pa ngo mtshar che/ ༈ phyogs dus rgyal ba gaṅga'i klung*// bye snyed rnams kyi spyi gzugs ni// mtshan ldan bla ma gang de yi// zhabs pad bsten pa'i skal ldan ma/ ༈ dad pa'i myu gu skye 'phro la// log lta'i than pa 'byung nyen yod// mos gus chu lud ma zhan na// thugs rje lo 'bras 'byung bar nges/ ༈ tshe gcig thar lam snyogs dus 'dir// las nyon bag chags 'phrang 'gag dam// dug lnga 'khrul zhen jag pa rgod/ nges 'byung skyel ma 'bral med mdzod/ ༈ sems nyid phyag rgya chen po ni// ye nas rang la lhun grub kyang*// dbul po'i khyim gyi gter lta bu// rang la rang gi ma rig 'asgribs/ ༈ bla ma'i 228) drin gyis rnyed dus 'dir// g.yeng ba'i dgra la ma shor ba'i// yengs med dran pa'i mel tshe dang*// snying rus mkhar so bzung 'tshal lo/ ༈ tshogs drug yul snang 'char sgo 'di// rang sems rtsal las gzhan min yang*// byis pa 'bag 'cham mthong ba ltar// bden lta 'dzin pas rnam par 'khrul/ ༈ 'khrul pa'i rang mtshang rig thabs las/ gzhan pa'i lta sgom med na yang*// sgom blo'i zhen pas bcings pa mang*// mi sgom ma yengs mkhyen par mdzod/ ༈ sangs rgyas dngos kyi bla ma brnyed// gdams ngag 'dud rtsi'i gter sgo phyes// phun sum tshogs pa'i dus gcig 'dir// nyams len ran pa gal du che/

༈ chos sgor zhugs pa mang lags kyang*// chos bzhin spyod pa nyung lags dang*// mtha' ru phyin pa dkon tshul dang*// gzigs nas tshe dang bsgrub mnyam zhu/ ༈ mi rgan 229)mig dbang mi gsal bas// yig gzugs srin bu'i rjes 'dra 'di// gzigs par dka' yang don la dpyod// thugs la bcag nges mdzad par gsol/ ༈ de skad byin rlabs myong grol dang*// bcas te dbo zla'i dkar tshes la// chos dbyings 'od gsal rtse mo nas// phul 'dir mchod gnyis thugs dgyes shig ces pa 'di mnyam med sgal po pa'i rigs dbon sku mdun rje btsun ma mchod gnyis la phul ba'o/ ༈ skal ldan dzña na pha la yis// zhal gdams dgos zhes gang gsungs ba// sangs rgyas mngon sum der bzhugs bzhin// bdag 'dra'i zhal gdams ci zhig bya// 'on kyang bzhed pa skong slad du// gang drang tshig 'ga' smras pa 'di// khyed thugs rgyud dang 'dres pa yi// lag len thog tu khril mdzad zhu/ kye ma/ tshe 'di mi rtag rnam kyang 'chi// na so rgan gzhon ma ltos pas// blo sna ring 230)po'i sgo bshom spongs// 'chi dus 'gyod med grabs mdzod cig /dbang po dwangs shing rig gsal yang*// chos 'di zhor la shes pa dka'// chos min ma bslabs shes 'gyur pas// blo rgyud chos dang mthun mdzod cig /bla ma'i gzugs tsam 'dzin pa mang*// mtshan nyid ldan pa gser las dkon// sangs rgyas mngon sum mjal dus 'dir// zhabs tog ci gsungs sgrub mdzod cig /rang gi 'dod dang mthun pa na// dad pa che skad byed na yang*// rang 'dod cung zad ma byung na// log lta skye bas gzab mdzod cig /bla ma'i ci gsungs bsgrub nus na// chos kyi skal ba de yis chog /bla ma mi dgyes thos bsam sgom// don med yin no dgongs mdzod cig /sangs rgyas bstan pa zhugs phyin chad// dam tshig sdom pa gtsang nges dgos// rgyu 'bras mi 'dzoms btsun gzugs de// ru dra yin 231)

pa mkhyen mdzod cig /za 'thung dkor gyi rang bzhin la// chog tshod med na khyi ltogs 'dra// lus srog 'tsho thub kho nas chog /'dod zhen sred pa spong mdzod cig /thob thob zhus zhus mang po'i chos// nyams len med na phan par dka'// blo gtad thub pa'i chos cig la// smar 'jus nyams su longs mdzod cig /gzhis byes lam gsum nyin mtshan kun// ci nus dge sbyor ma byas na// mtshams dang dal khom sgug ring la// mi tshe zad pa tshor mdzod cig /bla ma mched grogs drag zhan su// gang gi skyon la mi lta bar// rang skyon brtag cing nan gyis spongs// kun la dag snang 'byongs mdzod cig /mdor na mi tshe yud tsam 'di// don med zad du ma bcug par// bla ma mnyes pa'i zhabs tog dang*// mdo don chos la dril mdzod cig 232) /mi rgan bslab bya tshig gsum 'di// snyan ngag sdeb sbyor mi ldan yang*// don la dgos pa'i gnad 'gag yod// thugs la legs par bstim mdzod cig /snying gtam snying la bcags pa dang*// lag len lag thog 'khel gyur nas// tshe 'di tshe rabs kun tu yang*// don gnyis don mchog 'grub gyur cig / ces skyabs mchog mtshungs pa ma mchis pa lha'i lhar gyur pa gang gi zhabs pad nye bar sten pa dzñā na ba yi bzhed skongs su/ rgan po pad+ma legs grub kyis/ 'od gsal rtse mo'i daden khrod du bris pa / / ༈ rigs rus cho 'brang 'jig rten gyi// zhen spangs dam pa'i chos kho nar// legs brtson nges don mchog grub pa'i// ming dang don mthun bskal bzang nyid/ ༈ ji skad gsungs ltar 'khor 'das chos ma lus// sems nyid gcig pu'i rol pa las ma 'das// de lta'ang rang sems rang tshod ma zin pas// rmi lam 233)'dra ba'i 'khrul 'khor 'di yis bslus/ ༈ rang sems nor bu rin chen la// yengs med dran pas ma ma chod na// nyams rtogs 'dod dgu mi 'byung phyir// rang ngo rang rig byi dor 'tshal/

༈ gnas skabs ltar snang g.yeng ba'i bye brag dang*// rje btsun bla ma'i bka' yi khol po sogs// kun kyang rang rig dran pas khyab nges nas// lhag bsam dag pas lhur blangs zol med 'bungs/ ༈ dran pa skyong ba'i mkhan po dang*// skyong rgyu'i shes pa so la ni// tha dad min phyir rang snang gi /'char tshul wal po 'di ka la/ ༈ mi 'dzin ma zhen dgag sgrub bcos slad kyis// bsgyur bkod gang yang mi bya rang gi rang*// rig tsam dran tsam gu yangs khrol le ba// shes rig rjen pa 'di ka ma brjed bya/ ༈ sems la sems kyis bcings pa'i nyams// sdug 234)btsir bsgom mkhan mang mod kyi// ci ltar 'char ba'i snang sems kun// shar mkhan rig na de kas chog ༈ dran pa rgyun chags re zhig dka' na yang*// 'khrul pa'i chos la zhen 'dzin ci chung gis// rnam par rtog pa gcig skyes gnyis skyes la// cer cer hrig hrig ngo yis zin par mdzod/ ༈ mtshan snang ji bzhin zin pa la// nyin snang dran rig 'khor yug dgos// de yang gnyid kyis thim rim gyis// bar du chod pas cung zhig dka'/ ༈ 'on kyang 'od gsal 'dzin la gom pa'am// sngon sbyangs shugs dang bla ma'i byin rlabs sogs// rten 'brel mtshams sbyor mthu la ma nges te// gtso bor nyid snang 'phro mthud gal che lags/ ༈ rtag tu 'chi ba bsam zhing cis kyang dgos med dran// bla mas rang sems dbyer med rig pa yengs med bskyang*// rgyu 'bras 235)bslu med bsam zhing dam sdom srog bzhin bsrung*// sgo gsum dge la rems pa'i dge rtsa 'gro la bsngo/ ༈ rgan po'i snying gtam tshig gsum 'di// srin bu'i rjes 'dra'i yig gzugs su// bkod do phul 'di'i rnam kar mthus// khyed thugs phyag rgya che 'grub shog ces zab mo nges pa'i don bzang mchog tu grub pa'i skal bzang mngon par mtho ba gang gi bzhed don skongs phyir la gcig tu pa bsam/ sna tshogs rang grol kyi ming tsam 'chang ba'i rmongs rgan gyis chos dbyings 'od gsal rtse po'i ri bor bris pa dge'o//

༈ snying gtam tshigs su bcad pa lags/ chos kun snying po'i mthar thug phyag rgya che// ston mdzad sgrub rgyud bla mar gus btud nas// nges pa'i don la brtson pa'i rab gsal ba/ snying gtam bshad 'di thugs la gces par zung// bskal pa grangs med skye ba'i 'pheng rgyud kyang*// bstan pa'i snying por zhugs pa da res tsam// da dung phyis nas 'di ltar 'byor ba dka'// da lta gtan 'dun sgrub dus lan 236)gcig lags// dal 'byor lus 'di'i lang tsho 'phral 'phral rgud// tshe yi dbang skal lo zla zhag gi zad// ma tshor 'chi ba'i dus la tug gi slebs// 'gyod med grabs chud bya ba'i dus la babs// rigs rus stobs 'byor gang che sdig pa'i rgyu// yon tan shes rgya'i khengs pas ngan song bsgrub// 'jig rten pher yo can tsho gtan phung 'gro// rtse gcig sgrub pa las gzhan snying pos dben// skyid 'dod lto gos 'dzom tshe sgrub sgrub nas// dgos nges phyi ma'i don chen ma grub pas// shi khar kha chems 'jog pa'i chos pa 'khrul// blo sna thung ba'i mi la khe gcig yod// dam chos byed 'dod yod pa shin tu mang*// byas par rlom pa'i chos gzugs de bas mang*// snying nas rtse gcig nus mkhan rab tu nyung*// chos de rgyud la khel nges dgos pa lags// 'gro ba'i mgon po mnyam med 'dzam gling grags// gang sku'i 237)bkod pa dngos su mjal dus 'dir// ci mdzad legs mthong mos gus rtse gcig pas// gdams ngag phu thag gcod la 'bad dgos so// rang sems bla ma chos skur dbyer med kyang*// 'dus byas gzugs sku'i bla mar 'du 'bral yod// sku 'bum 'dra 'bag mjal tshe cung zad phyis// da lta ci gsung bsgrub pa gal re che// tshe 'di'i skyid sdug rmi lam snang ba tsam// bsam mno sgo bshom mang po'i thog babs dka'// gang 'byung bla ma'i thugs rjer lam du 'khyer// bsam rgyu dge sbyor kho nar hril gyi dril// rnam rtog 'char sgo mang ba skyon med kyang*// de la zhen 'dzin byas na las ngan gsog

/gcig shar gnyis shar rang ngo shes kyis dang*// rnam rtog chos skur shar ba dka' las med// lam rtags nyams rtogs yon tan nam 'ong snyam// re 'dod byas tshad bdud kyi bslu brid byung*// shi rung gson rung rig pa 238)rjen pa bskyang*// nor 'khrul shor gol de la yong don med// ro snyoms brtul zhugs spyod mkhan mang lags kyang*// chos brgyad dri mas ma sbags gar yang dkon// tshig zur mtho dman skyo tsha'i zhim mngar tsam// mi bzod rang 'tshang ston pa'i sgom chen mang*// rgyal ba'i chos kun rang rgyud 'dul thabs nyid// mdo sngags gnyis ka nyon mongs rang dag tu// ma shor thabs su dgongs pa gcig pas nas// don gyi gnad 'gag zin pa gal cher gda'// gzhi byes lam dang tshogs dben nam du yang*// rgyu 'bras dam sdom ngos lkog med pa yi// spang blang phra mo'ang khyad du mi gsod par// lha dang bla ma mnyes pa'i spyod pa spyad// nyin mtshan snyom las mi sdod dge sbyor rems// gzhan gyi skyon la mi rtog rang skyong brtag /dge 'dun 'gro ba'i don bsngo rang 'khris spangs// rtag tu de bzhin mdzod 239)cig snying gtam yin// mang du bshad kyang tshig la zad mtha' med// dgos don sems la len na gdams ngag yin// gdams ngag kha khyer ma mdzad lag thog longs// 'di yis dge bas mthong thos smin grol shog ces dad ldan sgam po ye shes rab gsal la dge sbyor gyi gzhan bskul du dmigs nas/ rgan po pad+ma legs grub rtsal gyis thang 'grog 'od gsal rtse mo'i mtshams mal du bris te phul ba maṅga lam// ༈ e ma skal ldan thar pa sgrub bzhed pa'i// rgyal ba'i zhabs 'bring rab dga' gson mdzod dang*// dal 'byor lan gcig thob 'di stong zad du// shor nyen ches pas chos la 'bad re ran// rtags tsam bsgyur zhing byed blo'i chos gzugs 'dis// 'chi khar mi phan dkor gyi g.yab shing lags// rgyal ba sgrub rgyud gong ma'i mdzad srol ltar// sgrub la snying rus 'bad na don chen 'grub// bla ma sangs rgyas dngos dang

240)mjal dus 'dir// ci mdzad legs mthong ngam tshig gtsang ma gces// rang sems chos kyis thul bar ma gyur na// shes shes mang po khengs pa 'phel byed yin// rtag tu rang sems gtsang mar ma byas tshe// sdom pa dam tshig phyi dkar nang nag 'byung*// rang zog rang la 'tshong pa'i btsun gzugs kyis// chos gos rnam dpyod gtsang yang rgyal 'gong yin// rgyu 'bras bslu med rang rgyud 'dres nges pas// 'chi khar 'gyod pa med pa'i mdun gros 'tshal// thos bsam sgom pa'i don po sems 'dul thabs// nyon mongs kha rgyal mi btang gnyen po bsten// skyid rung sdug rung bla mar blo 'khel na// mo bon rtsis gsum mi dgos gtan don 'grub// bla mas gang gsungs the tshom med sgrub pa'i// dam tshig can la byin rlabs ngang gis 'jug /chos kyi snying po nges don ma rtogs na/ 241) /ltar snang gzi brjid che yang sangs mi rgya// 'khor ba'i sa bon bdag 'dzin rnam rtog 'di// phyag rgya chen por 'khyer thabs gcig dril 'bungs// nyin mtshan snyom las spangs nas dge sbyor mdzod// rang gzhan don kun lhun grub 'byung ba lags/

/ces khams gsum 'dren mchog rgyal ba sprul pa'i zla snang bzang po'i mtshan gyi zhabs 'bring ba thub bstan rab dga'i bzhed pa skong phyir/ spong ba pa rgan po sna tshogs rang grol gyi phul ba dge'o// ༈ dran pa tsam gyi 'khor ba'i bag chags zhi// mthong thos reg pas thar pa'i sa bon thebs// gsol ba btab na byin rlabs 'byung ba yi// mtshungs bral bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ ༈ 'dus ma'i mtha' ma bral ba'i chos can gyi// rang bzhin skye 'gro kun gyi mtshan nyid las// ring du 'grogs nas so sor gyes pa yis// grogs la snying gtam 'gro chos 'di skad gdams/ ༈ dal 242)'byor phun tshogs thob kyang rtag mi thub// na so gzhon yang tshe la nges pa med// yong snyam med par 'chi ba thog bab 'ong*// long yod snyom las blo sna ma ring mdzod/ ༈ legs nyes skyid sdug thams cad sngon gyi las// pher yong sgo bshom mkhas kyang bkos tshad rag /'dun ma chos phyogs dril na bub mi srid// blo gtad bla mar bgyis dang bslu ba med/ ༈ mi khyur sdod na legs legs mdzes mdzes kyi// chos brgyad snang shas 'di la kun spro yang*// mi tshe stong zad gtan phung rgyu yin pas// spros med bya gtang ri khrod 'grim na legs/ ༈ bza' btung gos rgyan 'bol 'bol bshom bshom gyi// 'dod pa rtsol sgrub byas bzhin chog shes med// bem dugs skyo tsha ja la blo thag bcad// sgrub rgyud skyes chen rnams kyi mdzad srol ltos/ ༈ 'jig rten 'khor ba'i gnyen la zhen chags kyis// grong yul 243)thags ltar bran nas rgyug byed pas// mtha' mar khyi rgan las kyang lod de 'chi// btsun pa'i rkang 'dren yin no rang tshugs bzung*/ ༈ grogs ngan skye ba dman pa'i bud med dang*// zas ngan smyo byed rdzas chen chang rag la// zhen sred gting nas spong bar mi byed na// thar pa'i srog rtsa chad do snying rus skyed/ ༈ gnyid dang rnam g.ye long gtam dal 'dug dang*// nyin par nyal dang don med bya byed rigs// thos bsam sgom pa'i bar chad kun la 'dzem// rang khrims rang la bcas pa chos pa'i gnad/

༈ rang gis gzhan skyon mthong ba ji tsam las// lhag pa gzhan gyis rang la mthong 'gyur bas// gzhan skyon mi lta rang skyong 'dul la 'bad// rang snang dag na gzhan skyon mthong mi srid/ ༈ chos kyi rtsa ba rgyu 'bras bslu med tshul// mdo rgyud man 244)ngag kun mthun spang blang bya// dge sdig phra mo tsam la'ang khyad mi gsad// ngos skog med pa dam sdom rtsa ba yin/ ༈ bla ma'i mdzad pa gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul la// skyon du bltas na byin rlabs skal pa chad// bla ma mched grogs ci mdzad logs mthong gi /dag snang can la thugs rje rgyun mi chad/ ༈ rtag tu lus ngag yid gsum chos min las// spangs nas dge sbyor chos spyod bcu la 'bad// gzhis byes lam gsum khyad med dge sbyor la// brtson na mi tshe chos la 'khyol bar 'gyur/ ༈ na tsha rkyen ngan sdug bsngal ci byung yang// skyabs dang re sa bla ma dkon mchog la// blo snying brang gsum lings bskyur mi nus par// phan thabs gzhan du 'tshol na chos pa min/ ༈ rang nyid thos bsam sgom pa phyogs re tsam// gang gi'ang nges pa brnyes pa med bzhin du// grub mtha' chos rgyud gang zag su dang 245)sur// log lta chags sdang skur 'debs byar mi rung*/ ༈ ci phyir zhe na rgyal rnams thabs mkhas dang*// thugs rjes gdul bya'i skal ba gang 'tshams par// chos kyi rnam grangs gang 'dul bstan pas na// chos lugs nga bzang phyogs zhen byar mi rung*/ ༈ chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong thams cad kyang*// mthar thug rang sems 'dul thabs kho na yin// don la snang srid 'khor 'das sems su gcig /bye brag du mar snang yang rmi lam tsam/ ༈ sems nyid stong pa ngos bzung bral ba la// lha dang 'dre ru bzung ba 'khrul 'dzin yin// 'khrul la 'khrul par ma shes bden 'dzin 'dis// 'khor bar gtan 'khyams gyur pa de yis lan/ ༈ da nas 'khrul med rang rig rjen pa 'di// yengs med 'dzin bral ma bcos rang babs skyong*// tshogs drug snang ba bzang ngan ci shar la// bden zhen ma

246)byed g.yas med bskyur la zhog ༈ 'dzin pa ma byas 'khrul pa'i rgyu rkyen med// 'khrul snang zad na chos sku rang sems yin// rang sems sangs rgyas mngon du gyur pa'i tshe// chos kyi dgos don grub pa yin no bu/ ༈ mdor na dus dang rnam pa thams cad du// mi rtag 'chi ba dran bya dge sbyor 'bungs// 'jig rten zhen pa bskyur la bya btang dril// nyon mongs dug lnga rang gar mi btang ngo*/ ༈ bla ma sangs rgyas mthong bas gsol ba gdab// 'gro kun pha mar shes pas byang sems sbyongs// gang la'ang gnod 'tshe spang zhing phan pa sgrubs// rang rgyud chos kyis thul zhig snying gtam yin/ ༈ da ni bskal pa'i tha ma dus ngan gyi// rnam 'gyur mi rung sna dgu tshang lugs la// mi tshe ring po'i blo sna mi khoms pas// sems rgyud nang du khug cig snying gtam yin/ ༈ sna tshogs rang grol rgan po 'chi kha las// sems la bcags pa'i snying gtam zab 247)mo 'di// khyed la brtse bas gdams so ma brjed par/ snying la phan pa'i bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog / ces rang gi rtsa grwa 'phrin las don grub pa'i skye ba la gdams pa'o// ༈ rigs rus longs spyod 'jig rten bde 'byor la// ma chags nges par 'gyur bas yid drangs te// bla med byang chub sgrub pa'i skal ba can/ grub chen dharma ma ṇi gsan mdzod dang*// dal 'byor thob cing chos sgor zhugs na yang*// nam 'chi cha med snying nas ma dran na// kun rdzob tshe 'di'i bya bas bslus pa mang*// long med rgyud la bskyed pa gal du che/ 1 /mdo rgyud man ngag chos kun gdul bya yi// blo rgyud gdul thabs kho nar gsungs na yang*/ thos bsam sgom yus khengs sems che ba mang*// rang rgyud gting nas thul ba gal du che/ 2 /bla ma mtshan ldan rnyed dka' brnyed nas kyang*// gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i bcud la spyod dus 'dir// mnyam 'grogs log ltas dam sel 247) 'jug pa mang*// ci mdzad legs mthong mos gus gal du che/

3 /bag chags 'khrul 'dzin dbyings su ma thim par// de srid dge sdig rgyu 'bras bslu ba med// sgom chen las 'bras khyad du gsad mkhan mang*// dam sdom rgyu 'bras zhib pa gal du che/ 4 /chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong ji rnyed pa// yang snying phyag rgya chen por ma 'dus med// kha bshad tshig gis don la sgribs pa mang*// nges don sems la sbyor pa gal du che/ 5 /sems kyi 'gyu dran rtog tshogs phra rags la// ma zhen ma dgag rang rig dran pas bskyangs// nam mkhar sprin dang rba rlabs chur thim bzhin// rang shar rang grol gtong ba gal du che/ 6 /rkyen dang ma phrad bde bde 'dra ba'i sgom// rkyen ngan byung tshe 'khrul dbang shor mkhan mang*// 'khor 'das thams cad sems su thag chod pas// gang la'ang re dogs spong ba gal du che/ 7 mdor 249)na lus sems ma bral ring du la// bsam rgyu bla ma bya rgyu dam pa'i chos// da lta 'chi yang bla ma'i gdams ngag las// gzhan pa'i bsam blo mi byed gal du che/ 8 /tshe 'di'i bya ba'i kho thag rbad kyi chad// nyin mtshan nam yang dge sbyor rtse gcig 'bad// bla mar gsol gdab 'gro kun snying rjes bskyang*// tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa gal che lags/ 9 /gal chen dgu yi snying gtam mdor bsdus ni// dad ldan chos mdzad dam chos nor bu la// chos dbyings 'od gsal rtse mo'i ri khrod nas// pad+ma legs grub rtsal gyis gdams pa dge'o/ ༈ rgyal ba thams cad bla ma kho na'i 'phrul/ /yin la yin par shes pa'i mos gus kyis// rtag tu btud nas skal ldan don gnyer ba// yon tan ming can de la 'di ltar gdams// dal 'byor thob 'di gtong zad ma byed par// ci nus dge sbyor 'bad pa gal 250)re che// 'chi ba nam mkha'i thog ltar myur du 'ong*// 'jig rten zhen pa ma che blo na bstungs// tshe 'di'i bya ba zin pa'i dus tshod med// spros pa bcad na zin pa de ga yin// dge sdig spang zhib ma nor la 'bar na// dkar nag bde sdug 'bras bu bslu mi srid// sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma'i rnam par thar// ci mdzad legs mthong mos gus 'gyur med bya// gsol 'debs nus na byin rlabs ngang gis 'byung*// thugs rje che chung dad pa nyid la rag

/skyid sdug legs nyes gang byung bla ma rje'i// byin rlabs kho nar shes pas gtan mdun 'grub// grub mtha' phyogs 'dzin chos pa'i phung 'dre yin// dag snang phyogs med sbyang na don gnyis 'grub// 'khor 'das kun gyi rtsa ba rang sems 'di// 'khrul pa'i ngang la mi btang dran pa bsten// rnam rtog bkag pas mi khegs rang ngo ltos// lta sa lta mkhan sems nyid kho rang yin// kho rang 251)rang ngo rig thog lhod gyi glod// sgo gsum zhen 'dzin med pa gnad du che// tshogs drug yul phyir ma 'brang rang sar zhog /zhen pa med na 'ching ba kun dang bral// na tsha rkyen ngan 'jig skrag ci byung yang*// sems kyi 'char tshul yin par blo thag bcad// shi rung gson rung chos dang bla ma las// gzhan pa'i bsam rgyu med par thag chod bya// dge ba gang byed mkha' khyab sems can rnams// byang chub thob phyir bsngo ba smon lam gdab// snying gtam tshig 'di kha khyer ma byed par// sems la 'dres nges mdzod cig dge legs 'phel// zhes pa 'di ni mi rigs skad rigs mi gcig pa'i yul khams nas 'ongs pa'i dad can karma gu ṇa'i ming can gyis bskul ngor gdams pa'o// ༈ na mo gu ru rat+na bh+yaḥ gang zhig 'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad kyi// gnas lugs ji bzhin gzigs 252)pas rgyal dgongs nyid/ 'gro la mngon sum ston pa'i phye'i dpal/ gang la mnga' ba'isgrub rgyud bla ma'i zhabs// gus pas lan brgyar gtud nas nges don gyi// snying po'iyang bcud zhal nas snyan rgyud pa'i// nges don zab mo smros zhes gang gsungs ltar// ci nus phul 'di thugs la nyer bstim gsol// de la spyir 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos kyi 'khor lo yongs su bskor bar mdzad pa thams cad don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ skyon thams cad dang bral ba yon tan kun dang ldan pa/ thog mtha'i bar gsum du dge ba'i gter gyis gtam pa 'ba' zhiganyid las/

bzang ngan nam/ mtho dman nam/ zab mi zab sogs kyi khyad par can zhig ni gang yang ma yin mod kyang*/ chos de dag gis gdul bar bya ba'i 'gro ba rnams dbang po dang*/ khams dang bsam pa dang skal ba'i rigs tha dad 253)pas/ chos kyi tshig gcig kho na la yang so so'i rgyud la go myong rtogs pa'i tshul mi gcig pa mtha' yas pa zhig tu 'gyur la/ de'i mthus lam dang 'bras bu mngon du gyur tshul yang ring ba dang nye ba dang shin tu nye ba dag 'byung ba'i dbang gis/ theg pa dman 'bring chen po'i bye brag tu tha snyad btags mod kyi// don dam pa'i mthar thug tu ni chos kyi dbyings gdod ma'i gnas lugs nyid las nam yang g.yo ba med cing 'khor 'das dus gsum gyi mtshan ma'i spros pa thams cad las 'das pa kho na ste/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin ni 'di lta bur gdod nas lhun gyis grub pa'o/ de ltar mod kyi sangs rgyas rnams thabs mkhas shing thugs rje'i nus pa bsam mi khyab pas/ gdul bya tha dad pa'i skal ba dang mos pa ji snyed pa de dang mthun pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi sgo dang rnam grangs mtha' yas pa dag gis snying po ni mdo sngags gnyis 254)las sngags kyi theg pa/ de la rgyud sde'i rim pa bzhi'am drug las/ 'dir 'chad par bya ba ni 'bras bu bla na med pa thams cad kyi spyi phud dam par gyur ba nges don zab mo tshe gcig sangs rgyas lag bcangs su ston par byed pa'i gdams pa/ de la'ang phyag rdzogs gnyis las skabs 'dir rdzogs pa chen po dang*/ de nyid la'ang phyi sems sde/ nang klong sde/ gsang ba man ngag gi sde/ yang gsang bla na med pa a ti/ spyi ti/ yang ti dang bcas pa'i zab mo'i rgyud sde 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i grangs med kyi rgyud dang man ngag mtha' yas pa'i nang nas/ 'dir ni yang gsang bla med snying thig zab mo'i nyams len gyi 'gag bsdus rgyun khyer gyi tshul brda mtshon sa bon tsam zhig ston par byed pa lags/

༈ brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi phung po las// nges don snying po'i nor bu ma blangs na// tshe gcig byang chen 'bras bu mi thob 255)kyi// nges gsang snying po'i nyams len 'bad 'tshal lo/ ༈ de la thog mar gdams pa 'di lta bu ston par byed pa'i bla ma ni gang byung byung gis rung ba ma yin te/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa spyi dang khyad par rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i don phyin ci ma log pa la gom pa mngon du gyur pas slob ma'i rgyud byin gyis brlab nus pa gcig la bstan dgos la/ des kyang thog mar slob ma'i gshis rgyud ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i dbang bzhi'i rim pa bskur nas dbang don gyi ye shes cung zad nyams su myong ba zhig gal che ste/ 'di ni dper na zhing la lo tog 'debs pa'i dang por rmo khrol chu lud sa bon 'debs pa sogs dang tshul mtshungs pa ste/ de dag tshul bzhin ma byas par ni lo 'bras ji lta ba skye ba dang 'byung ba'i gnas med pa bzhin no/ de ltar smin byed kyi dbang thob pa'i 256)rjes la grol byed kyi khrid rim dngos ston par byed pa la yang sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyi srang nas 'don dgos phyir/ de yang dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam nas dam pa'i chos la spro ba bskyed/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam nas chos ma gtogs cis kyang dgos med dang*/ phyi bshol snyom las la mi shor bar long med brtson 'grus kyi lcags kyis bskul/ dkar nag gi rgyu 'bras bsam zhing dge sdig phra zhing phra ba tshun gyi blang dor la bslabs/ rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam nas 'khor ba'i zhen pa spang zhing thar pa'i phan yon la yid ches par bya ba rnams ni thun mong gi sngon du 'gro ba ste/ chos la blo 'jug cing khrid par byed pa'i thabs yin pas rgyud la 'khel nges shes par bya'o/ de nas tshogs bsag cing sgrib pa sbyong bar ma byas na chos ci byas lam du mi 'gro bas/

dang por 257)mdun gyi nam mkha' skyabs gnas dkon mchog ma lus mngon sum du khrom tshogs pa ltar bzhugs par dmigs te/ rang gzhan mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad lhan cig tu 'khor ba ngan song gi sdug bsngal las thar nas myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'khod pa zhig bla ma dkon mchog khyed rnams mkhyen snyam pa'i dad gus drag pos skyabs 'gro bya zhing*/ skyid sdug ci byung yang re sa ltos yul dkon mchog ma gtogs gzhan la mi re bar blo thag bcad la phyag mchod skyabs 'gro kha ton la 'bad/ skye ba 'di'i pha ma'i drin gyi che lugs la bsam nas 'gro ba rigs drug mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad kyang 'khor ba thog med nas pha ma drin chen ma byas pa su yang med pas/ 'di dag la drin lan chos kyis ma gzhal na/ gzhan gang gis kyang drin lan 'khor ba'i thabs ma mchis pa na/ bdag gi tshe gcig byang 258)chub bsgrub te sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las sgrol bar sems bskyed cing smon lam bzang po'i mtshams sbyor bya/ sangs rgyas thob pa la gegs dang bar du gcod pa ni sdig sgrib nyams chag kho nas lan pa yin pas de dag bshags sbyangs gal che ba'i phyir/ rang gi spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan steng na ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma la rnam pa rdo rje sems dpa'i cha lugs snang la rang bzhin med pa 'ja' 'od kyi skur bskyed pa'i thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ dkar gyi mthar yig brgyas bskor bar bsam zhing ngag nas bzlas pas/ sngags 'phreng las bdud rtsi 'o ma lta bu'i rgyun babs pa rdor sems kyi zhabs kyi mthe bong las bdud rtsi brgyud cing rang gi spyi gtsug tu tshangs pa'i bu gar zhugs nas lus thams cad mer gyi gang ba dang*/ nyes ltung sdig sgrib kyi dngos po mtha' dag sol khu lta bu nag 'dur gyi dbang po dang ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas phyir 'thon te 259)dag par bsam/ nyams rtogs rgyud la skye bar byen pa ni bla ma'i bying rlabs zhugs pa la rag cing byin rlabs 'jug thabs ni mos gus gsol 'debs la rag lus pa dang*/

dad pa mos gus zhes pa de yang kha tsam tshig tsam gsol 'debs byed lo tsam gyis ni ci yang mi phan gyi/ sangs rgyas thams cad bla ma'i ngo bor 'dus pa yin phyir/ bla ma ni sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa'o snyam pa'i dag snang zhe thag pa nas med na/ bla ma mi ru bzung ba'i slob ma la byin rlabs 'jug par mdo rgyud man ngag gang nas kyang ma bshad/ bla ma la tshod yod mnyam 'grogs log lta byas na mnar med pa'i dmyal bar ltung bar rgyud lung man ngag thams cad zhal mthun phyir/ deng sang gi bla ma dang slob ma phal cher phan tshul zol 'grogs dang bstun res su bya dgos pa'i dus 'di 260)'dra byin rlabs tshul bzhin zhug par yang shin tu dka' bar gda' mid kyi/ de bas na rang nyid yi dam gyi lha gang rung gi bskyed rim mos pa lam byed tsam gyi spyi bor seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan stengs su/ rang la sku drin che ba'i rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid chos sku kun tu bzang pa'am/ rdo rje 'chang ngam/ pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi cha byad du gsal ba'i gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs dus kyi sangs rgyas byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma bka' gter bshad sgrub man ngag don rgyud kyi bla ma yi dam lha tshogs mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs mdor na byin rlabs dngos grub kyi mnga' bdag ma lus char babs pa lta bur byon te spyi bo'i bla ma nyid la dbyer med du thim pas/ bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus ye nas yin bzhin pa las kyang thugs rje nus pa byin rlabs gong 'phel du gyur pa'i nges shes bskyed 261)la/ snang srid snod bcud bdag lus longs spyod sgo gsum gtan dang bcas pa mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal du 'bul zhing*/ dad gdung mchi ma 'khrug pa'i mos gus kyi gsol ba gdab/ gsol ba 'debs rgyu'i don po yang gnas skabs tshe 'di'i 'dod yon tsam don du gnyer bar mi bya ste/ rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma dkon mchog rnams kyi thugs rgyud la mnga' ba'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje mdzad pa'i phrin las/

skyob pa'i nus mthu nyams rtogs yon tan ci mchis pa de thams cad bdag nyid kyi rgyud la bstim zhing 'phel te/ skyabs gnas de dag dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i go 'phang bdag gis thob nas mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i don rlabs chen rgyun chad med pa 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol snyam pa 'ba' zhig tu gsol ba gdab/ de lta bus gsol ba btab na 262)mchog gi dngos grub rtsol med du thob par 'gyur la/ mchog thob na thun mong zhar la 'byung ba chos nyid yin pa dang*/ mdor na byin rlabs zhes pa ni dad pa'i rang gzugs yin phyir/ dad mos kyi stobs thugs che chung dang mthun pa'i byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che chung 'byung ba nyid do/ de ltar gsol ba rtse gcig gtab pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi gnas gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros te rang nyid kyi spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga gsum du thim pas sgo gsum gyi nyes sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs thob cing 'bras bu sku bzhi 'grub pa'i sa bon rgyud la 'jog pa'i nges shes dang*/ slar yang spyi bo'i bla ma nyid rang la gnyis su med par thim ste rang sems bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med pa'i ngang nas rang rig ma bcos bzo med du mnyam par bzhag pa ste/ de ltar 'di yan chad kyi 263)nyams len 'di dag ni gang zag las dang po pa nyams khrid la 'jug pa'i sngon 'gro yang yin la/ rgyun du nyams su len rgyu'i khrid rim yang yin phyir/ thun gyi thog mar med du mi rung ba'i gdams pa lags so/ ༈ skyabs 'gro sems skyed chos kyi gzhi ma yin// yig brgya maṇ+ḍal lam gyi mthun rkyen yin// bla ma'i rnal 'byor lam gyi snying po ste// gsar rnying grub thob kun gyi gshegs shul lags/ ༈ de nas dngos gzhi nges don rang byung gi ye shes dngos ji ltar nyams su blangs ba'i thabs la/ gsang sngags gsar rnying gi nges don so sor khrid tshul dang phyag bzhes mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod mod kyang*/

rdzogs chen snying thig zab mo'i man ngag las ni skabs 'dir thog mar phyi nang gsang gsum thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro rnams rgyas 264)par bshad cing phyag len la 'debs pa yin mod kyi/ skabs 'dir ni dngos gzhi'i nyams len dmar 'jus nyid ston pa yin phyir gzhan rnams brjod dgos par ma gyur la/ de yang sgom thog nas lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa dang/ lta thog nas sgom pa ngos bzung ba'i phyag srol gnyis yod pa las/ 'dir ni sgom thog nas lta ba ngo sprod pa'i lugs bzhin yin pas na/ de la yang chos spyi nas zhi gnas lhag mthong rim can du ston pa'i dgongs pa ltar/ 'dir yang rnal du dbab pa dang*/ gsor 'jug pa zhes pa'i ming gis bstan pa mdzad de/ dang po ni/ dben pa'i gnas su bde ba'i gdan la lus ngag yid gsum bzo glod de bya ba gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i ngang nas sems nyid 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gyi bsam mno 'gyu 'phro dgag sgrub bzo bcos gang yang 265) mi bya bar/ rang sems lhad med du rjen ne/ gsal le/ lhan ne bar bzhag cing*/ de yang ha cang bsgrims na sems kyis sems bcings pa ru song nas bcos mar 'gro/ ha cang rang lhod drag na ma tshor bar 'og 'gyu phra mo shor ba'am bying rmugs gnyid kyi dbang du thal ba sogs kyi skyon 'byung phyir grim lhod ran zhing rang tshod zin par bskyangs pas/ rang sems kyi gnas lugs ji lta ba rang rgyud la 'char bar 'gyur ba de ni mchog gi zhi gnas sam/ bsam gtan gyi gnas pa zhes bya ba yin no/ 'dis sgom dngos kyi go chod pa ma yin kyang sgom rgyud la skye bar byed pa'i gzhi mar med mi rung ba lta bu lags/ ༈ de nas lhag mthong gi ngang du gsor 'jug pa ni/ gnas pa'i bsam gtan de nyid kyi thog nas gnas mkhan gyi sems kho rang ji 'dra 266) zhig 'dug bltas pas/ 'di lta bu zhig 'dug gi dngos po ngos bzung gang yang med pa'i dran bsam 'gags med du 'char rgyu yod pa shar rgyu'i rnam rtog dang 'char mkhan gyi rang sems dngos gzhi yang tha dad du ma grub pa zhig 'byung ba de ni sems kyi ngo bo yin te/

gong du gnas mkhan dang slar de la lta mkhan gnyis ka kho rang kho na ma gtogs gnyis su nam yang med do/ de ltar lta mkhan nam gnas mi gnas 'gyus ma 'gyus sogs tshor mkhan gyi shes pa hrig ge yer re ba zhig yod pa de nyid la rig pa zhes bya ste/ mdo sde dag las/ dran dang shes bzhin zhes pa de yang de nyid yin pa dang/ phyag rgya chen po sogs las ni dran pa cazhas pa'i ming du btags la/ zhi byed kyi man ngag rnams su ni thug phrad kyi shes pa zhes zer ba ste/ mdor na sems kyi mtshan nyid ji lta bar shes pa'i lhag 267)mthong gi ye shes yin pas/ sgom nyams su len rgyu'i ngo bo dngos kyang lhag mthong gi rig pa rjen pa de nyid yin gyi/ zhi gnas kyi nyams snang gnas cha rkyang pa tsam la ni ma yin no/ lhag mthong gi rig pa rjen pa de ni/ dper na mnyam gzhag la bsdad thog der gzhan rkyen gzugs sgra sogs kyi sems bskyod pa'i rkyen med rung rnam rtog zhig lhag gis shar tsa na lhag mthong gi rig pa de yod na rnam rtog gang skyes te ngo yis tsir gyi zin nas/ rnam rtog de 'phro 'thud dbang med par sgom thog tu lhan gyi 'gro ba yin zhing*/ dran rig des ma zin na rnam rtog gang skyes a 'thas lu gu rgyud du 'khrul nas nyon mongs 'ba' zhig 'phel bar 'gyur ba ste/ de nas sgom yod med dam/ thugs dam gnad du song ma song ni sems gang shar ngos mi zin 268) kho nar rag pa dang*/ 'khor 'das kyi so mtshams 'di gcig pus kyang phye ba ste/ rang ngo rig na sangs rgyas/ ma rig na sems can zhes bya bas so/ spyir yang sgom chen phal cher sgom zhes gnas gnas po/ bzang bzang po/ bde dang gsal dang mi rtog sogs rgyud la 'char ba zhig 'dod mkhan rang mang mod kyang*/ de dag ni zhe 'dod kyi rtog pa kho nas bslad pa yin la/ sgom dngos ni zhe 'dod blos byas yid byed gang gis kyang ma bslad pa'i tha mal shes rig so ma rang ngo rang gis rig pa nyid dgos pa dang/

de lta bu'i rig pa lhad med de ni lta ba'i don dngos gzhi yin phyir/ de las lhag pa'i lta ba zhes gzhan zhig dgos pa ma lags so/ lta ba'i don de nyams su len pa ni sgom pa/ nyams len de spyod lam thams cad dang bsre ba ni spyod pa/ de don mngon du gyur tshe 269)'bras bu mthar phyin pa yin pas na/ lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi rnam grangs mang po dang/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas chos dang sa lam gyi yon tan mang po mtha' dag kyang sems nyid dri med kyi thog tu 'dus pa nyid las gzhan ma mchis kyang*/ 'dod zhen bzang 'dzin rlom sems kyis ma bcings pa gal che bas/ sems nyid gnas na gnas mkhan rang ngo shes pas/ 'gyu na 'gyus par ngo shes pa/ tshogs drug gi snang ba gang dang cir shar ba thams cad la yang shar mkhan kho rang ngo shes na 'char sgo gang la'ang dgag sgrub bya ma dgos par gang shar rang grol du 'gro ba chos nyid lags/ mdor sdu gnas pa dang 'gyu ba gnyis ka la rang rig pas ngos zin na ni gnyis ka sgom gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das la/ ngos ma zin na gnas kyang dman pa'i zhi gnas tsam yin zhing*/ 'phro na 270) 'khrul pa'i bag chags las ma 'das tshe chos su nam yang ma song ba'i phyir/ des na rnam pa thams cad du rang rig rjen cer re/ hri ge wa le/ khyug ge ba 'di ma brjed par skyong pa la nyams len gyi snying por bya'o/ gal te nyon mongs pa zhe sdang lta bu zhig skyes pa na/ zhe sdang lhang nge ba de ka'i ngo bo la rig pa mdung tshugs su gtad nas nyams su blangs pas/ zhe sdang kho rang tsho mi thub par gtad med du yal 'gro ba las gzhan pa'i las mi gsog pa yin/ de bzhin nyon mongs dug lnga gzhan rnams la'ang mtshungs pa ste/ gang skyes de'i rjes su phar mi 'brang zhing*/ de spong ba'i dgag pa'am gnyen po gzhan bstan pa sogs chos gzhan dang theg pa 'og ma'i lugs ltar bya mi dgos par/ de nyid kyi rang ngo la rig pa yengs med rtse gcig tu gtad

271)pas rba rlabs rgya mtshor thim pa'am/ 'khyags rom chu nang du zhu ba ltar rang sar thim zhing grol bar 'gyur ba ste/ ci'i phyir na/ nyon mongs dang rnam rtog de thams cad don dam par rig pa kho rang gi rtsal las shar ba ma gtogs gzhan nas byung ba ma yin pas rang ngo shes na rang grol du 'gyur ba ni dper na/ sprin nam mkha' las byung zhing nam mkha' thim pa bzhin/ nyon mongs dug lnga rang byung rang grol lam du 'khyer ba 'di ni 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i zab gnad kho na lags/ ༈ de lta bu rang sems rang ngo rig pa'i nyams len dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ nub mo gnyid du 'gro khar yang rnam par rtog pa tha mal 'khrul 'byams su mi bya bar/ rig pa gsal le yer re ba'i ngang gi 'phro la gnyid du 'gro ba la slab/ gnyid sad pa'i tshe de ma thag rig pa ngos zin par byas la/ 'khrul pa lug rgyud kyi 272)thag pa 'di gang thung thung la goms su bcug pa gal che ba dang*/ ༈ gnas skabs kyi bya ba za 'thung smra brjod 'gro 'dug la sogs rang la yang a 'thas bden 'dzin zhen chags gyis bdag tu bzung ba'i blo kad kad khrig khrig tu byas kyang*/ gang la'ang snying po med cing rtag mi thub phyir dgos don spu tsam ma mchis pas ci la yang dngos 'dzin dang dga' mi dga'/ zhim ngar/ skyid sdug legs nyes/ bzang ngan sogs su 'dzin pa'i 'khrul rtog 'di ci chung ci zad kyi thabs la rems dgos te/ 'khor bar gtan du 'khyams pa'i rgyu rkyen ni changs sdang gi rtog pa la bdag 'dzin a 'thas kyi mtshams sbyar te/ mi bden pa la bden par bzung*/ mi rtag pa la rtag par 'dzin/ 'dus byas snying po med pa la snying por re bas/ bdag gzhan dgra gnyen/ khang khyim/ nor rdzas/ gnyen 'khor la sogs pa'i ched du mi 273)byed dgu byed kyi bsam sbyor 'khrul pa'i yo langs sna tshogs pa ci byas kyang*/ yid la med pa gcig tu 'chi nad kyis phog ste/

tshe 'di'i bya byed sngar byas pa dang*/ da byed rgyu thams cad la don sgo spu tsam yang med par shul du cam gyi bzhag nas/ rang sems 'di gcig bu bar do'i phrang ring gshag dgos pa'i dus shig myur du 'ong bar thag chod pa'i tshul yid la bsam ste/ skyabs bla ma dkon mchog la kha zhe med par blo bkal zhing phyag mchod gsol 'debs bya/ mkha' mnyam pha ma sems can kun la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom zhing gnod spang phan pa sgrubs/ 'khor 'das thams cad sems su shes shing sems stong pa nyid du thag chod kyang stong nyid kyi rang mdangs rgyu 'bras su shar ba bslu med yin pas dge sdig gi blang dor zhib tu bya/ lto gos dang 'jig rten 'khrul pa'i bya ba la ni sus kyang 274)dal khoms mi brtsi bar lus srog dka' ba khyad du bsad nas 'bungs nus pa la/ chos dang dge sbyor la khoms mi khoms brtsi zhing chang lhag bsdom pa tsam du byed pa 'di 'dras chos go mi chod pas/ dal khoms skyid sdug mi brtsi bar spros bcas spros med kyi dge sbyor la snying rus bskyed/ nyams len gyi snying po ni/ rang sems 'khrul 'byams su ma shor bar/ bcos ma'i sgom rgyu med kyang yengs su skad cig kyang mi rung bas/ sems nyid rjen pa'i rang ngo lta ba la nyin mtshan rtag tu 'bad/ spros bcas kyi dge sbyor phyag skor/ kha ton bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod ci lta bu zhig byed na'ang rig pa ma yengs tsam gyi ngang nas byas na/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gam 'dus byas 'dus ma byas dbyer med du 'gro ba'i gnad kyis/ nyams len la gol sa dang bar chad rkyen bgegs kyi yul las 'das shing/ rgyu bsod nams dang 275)'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis gong 'phel du rdzogs nas/ 'bras bu sku gnyis zung 'jug gi go 'phang thob pa'i thabs kyi mchog tu 'gyur pa lags/ de'i phyir dge ba che chung gang dang ci byas kyi phan yon ma lus mkha' khyab 'gro kun byang chub thob pa'i rgyu rkyen kho nar bsngo zhing smon lam bzang po'i mtshams sbyor la brtson par bya'o/

༈ nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus la babs pa'i tshe/ tshe 'di'i bya byed kyi lhag ma'ang nor rdzas nye du sogs la chags zhen gyi blo thag rbad kyi bcad la/ spyi bor drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma lam gyi gsal btab ste/ rtse gcig dad gdung gi yid kyi gsol ba btab/ 'chi kha'i thim rim gyi zug ngu gnad gcod sna tshogs pa dang*/ rtags dang don gyi 'od gsal gyi bye brag du ma dang*/ bar do dang po gnyis pa gsum pa'i 276) 'char snang sogs nges med ji ltar shar yang*/ thams cad rang sems kyi cho 'phrul las gzhan gang yang ma grub par gding thag rtsa ba nas chod par byas la/ bla ma rang sems dbyer med pa'i dran rig ma yengs pa gcig pu la rtse gcig tu dril nus na/ 'chi kha dang bar do snga phyi thams cad kyi gdams ngag nyams len 'di gcig pus chog nges lags pas dgongs pa'i dbyings zab dam par nan tan du bstim zhing bcags par mdzad du gsol/ ༈ e ma/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab rgya mtsho mtha' dag kun// sems can sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i thabs su gcig /de yi yang snying nges gsang rdzogs pa che// bla med theg pa kun gyi yang rtse bar// thugs rje kun khyab 'gro la ye bzhugs kyang*// lhan skyes dri mas bsgribs gang bsal bya'i phyir// khregs chod thod rgal gdams pa'i nyin byed gsal// chos tshul 'di yi tshig don rab 277) rgyas rnams// rgyud lung man ngag bstan bcos du ma las// rig 'dzin brgyud pas rgya cher bstan mdzad pas// rmongs rgan bdag 'dras bshad pas dgos pa ci// de las nyams len snying po nyung bsdus shig /smra bar gyis zhes bka' bstsal ji bzhin du/ mig dbang rnam rig nus pa rgud na yang// lhag bsam dkar pos kun blangs phul lags pas// bsod nams stobs kyi 'byor pa'i sa skyong ma// mkhyen pa spyan yangs mnga' mod dgung los lci// de phyir snying po'i zab bzhes don gnyer ba/ legs so ran no brtson par mdzad 'tshal lo// bshad tshogs lung 'dren tshig gis 'dab brgya ni// bzhad pa'i skabs min mdzub tshugs bcud dril du// phul 'di'i dge tshogs mthu yis 'gro kun kyang*// nges don lam zhugs tshe gcig sangs rgyas shog

ces pa 'di ni grub dbang 'gar gyi chos kyi rgyal khab tu seng ge'i khri 278) gnon pa'i gdung rigs dri ma med pa las 'khrungs shing lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen pa'i pad tshal rgyas pas mnga' 'bangs rkang drug rnams kyi ro gnas mchog tu gyur pa sku mdun dbon po'i drung gres mo'i bzhed pa skong phyir/ rgan po mig dbang mi gsal zhing 'byung khams ma snyoms bzhin du snying rus kyi gzhon pas drangs te/ chos dbyings 'od gsal rtse mor yi ge'i lam du bkod nas phul ba dge legs su gyur cig/ ༈ rigs rus cho 'brang lang 'tsho'i 'byor stobs la// ma zhen dam pa'i chos kyis thugs 'phrogs pa// rig pa 'dzin pa'i dbang mo ming don la// mthun pa'i skal bzang ma de shis gyur cig /dal 'byor phun tshogs thob 'di don yod du// mdzad phyir 'khor ba'i btson ra ring spangs shing*// myos byed dug gi yo lang rab spong ba'i// dam bca' bzang por yi rangs dge rtsa'ang bsngo// dam pa'i bshes gnyen mchog gi zin pa'i mthus// log pa'i lam du 'gro nyen chung mod kyi// 'on kyang ji srid lus sems 'grogs 279)kyi bar// rang tshod chos kyi zin la 'bad par zhu// skyes mtha' 'chi zhing 'byor pa'i mtha' ma rgud// bsags mtha' zad pa 'dus byas chos nyid la// blo sna ring ba gang zhig 'gyod pa'i rgyu// 'jig rten blo rgya gang chung chos dang mthun// mi tshe'i nyi ma lo zla zhag gi 'dzad// 'chi bdag nam mkha'i thog ltar nges med 'ongs// na so gzhon snyam le lo byar mi khoms// chos la snying rus bskyed mdzod skal ldan ma// sangs rgyas mngon sum bla ma bzhugs dus 'dir// bka' chos bdud rtsa'i zil mngar ma 'thung na// gtan du mtshan ldan bla ma brnyed par dka'// ded dpon 'dzom dus nor bu len 'tshal lags// dad gus shugs bskyed gsol ba rgyun du gdab// mkha' mnyam pha ma'i tshogs la byang sems sbyang// dge sdig phra zhing phra ba'ang 'dor len rem// rang rgyud chos kyis thul mdzod snying gtam lags// mi

280)rgan 'chi kha'i gtam la don snying yod// don de yal bar ma 'dor thugs la bstim// don mchog chos kyi tshig gi 'gro kun kyang// zhal kha dam pa'i chos la 'gyur bar shog ces pa 'di ni/ mnyam med sgom po pa'i gdung rigs las 'khrungs pa'i sku mdun ma rig 'dzin dbang mos myos byed chang gi btung ba spong bar zhal bzhes gyi dam bca'i lan du phul ba'o// ༈ chos nyid don la rab mos pa'i// chos nyid dbang mo dad ldan mas// yi ge lha rdzas mtshan grangs bcas// ji ltar gnang bzhin legs smin lags/ e ma/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// bde bar 'khrul nas zhen mkhan mang// sdug bsngal mtshan nyid shes nas kyang*// 'khor ba spong ba ngo mtshar che// myos byed chang gis dug chen 'dis// 'phral yun 'dun ma rlag byed pa'i// phung rdzas yin kyang go mkhan med// spong ba'i dam bca' rjes yi rangs// dam pa'i chos kyi 281)sgor zhugs nas// sgo gsum snyom las mi khoms kyi// thos dang bsam dang sgom pa la// nan tan mdzod cig chos nyid ma// sangs rgyas dngos byon mchog sprul che// yid bzhin nor bu rang gi gcen// mtshan nyid kun tshang dge ba'i bshes// yod dus dam chos zhu la rems// na so gzhon dus dbang po gsal// rang dbang yod tshe ma 'bad na// rgas khogs dbang po 'gribs pa'i tshe// byed par 'dod kyang nus pa med// 'chi ba nam yong cha med la// na so'i nges pa ma mchis na// gzhon zhes le lo mi rung gi /dge sbyor brtson mdzod chos nyid ma// 'di dang phyi ma bar do sogs// nam du'ang skyid sdug ci byung kyang// bla ma dkon mchog ma gtogs pa// re yul med do gsol ba thob// 'gro drug sems can mtha' dag pa// skye ba gtan gyi pha ma yin// nye ring med par byams 282)snying rjes// ci phan bsgrub cing gnod 'tshe spang*// dad dang nges 'byung so ma 'di// yal nas blo dred 'gro ba mang*// mi tshe'i 'go mjug 'khyol ba yi// chos mthun mdzod cig snying gtam lags/

zhes sku mdun ma sku gzhon pa la phul ba'o// bzang po'i rgyud las legs 'khrungs shing*// rin chen bla mas rjes bzung ba// bzang po'i rin chen ming don dang*// mthun pa'i skal ba bzang ldan des// skyes gnang yi ge'i lan don por// snying la bcags pa'i snying gtam ni// bsrings zhig gsungs bzhin srin bu'i rjes// ji lta'i yig mchid 'di skad 'bul// khams gsum 'khor ba'i skye gnas bzhir// skyes pa'i nang par 'chi bdag gi bdag tu ma bzung su yang med/ 'chi ba dran mdzod snying gtam lags// na so gzhon pa'i gdeng brong la// 'chi bas mi 'jigs ma yin gyi// rnam g.yengs le lo sus byas phung*// long med dran mdzod 283) snying gtam lags// chos sgor zhugs pa mang lugs la// tshul bzhin byed pa nyung lags kyis// mtha' ru phyin mkhan srid pa tsam// snying rus bskyed mdzod snying gtam lags// bla ma'i gzugs brnyan rab tu mang*// mtshan ldan nyin skar shin tu dkon// sangs rgyas mngon sum mjal dus 'dir// dad dam ldan mdzod snying gtam lags// thos bsam sgom pa'i snying po de// rang rgyud thul ba gal che na// ngar 'dzin khengs rlom ma zhugs par// dman sa 'dzin mdzod snying gtam yin// sdom pa dam tshig rtsa ba de// ngos lkog med pa'i yid ches dgos// btsan dug lkog tu za 'dra ba'i// rang phung ma byed snying gtam yin// rang rgyud dar dkar zab mo 'di// grogs ngan snum gyis gos dogs yod// dri med lhag bsam dag pa nyid// chud mi gzan mdzod snying gtam yin// 'jig rten bya ba zar zir la// blo sna gang 'jug phung ba'i rgyu// blo kha nang du bzlog 284)nas kyang*// chos la dril mdzod snying gtam yin// dam chos snying po phyag rgya che// gnas lugs gdod ma'i ye shes de// rang dbang thob pa'i nyams len zhig /med thabs med do snying gtam lags// rgan po 'chi kha'i snying gtam 'di// tshig la rnam dpyod mi ldan yang*// don la lhag bsam bden stobs yod// thugs la 'chang mdzod phan pa 'byung*// mig dbang 'grib pa'i yig gzugs 'di// spyan lam brims pa'i re med kyang*// bzhed don bskongs phyir phul ba'i dge
