/ma lus 'gro ba'i don du bsngo/ zhes 'phan yul rgya ma chos mdzad bzang rig par phul ba'o// ༈ skye ba mang por goms pa'i blo gros ni// dug gsum rgyu 'bras zug rngu 'byin pa'i mchog /rmad byung gso ba rig pa'i mdzod 'chang ba// gzhan phan bzang po sku khams snyoms lags sam// bdag las gzhan gces byang chub sems bzang pos// 'gro ba pha ma'i rang bzhin 285)la phan pa// bsgrub de rgyal ba'i sras mchog kun gyi lam// yin phyir gzhan phan bzang po ming don mthun// 'di na spong ba la mos rgan po ni// mi tshe'i lhag ma zla zhag 'ga' tsam 'di// rgod tshang dben pa'i phug par skyel snyam yang*// klo rong sa chu lus la ma phrod pas// rgan po mkhar ba la brten yar la 'ongs// gang du gnas kyang 'chi bas mi tshugs pa'i// sa phyogs gang yang yod pa min mod kyang*// re shig 'byung khams snyom par 'ong re bas// gnas 'dir mchis rung rgas pa'i nad dang 'grogs// sgyu lus bde ba'i go skabs mi gda' yang*// skyes mtha' 'chi las nam yang mi 'da' bar// rtag tu yid la nges pa'i gnas skabs lags// skal pa bzang pos gzhan la phan brtson khyed// dal 'byor phun tshogs don dang ldan 286)phyir du// sgo gsum dge sbyor brtson pa mi lhod bzhin// skyabs bral nyams thag sdug bsngal bsal ba la// sngar bzhin lhag bsam go cha mi nyams mdzod// 'di phyi bar do skyid sdug ci byung yang*// re sa bla ma las lhag gzhan med pas// sman rgyal pad 'byung gu ṇa mnyam rdor bar// kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma dran par mdzod// tshe 'di'i skyid sdug rmi lam snang ba tsam// 'di ni g.yas chung de bas gtan 'dun zhig /sgrub dus da res lags gyi nam du yang*// dam chos rin chen yal bar mi 'dor ba'i// nyams len rgyud la 'khel mdzod gzhan phan bzang*// de skad gdams pa'i yig 'phreng byin rlabs rten// lhan cig phyi thums rdo rje'i rgyas btab de// chos dbyings 'od gsal rtse mo'i ri khrod nas// sna tshogs rang grol rgan pos phul ba dge

ces pa 'di 'tsho mdzad gzhan phan bzang po la gdams pa'o// ༈ 287) dad ldan chos mdzad kun dga' dbang rgyal dgongs// dal 'byor phun tshogs thob kyang rtag mi thub// na tshod 'byung khams bde yang myur du rgud// sangs rgyas bstan dang skye 'gro'i spyod tshul gzigs// dal khoms long yod sdod pa'i dus ma lags// gnyen dang yul 'khor khang khyim nor rdzas dang*// 'jig rten pher yong shes shes rnam grangs las// dben pa'i ri la rang sems 'dul skyong dang*// dge sbyor bre gsog phul gsog mdzad re ran// 'khor ba thog med bag chags 'khrul 'khor goms// tshe 'di'i bya ba byas bzhin mang du 'gro// cam gyi gzhag na 'khrul pa'i 'khor rgyun chad// 'chi kha'i rgyags grabs ran no ngang ma ring*// 'di byas 'di 'ong bsam mno mang po dang*// gzhan gyis dogs pa slong ba'i gros 'debs sogs// the tshom yid gnyis thag pa rbad kyi chod// blo rtse nang du khug pa'i dus la babs/ 288) /mi med brag phug lha yi khang bzang yin// skyo tsha rdor dkar zas dang skom gyi rab// bem dug bstum nas gsol 'debs lhang lhang sgrogs// dus gsum rgyal ba mnyes pa'i spyod pa yin// nags khrod dben par 'chi ba mi rtag sgom// do nub shi yang 'tsher dang 'gyod med kyi// 'dun pa'i snying po bla ma dkon mchog la// blo snying brang gsum gtod dang bslu ba med// gnyid dang snyom las long gtam rgyang du bsring*// dgos dgos bshom bshom 'dzom cha'i zhe 'dod spang*// sgom chen ri khrod 'grim nas shi ba de// chos pa'i gtam la snyan no 'gyod pa med// mkha' khyab sems can snying rje'i khongs su bcug /skyabs sems yig brgya tshogs gsags sgrib sbyong 'bad// bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol 'debs gdung shugs la// nyin mtshan rgyun du brtson mdzod gal re che/ ༈ sgom zhes bzo bcos 289)dmigs pa gang yang med// sems la sems kyi lta ba gcig pu yin// rnam rtog ci ltar shar yang g.yas med bskyu+ur// dgag sgrub rjes 'brang ma byas kho nas chog

/bzang po'i rtog pa skyes la dga' byed dang*// ngan pa'i rtog par dgra ru lta ba sogs// spang blang byas bzhin chags sdang je cher 'gro// g.yas med 'dzin med bsgyur ba gnad du zab// spyod lam rnam bzhi tshogs drug 'char snang rigs// gang la'ang der 'dzin zhen pa mi bya bar/ shes rig gsal le hrig ge 'di kho na// ma yengs rang babs skyong dang nor sa med// nad gdon bar chad 'gal rkyen bye brag rigs// ci ltar byung yang dge sbyor blos mi btang*// legs nyes mtha' dag sems kyi 'char tshul tsam// yin la yin par shes pa'i thag chod bya// nyams rtogs lam rtags yon tan ltar snang 290)ba// 'byung du re na rang sems bdud kyis khyer// mos gus dag snang snying rje zhen log dang*// nges 'byung skye ba grub rtags snying po yin// 'di dang bar do skye ba phyi ma dang*// mthar thug byang chub ma thob bar du yang*// bla ma rang sems dbyer med nyams len las// g.yel med rgyud la 'byor mdzod snying gtam lags/ /zhes pa 'di ni bla ma chos mdzad kun dga' dbang rgyal la yang dad pa'i gzhan bskul du gdams pa // ༈ dad pa'i yid can sgam po dbang gi rgyal// dal 'byor rin chen thob pa'i dka' chod la// 'khor ba sdug bsngal 'dam las legs thon te// dam pa'i chos sgor zhugs pa ngo mtshar che// bla ma sangs rgyas dngos kyi zhabs la zin// bstan pa'i snying po sgrub rgyud rin chen mjal// gang nas bsam kyang phun sum tshogs dus 'dir// snyom las le lor ma sdod dge sbyor 'bungs// tshe la nges med nam yang 'chi thag chod// de tshe dam pa'i chos 291)rang ma gtogs pa// stong gsum kha lo sgyur yang phan pa med// mi rtag zhen log bsgom pa gal du che// rang sems 'khor 'das kun gyi byed po 'di// rang dbang thob pa'i thabs la mi 'bad na// pher yong rnam rig bkra dang shes shes kyis// nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i dgra bo gzhom mi nus// rgas khar ltogs kyi dogs pa byed mkhan mang*// shi khar nyams len med dogs
